paper_title: Contributions of Latin American researchers in the understanding the novel coronavirus outbreak: A literature review
paper_abstract: This paper aimed to give the visibility of Latin American researchers' contributions to the comprehension of COVID-19; our method was a literature review. Currently, the world is facing a health and socioeconomic crisis caused by the novel coronavirus, SARS-CoV-2, and its disease COVID-19. Therefore, in less than four months, researchers have published a significant number of articles related to this novel virus. For instance, a search focused on the Scopus database on April 10, 2020, showed 1224 documents published by authors with 1797 affiliations from 80 countries. 25.4%, 24.0%, and 12.6% of these national affiliations were from China, Europe, and the USA, respectively, making these regions leaders in COVID-19 research. In the case of Latin America, on April 10, 2020, we searched different databases, such as Scopus, PubMed, and Web of Science, finding that the contribution of this region was 2.7±0.6% of the total publications found. In other words, we found 153 publications related to COVID-19 with at least one Latin American researcher.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) 13. This review considers the contribution of Latin American research concerning Covid-19, which sets it apart from other reviews on this disease. Why is it important to consider the regional contributions to new science on this subject and does this contribute to understanding the unique aspect of every society when dealing with this pandemic? This should be covered in your introduction and conclusion sections. Answer Same answer that question 1. 14. In general, when describing results reported by other studies, the past tense should be used. Answer We corrected the verb tenses. 15. On your abstract: “we searched in different databases, such as Scopus…” could be written as “we searched different databases, such as Scopus…”. “Finding that its contribution was 2.7…” would be clearer if written as “finding that the contribution of this continent was 2.7…”. Also, it is not clear from this sentence what this 2.7% represents. Finally, “visibility to the region contributions” could use an apostrophe (region’s). This is also true for line 61. Answer The sentence was corrected as follows: “finding that the contribution of this region was 2.7±0.6% of the total publications found” (lines 26-27). 16. Line 21: on the first time the word “national” is mentioned, it could be deleted. Or maybe this affiliation could be better explained: are these 1797 affiliations or 1797 mentions to Latin American countries in the affiliations section? Answer We confirmed that in one article, Scopus count one national affiliation by country, no matter how many authors have that national affiliation. If there are two or more different national affiliations in the same article, the count remains one, but this time for each national affiliation. Therefore, the line corrected is “by authors with 1797 affiliations from 80 countries” (line 22-23). Answer The corrections were included. 17. On the introduction, the number 170000 could be written as 170,000. The same applies to 100000 and 5500. Line 39: “as shown in table 1” Line 43: “Coronaviridae, has a zoonotic origin, and can remain on some surfaces for considerable periods.” Lines 45-47: this sentence needs rephrasing. Line 81: “due to” should be replaced by “because”. Line 101: “manually excluded eight additional publications due to affiliations from New Mexico…” Line 124: “in consulted databases” can be deleted. Line 127: delete “the.” Line 130: The expression “science gap” is not very clear. Is it a gap in science funding, technology, facilities? Line 144: “second, that if…” Line 150: “a higher ability to infect humans when compared to other coronaviruses” Line 157: “receptor, providing SARS-Cov-2 with a higher infectiousness” Line 169: delete “While” Lines 182-185: Please rephrase these sentences with active voice (table 2 summarizes…). Line 202: “the geo-positioning of some cases and the heterogeneity of the outbreak progress among countries have been reported” Line 212: “Meta-analyses and the search for potential treatments” Line 221: “Oxygen support in critical patients…” Line 229: “Concerning respiratory viruses” Line 252: “use” should be deleted Line 262: delete “regarding” Line 303: “take into account” Line 205: “the latter being a treatment that not all medical centres” Line 309: “Finally, mental health care” Answer The corrections were included. 18. Line 83: Were there any articles with Latin American affiliation and no Latin American authors? Do you believe these articles should be completely excluded? Although they do not contain Latin American researchers, if there are any, you could mention them in your analysis since they were at least partially conducted in Latin American institutes. Answer Some databases initially included these articles due to some flaws in their search forms. The most obvious was to confuse New Mexico with Mexico, but a second confusion was performed by the Lilacs database, which mixed Pennsylvania (PA) and Panama as the same affiliation. These eight articles had no Latin American researchers. This is cleared up in the bibliometric analysis section (lines 110-112). We also corrected sentence in section 2.2 as follows: “Later, we performed a second manual revision to verify that all publications had at least one researcher with a Latin American affiliation” (lines 89-90). 19. Line 111: to avoid confusion, you could explain what the national affiliations correspond to. If one paper has authors affiliated to two different institutes of the same country, does this count as one national affiliation or two? Answer We included the line “Regardless of the number of authors from the same country but different institutions”. (line 120) 20. Lines 166-168: this information should be moved to the next paragraph. Answer We did no moved the sentence. Instead, we moved the phrase that was immediately after to the Lines 179-183, meaning both Ortega group studies are now contiguous. Then, former lines 166-168 are now followed by the next paragraph. 21. Lines 226-228: this sentence could be rephrased (high levels of NLR and low levels of LCR). Was this confirmed or is this an initial hypothesis? Answer The corrections were included (lines 252-254) 22. Lines 232-234: this study should be cited. Answer The reference was included (line 262). 23. Reviews should be very cautious when reporting results from other studies; wording should be careful so as to not twist other studies’ results or imply different meanings. Answer The corrections were included. 24. I understand that your review considers Latin American contributions to understanding the epidemic, but the Latin American contribution should be compared with information published worldwide especially when there is a lack of published information or contradictory studies. Answer We agree, therefore, the bioinformatics section included global reports, other simulations included the clarification that experimentation is required. Epidemiological analyses are focused on the region, validation with other publications is difficult. Regarding meta-analyses, we exposed it as general as possible. The articles included in search of treatments are reviews, therefore, we supposed their searches were meticulous. Medical and mental health considerations used reviews (same supposition), articles based on global recommendations and protocols (WHO, CDC, etc.), and global surveys to physicians. The final section (additional concerns) included mostly opinions and suggestions because research in many fields is still incipient. 25. Line 39: This sentence is not very clear. Did you mean that the amount of testing per million inhabitants is low because of indigenous populations, vulnerable groups, and Venezuelan refugees? I have checked your reference (Torres & Sacoto, 2020) and the article stated that this happened due to limited test availability, and case monitoring was challenging because of the lack of cellphone use among these populations. Regarding Oliveira et al. (2020), I have not found any information on this subject, please check this reference citation. Answer We corrected the sentence as follows: “However, these data may be lower than actual numbers because the number of tests per million inhabitants remains low, which is caused by factors such as the limited availability of tests and the difficulty of monitoring people without facilities like indigenous populations, vulnerable groups, and Venezuelan refugees (Oliveira et al., 2020; Torres & Sacoto, 2020).” (Lines 41-44). 26. Lines 141-142: was the highest of what? Among the analyzed viruses? Which ones? Answer We corrected the sentence as follows: “finding that among the viruses compared, this virus is closely related to bat-SL-CoVZXC21 (GenBank ID MG772934.1), while the least related is MERS (Benvenuto et al., 2020b)” (Lines 160-162). 27. Line 224: how old is this group exactly? What do you mean with most of the data came from China? Is there a need for more studies? Please make this clear. Answer The corrections were included as follows “Regarding lethality, the most affected population (81%) was the older group (60 years or more), but additional information is required to understand the COVID-19 impact on other continents because most of the data used in these meta-analyses came from China. Therefore, meta-analyses using Latin American cases would also be ideal for determining how COVID-19 could affect this region, which has some differences, such as lower average age or higher exposure to respiratory infections than other regions like Europe (Amariles et al., 2020a).” (Lines 245-250). 28. Line 287: which are these positive effects of hydroxychloroquine and chloroquine on diabetic patients? Is this regarding blood glucose levels or COVID-19? According to your reference, these medications affect glucose levels. This should be made clear. Answer The corrections were included as follows: “Likewise, the positive effects of hydroxychloroquine and chloroquine on diabetic patients were mentioned, such as reducing insulin degradation tending to normalize glucose levels. Therefore, in case hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine is administered, antidiabetic drug doses should be readjusted to avoid hypoglycemic events.” (Lines 314-317). 29. Line 320: It is important to state in which country these questionnaires were applied, since cultural and social aspects could also be involved in this matter, and please clearly state that their results represent that population and could not necessarily be the same for all countries. Answer The corrections were included as follows: “using questionnaires to Brazilians” (line 360) and “Therefore, at least in Brazil, strategies for extroverted people should be proposed to avoid they become transmission vectors. However, the idiosyncrasy is similar throughout Latin America; thus, these strategies should be required in the entire region.” (lines 364-367). 30. Line 331: It is important to clarify if this lack of information about the use of face masks is observed only in studies published by Latin American authors or if this is a global issue. Answer The correction was included as follows: “Elachola et al. (2020) highlighted that there are no prevalence and effectiveness studies on using facemasks related to the COVID-19 outbreak. This information could be useful in providing recommendations about their usage” (Lines 374-376). 31. Line 367: I believe the effects of angiotensin receptor blockers on Covid-19 infection have not yet been clearly established (see Reynolds et al., 2020, doi: 10.1056/NEJMoa2008975), therefore this topic could either relate the Latin American articles with other papers or clarify that this is a hypothesis. Answer The correction was included with this phrase “therefore, there is a possibility that they can favor the internalization of SARS-CoV-2 within the cell; thus, further studies are required”. (lines 411-412).
paper_title_zh: 拉丁美洲研究者在理解新型冠状病毒爆发中的贡献：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 本文旨在揭示拉丁美洲研究人员对理解COVID-19的贡献；我们的方法是文献综述。目前，世界正面临由新型冠状病毒SARS-CoV-2及其引发的疾病COVID-19造成的健康和社会经济危机。因此，在不到四个月的时间里，研究人员发表了大量与这种新病毒相关的文章。例如，2020年4月10日对Scopus数据库的搜索显示，共有1224篇文献，作者来自80个国家的1797个机构。其中，25.4%、24.0%和12.6%的国家级机构分别来自中国、欧洲和美国，使这些地区成为COVID-19研究的领导者。在拉丁美洲的情况下，2020年4月10日，我们搜索了不同的数据库，如Scopus、PubMed和Web of Science，发现该地区的贡献占总出版物的2.7±0.6%。换句话说，我们找到了153篇与COVID-19相关的出版物，其中至少有一位拉丁美洲研究人员参与。
review_content_zh:
审稿人3（匿名）13. 这篇综述考虑了拉丁美洲关于Covid-19的研究贡献，这使得它与其他关于该疾病的综述有所不同。为什么考虑这一区域对这一新科学主题的贡献是重要的，这有助于理解每个社会在应对这一大流行病时的独特方面吗？这一点应在你的引言和结论部分中加以涵盖。回答 同问题1的答案。14. 通常情况下，在描述其他研究报告的结果时，应使用过去时态。回答 我们已更正了动词时态。15. 在你的摘要中：“我们在不同的数据库中进行了搜索，例如Scopus…”可以写成“我们搜索了不同的数据库，例如Scopus…”。“发现其贡献为2.7…”如果写成“发现该大陆的贡献为2.7…”会更清楚。此外，从这句话中不清楚这2.7%代表什么。最后，“对区域贡献的可见性”可以使用一个撇号（region’s）。这在第61行也是适用的。回答 该句子已更正如下：“发现该区域的贡献为2.7±0.6%的总出版物”（第26-27行）。16. 第21行：在第一次提到“国家”这个词时，可以删除。或者 maybe 这个隶属关系可以更好地解释：是1797个隶属关系还是隶属关系部分中1797次提到拉丁美洲国家？回答 我们确认在Scopus的一篇文章中，每个国家计算一个国家隶属关系，无论有多少作者有那个国家隶属关系。如果同一篇文章中有两个或更多不同的国家隶属关系，计数仍为一个，但这次是针对每个国家隶属关系。因此，更正后的行是“由来自80个国家的1797个隶属关系的作者”（第22-23行）。回答 已包含更正。17. 在引言中，数字170000可以写成170,000。100000和5500同样适用。第39行：“如表1所示”第43行：“冠状病毒科，具有人畜共患病的起源，并且可以在某些表面上存活相当长的时间。”第45-47行：这个句子需要重写。第81行：“由于”应替换为“因为”。第101行：“手动排除了八篇额外的出版物，因其隶属关系来自新墨西哥州…”第124行：“在查阅的数据库中”可以删除。第127行：删除“the”。第130行：“科学差距”这一表达不太清楚。是指科学资助、技术、设施方面的差距吗？第144行：“其次，如果…”第150行：“与其他冠状病毒相比，具有更高的感染人类的能力”第157行：“受体，为SARS-Cov-2提供了更高的传染性”第169行：删除“While”第182-185行：请用主动语态重写这些句子（表2总结了…）。 第202行：“某些病例的地理位置定位以及各国疫情进展的异质性已有报道”
第212行：“荟萃分析及潜在治疗方法的探索”
第221行：“危重患者的氧气支持……”
第229行：“关于呼吸道病毒”
第252行：“使用”应删除
第262行：删除“关于”
第303行：“考虑”
第205行：“后者是一种并非所有医疗中心都具备的治疗方法”
第309行：“最后，心理健康护理”
回答：已包含所有修正。18. 第83行：是否有任何具有拉丁美洲隶属关系但没有拉丁美洲作者的文章？你认为这些文章应该完全排除吗？尽管它们不包含拉丁美洲的研究人员，但如果有，你可以在你的分析中提及它们，因为它们至少部分是在拉丁美洲的机构中进行的。回答：一些数据库最初由于搜索表单的某些缺陷而包含了这些文章。最明显的是将新墨西哥与墨西哥混淆，但第二次混淆是由Lilacs数据库造成的，它将宾夕法尼亚（PA）和巴拿马视为同一隶属关系。这八篇文章没有拉丁美洲的研究人员。这在文献计量分析部分（第110-112行）中已澄清。我们还对第2.2节中的句子进行了如下修正：“随后，我们进行了第二次手动审查，以确认所有出版物至少有一位具有拉丁美洲隶属关系的研究人员”（第89-90行）。19. 第111行：为避免混淆，你可以解释一下国家隶属关系指的是什么。如果一篇论文的作者隶属于同一国家的两个不同机构，这算作一个国家隶属关系还是两个？回答：我们添加了“无论来自同一国家但不同机构的作者数量”（第120行）。20. 第166-168行：这些信息应移至下一段落。回答：我们没有移动该句子。相反，我们将紧随其后的短语移至第179-183行，意味着奥尔蒂斯小组的两项研究现在是连续的。然后，原来的第166-168行紧接下一段落。21. 第226-228行：这句话可以重新措辞（高NLR水平和低LCR水平）。这是已确认的还是初步假设？回答：已包含修正（第252-254行）。22. 第232-234行：这项研究应被引用。回答：已包含参考文献（第262行）。23. 评论在报告其他研究结果时应非常谨慎；措辞应小心，以免扭曲其他研究结果或暗示不同含义。回答：已包含所有修正。24. 我理解你的评论考虑了拉丁美洲对理解疫情的贡献，但拉丁美洲的贡献应与全球发布的信息进行比较，尤其是在缺乏已发布信息或存在相互矛盾的研究时。 我们同意，因此，生物信息学部分包含了全球报告，其他模拟实验部分则明确指出需要实验验证。流行病学分析主要聚焦于该地区，与其他出版物的验证较为困难。关于元分析，我们尽可能将其表述得较为普遍。在寻找治疗方法的文章中，所包含的都是综述，因此，我们假设其搜索是细致的。医学和心理健康方面的考虑使用了综述（同样假设），基于全球推荐和协议（如WHO、CDC等）的文章，以及对医生进行的全球调查。最后一部分（额外关注）主要包含意见和建议，因为许多领域的研究仍处于初期阶段。

25. 第39行：这句话不太清楚。您是指每百万居民中的检测数量较低是因为土著人口、脆弱群体和委内瑞拉难民吗？我查看了您的参考文献（Torres & Sacoto, 2020），文章指出这种情况是由于检测资源有限，且由于这些群体中手机使用不足，病例监测具有挑战性。关于Oliveira等人（2020）的研究，我没有找到相关信息，请检查此参考文献引用。

我们已将句子更正如下：“然而，这些数据可能低于实际数字，因为每百万居民的检测数量仍然较低，这是由于检测资源有限以及监测缺乏设施的人群（如土著人口、脆弱群体和委内瑞拉难民）的困难所致（Oliveira et al., 2020; Torres & Sacoto, 2020）。”（第41-44行）。

26. 第141-142行：是最高的什么？在所分析的病毒中？哪些病毒？

我们已将句子更正如下：“发现与其他比较的病毒相比，这种病毒与蝙蝠-SL-CoVZXC21（GenBank ID MG772934.1）密切相关，而关系最远的是MERS（Benvenuto et al., 2020b）”（第160-162行）。

27. 第224行：这个群体具体多大年龄？您所说的“大部分数据来自中国”是什么意思？是否需要更多研究？请明确说明。

更正内容如下：“关于致死率，受影响最严重的群体（81%）是老年群体（60岁或以上），但需要更多信息来理解COVID-19对其他大陆的影响，因为这些元分析中使用的大部分数据来自中国。因此，使用拉丁美洲病例的元分析也将有助于确定COVID-19如何影响这一地区，该地区与其他地区（如欧洲）存在一些差异，例如平均年龄较低或呼吸道感染暴露率较高（Amariles et al., 2020a）。”（第245-250行）。

28. 第287行：羟氯喹和氯喹对糖尿病患者的这些积极效果是什么？是指血糖水平还是COVID-19？ 根据您的参考，这些药物会影响血糖水平。这一点应予以明确。回答：修正内容如下：“同样，羟氯喹和氯喹对糖尿病患者的积极影响被提及，例如减少胰岛素降解，倾向于使血糖水平正常化。因此，如果使用羟氯喹或氯喹，应重新调整抗糖尿病药物的剂量，以避免低血糖事件。”（第314-317行）。29. 第320行：重要的是要说明这些问卷在哪个国家应用，因为文化和社会因素也可能涉及此问题，并请明确指出其结果代表该人群，并不一定适用于所有国家。回答：修正内容如下：“使用问卷对巴西人进行调查”（第360行）和“因此，至少在巴西，应为外向型人群提出策略，以避免他们成为传播媒介。然而，拉丁美洲的特质相似；因此，这些策略应在整个地区实施。”（第364-367行）。30. 第331行：重要的是要澄清关于使用口罩的信息缺乏是否仅见于拉丁美洲作者发表的研究，或者这是一个全球性问题。回答：修正内容如下：“Elachola等人（2020年）强调，关于使用口罩与COVID-19疫情相关的流行率和有效性研究尚无。这些信息对于提供使用建议可能是有用的”（第374-376行）。31. 第367行：我认为血管紧张素受体阻滞剂对COVID-19感染的影响尚未明确（参见Reynolds等人，2020年，doi: 10.1056/NEJMoa2008975），因此这一主题可以关联拉丁美洲的文章与其他论文，或者澄清这只是一个假设。回答：修正内容如下：“因此，它们有可能促进SARS-CoV-2在细胞内的内化；因此，需要进一步研究”（第411-412行）。

paper_title: Interventions and implementation considerations for reducing pre-treatment loss to follow-up in adults with pulmonary tuberculosis: A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Tuberculosis (TB) is a leading cause of death worldwide with over 90% of reported cases occurring in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Pre-treatment loss to follow-up (PTLFU) is a key contributor to TB mortality and infection transmission. 
 
 
 Objectives 
 We performed a scoping review to map available evidence on interventions to reduce PTLFU in adults with pulmonary TB, identify gaps in existing knowledge, and develop a conceptual framework to guide intervention implementation. 
 
 
 Methods 
 We searched eight electronic databases up to February 6 2024, medRxiv for pre-prints, and reference lists of included studies. Two review authors independently selected studies and extracted data using a predesigned form. We analysed data descriptively, presented findings in a narrative summary and developed a conceptual framework based on the Practical, Robust Implementation, and Sustainability Model to map the factors for effective intervention implementation. 
 
 
 Results 
 We reviewed 1262 records and included 17 studies. Most studies were randomized controlled trials (8/17, 47%). Intervention barriers included stigma and inadequate resources; enablers included mobile phones and TB testing and results on the same day. We identified eight interventions that reduced PTLFU: treatment support groups; mobile notifications; community health workers; integrated HIV/TB services; Xpert MTB/RIF as the initial diagnostic test; computer-aided detection with chest radiography screening; active linkage to care; and multi-component strategies. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 Given the variation of healthcare settings, TB programs should consider contextual factors such as user acceptability, political commitment, resources, and infrastructure before adopting an intervention. Future research should utilize qualitative study designs, be people-centred, and include social and economic factors affecting PTLFU.
review_content:
Summary of the Article
The article titled "Interventions and implementation considerations for reducing pre-treatment loss to follow-up in adults with pulmonary tuberculosis: A scoping review" is a scoping review that addresses pre-treatment loss to follow-up in adults with pulmonary TB, a critical issue in TB management that exacerbates transmission and mortality rates. The authors aim to identify and evaluate interventions to reduce PTLFU, discuss barriers and enablers to their implementation, and propose a conceptual framework for intervention deployment.

Key findings of the Article
  * Interventions: Eight interventions were identified, including treatment support groups (TSGs), mobile notifications, integrated HIV/TB services, and the use of advanced diagnostic tools like Xpert MTB/RIF.
  * Barriers: Issues such as stigma, inadequate resources, and infrastructural challenges hinder effective implementation.
  * Enablers: Mobile phone access, same-day TB testing, and community health worker (CHW) involvement emerged as facilitators.
  * The authors developed a framework based on the Practical, Robust Implementation, and Sustainability Model (PRISM) to support context-sensitive intervention implementation.
Strengths of the Article
 1. The review synthesizes evidence from multiple databases and diverse study designs, providing a holistic view of available interventions.
 2. The conceptual framework offers practical guidance for policymakers and healthcare providers in tailoring interventions to specific contexts.
 3. By identifying these factors, the article enhances the utility of interventions in real-world settings.
 4. The use of double data extraction and adherence to PRISMA-ScR guidelines strengthens the reliability of findings.
 5. The focus on low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where TB burden is highest, ensures the article’s practical relevance to global health priorities.
Weaknesses of the Article
 1. Only one study included qualitative data, which limits understanding of patient and provider perspectives on intervention feasibility.
 2. The predominance of studies from India and South Africa may reduce the applicability of findings to other high-burden regions with different healthcare systems.
 3. Interventions like patient navigators and electronic linkages, which have shown promise in other chronic conditions, are scarcely addressed.
I hope this gives you an idea about my understanding of the article.
paper_title_zh: 成人肺结核患者治疗前失访减少的干预措施及实施考量：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
结核病（TB）是全球主要的死亡原因之一，超过90%的报道病例发生在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）。治疗前失访（PTLFU）是导致结核病死亡和感染传播的关键因素。

目标
我们进行了一项范围综述，以梳理关于减少成人肺结核PTLFU的干预措施的证据，识别现有知识的空白，并开发一个概念框架以指导干预实施。

方法
我们检索了截至2024年2月6日的八个电子数据库、medRxiv上的预印本以及纳入研究的参考文献列表。两名综述作者独立选择研究并使用预先设计的表格提取数据。我们进行了描述性数据分析，以叙述性摘要形式呈现发现，并基于实用、稳健实施和可持续性模型开发了一个概念框架，以映射有效干预实施的因素。

结果
我们审阅了1262条记录，纳入了17项研究。大多数研究为随机对照试验（8/17，47%）。干预障碍包括污名化和资源不足；促进因素包括手机和同日结核病检测及结果。我们确定了八项减少PTLFU的干预措施：治疗支持小组；移动通知；社区卫生工作者；整合的HIV/TB服务；Xpert MTB/RIF作为初始诊断测试；计算机辅助检测结合胸部放射筛查；主动联系关怀；以及多组分策略。

结论
鉴于医疗环境的多样性，结核病项目在采用干预措施前应考虑情境因素，如用户接受度、政治承诺、资源和基础设施。未来研究应采用定性研究设计，以人为中心，并包括影响PTLFU的社会和经济因素。
review_content_zh:
**文章摘要**
标题为“减少成人肺结核治疗前失访的干预措施及实施考虑：一项范围综述”的文章是一篇范围综述，探讨了成人肺结核治疗前失访问题，这是结核病管理中的一个关键问题，加剧了传播和死亡率。作者旨在识别和评估减少PTLFU的干预措施，讨论其实施的障碍和促进因素，并提出一个干预部署的概念框架。

**文章的主要发现**
* **干预措施**：识别了八项干预措施，包括治疗支持小组（TSGs）、移动通知、整合的HIV/TB服务以及使用先进的诊断工具如Xpert MTB/RIF。
* **障碍**：诸如污名化、资源不足和基础设施挑战等问题阻碍了有效实施。
* **促进因素**：移动电话接入、当日TB检测和社区卫生工作者（CHW）的参与成为促进因素。
* **作者基于实用、稳健实施和可持续性模型（PRISM）开发了一个框架，以支持情境敏感的干预实施。**

**文章的优点**
1. 该综述综合了来自多个数据库和多样化研究设计的证据，提供了对可用干预措施的全面视角。
2. 概念框架为政策制定者和医疗保健提供者在特定情境中调整干预措施提供了实用指导。
3. 通过识别这些因素，文章增强了干预措施在实际环境中的实用性。
4. 双重数据提取和遵循PRISMA-ScR指南的使用增强了发现结果的可靠性。
5. 重点关注结核病负担最重的低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），确保了文章对全球健康优先事项的实际相关性。

**文章的缺点**
1. 仅有一项研究包含定性数据，这限制了对于患者和提供者对干预措施可行性的理解。
2. 印度和南非的研究占主导地位，可能降低了发现结果对其他具有不同医疗保健系统的高负担地区的适用性。
3. 如患者导航员和电子链接等在其他慢性病中显示出前景的干预措施，本文鲜有涉及。

希望这能让你了解我对这篇文章的理解。

The predominance of studies from India and South Africa may reduce the applicability of findings to other high-burden regions with different healthcare systems.
Interventions like patient navigators and electronic linkages, which have shown promise in other chronic conditions, are scarcely addressed.
The authors aim to identify and evaluate interventions to reduce PTLFU, discuss barriers and enablers to their implementation, and propose a conceptual framework for intervention deployment.
The authors developed a framework based on the Practical, Robust Implementation, and Sustainability Model (PRISM) to support context-sensitive intervention implementation.
The conceptual framework offers practical guidance for policymakers and healthcare providers in tailoring interventions to specific contexts.
By identifying these factors, the article enhances the utility of interventions in real-world settings.

paper_title: Potential applications of personality assessments to the management of non-human primates: A review of 10 years of study
paper_abstract: Studies of primate personality have become increasingly common over the past three decades. Recently, studies have begun to focus on the health, welfare and conservation implications of personality, and the potential applications of incorporating quantitative personality assessments into animal management programmes. However, this literature is disparate and dispersed across a multitude of settings and scientific disciplines. We conducted a review of nonhuman primate personality studies relevant to these issues published since 2010. The databases ScienceDirect, PubMed and Web of Science were used to identify relevant articles. After eliminating irrelevant or duplicate papers, 68 studies were selected. Our review reveals that, while primate personality research is carried out on a range of species, there is strong taxonomic bias. While 28 species appeared within the reviewed literature, 51% of studies were carried out on just five species. Further, the most common research focus (43%) was validating new assessment methods or describing personality in different species, rather than exploring the links between personality and animal welfare using existing validated methods. However, among the remaining studies that did explore the role of animal personality in husbandry, health, and welfare, we identified increased progression towards integrating personality data into various aspects of animal management. Evidence suggests the assessment of personality may benefit social group management, enrichment practices, training protocols, health and welfare monitoring, and conservation planning for endangered species. We argue that further research which develops our understanding of primate personality and its influence in these areas will provide a valuable tool to inform existing animal management practices.

paper_title_zh: 人格评估在非人类灵长类动物管理中的潜在应用：十年研究综述
paper_abstract_zh: 灵长类动物个性研究在过去三十年中变得越来越普遍。近年来，研究开始关注个性的健康、福利和保育意义，以及将定量个性评估纳入动物管理计划的潜在应用。然而，这一文献分散且跨越了多种环境和科学学科。我们对自2010年以来发表的与这些问题相关的非人类灵长类动物个性研究进行了综述。使用ScienceDirect、PubMed和Web of Science数据库识别相关文章。在排除无关或重复的论文后，共选取了68项研究。我们的综述显示，尽管灵长类动物个性研究涉及多种物种，但存在强烈的分类学偏见。尽管有28种物种出现在综述文献中，但51%的研究仅针对五种物种进行。此外，最常见的 research focus (43%) 是验证新的评估方法或描述不同物种的个性，而不是使用现有验证方法探索个性与动物福利之间的联系。然而，在剩余的探讨动物个性在饲养、健康和福利中作用的研究中，我们发现将个性数据整合到动物管理的各个方面中的进展有所增加。证据表明，个性评估可能有利于社会群体管理、丰富实践、训练协议、健康和福利监测，以及濒危物种的保育规划。我们认为，进一步研究灵长类动物个性及其在这些领域的影响，将为现有的动物管理实践提供宝贵的工具。

J Pers. https://doi.org/10.1111/jopy.12310）对这一领域的综述中已经注意到的区别。具体来说，根据物种的不同，单一因素（社交性）要么负载于社交特质上，要么两个与五大人格因素中的外向性和宜人性相当的因素负载于这些特质上，尽管倭黑猩猩（参见上述2015年论文）显示出不同的配置。我认为作者不需要深入探讨所有细节，因此他们可以简单地提及与社交特质相关的人格因素，然后在引用相关研究时命名不同的因素。回应：感谢这一澄清。我们已按建议重新措辞以避免混淆（LL308-312）。在第374行，作者提到了“方面”，但不清除他们指的是什么。他们是指所谓的因素、领域、维度，例如人类的外向性或其他五大维度之一，还是指较低层次的构念，例如五大人格中的每个方面的“热情”方面或外向性？无论情况如何，作者在此需要保持术语的一致性，或许可以简要定义任何新术语。回应：‘方面’已被替换为‘维度’以保持清晰和一致性。所有其他同义词的引用也已替换为‘维度’，现已在LL56-58中定义。在摘要中，我认为我会删除“广泛”，这是真的，但文本的其他部分已经暗示了这一点。事实上，尽可能多地省略*ly词汇是个好主意。回应：按建议更改。我一直认为“非人类”不应加连字符，因为它不是一个复合词。回应：按建议更改。第42行，我会省略“它被”。回应：按建议更改。第44行，“整合”改为“整合中”。回应：按建议更改，L43。第47行，此处及他处作者使用了因果语言（“预测”），这在研究不是真正的实验时是个问题。我会更谦虚，使用“相关”和“关联”等术语。回应：按建议更改。第55行，作者需要指出这些测量是可靠和经过验证的。在此，我认为作者应该提供来自心理测量学和构念效度文献的定义。1955年Cronbach和Meehl的论文（https://doi.org/10.1037/h0040957）和1959年Campbell和Fiske的论文（https://doi.org/10.1037/h0046016）很好地定义了效度，但许多教科书处理也会很好。可靠性也已被广泛讨论。回应：谢谢，按建议添加。两个术语的定义已包含在引言中（LL60-66）。第58行，我会省略“现有的”。回应：按建议更改，L67。第59行：此处需要“动物”一词吗？回应：按建议更改，L68。第64行：此处“验证”一词有必要吗？回应：按建议更改，L72-73。第82行：我认为“众多”一词是多余的，可以省略。回应：按建议更改，L95。第92行：考虑省略此行。回应：按建议更改，L106。第97行：我会省略“然后”一词。回应：按建议更改，L111。第106行：我会将“具有普遍性”改为“泛化”。此处，一个定义也会很好。回应：按建议更改。‘泛化’一词现已在引言中定义，并添加了关于泛化挑战和复杂性的参考文献（LL87-89）。第149行：我会省略“不同”一词。回应：按建议更改，L165。第173-174行：我会修订文本，使其读作“……每个都有其优缺点”和“我们已概述”。回应：按建议更改，L193。第189行：如果作者能在此处引用一个例子，那也很好。回应：按建议更改，L210-211。第214-216行：此处一些例子会有所帮助。回应：按建议更改，L235-237。第217行：我认为此处可以有一个更好的过渡句。回应：我已调整段落，希望此处有更好的过渡，LL240-242。第241行：请引用提出这一观点的人。回应：按建议更改。引用了Coleman（2012），LL264-266。第250行：我不会提及“类型”，因为人格特质、因素等最好被视为连续体。因此，提及“在……方面较高或较低的个体”。回应：按建议更改，LL273-274。第254行：考虑人类文献显示的内容是否值得？换句话说，这是未来工作的一个有前途的方向吗？回应：LL260-274现在简要纳入了人类文献关于人格和攻击性行为的发现，及其对灵长类动物管理的可能影响。第298-299行：我会在此处及全文使用主动语态。回应：按建议更改。第306行：我会重写这句话，去掉“采取整体方法，即”文本。回应：按建议更改，LL340-342。第326-330行：请缩短或拆分这句话。回应：按建议更改，LL361-364。第334行：我会将其改写为“害羞-大胆连续体”。回应：按建议更改，LL369。第337行：在此，我会力求在使用的标签上保持一致。所以如果之前提到了“害羞-大胆”，就继续使用这个标签。回应：按建议更改，LL371。第351行：作者具体指的是什么“深入”？也就是说，哪些方面需要更深入地研究？回应：重新措辞并在LL387-390中扩展。第358行：我会改写为“自愿参与”。回应：按建议更改，L394。第488-494行：我认为这一部分可以引用一些关于可遗传人格变异是常态的事实，并提供一些机制，这些 paper_title: Resources, challenges and way forward in rare mitochondrial diseases research
paper_abstract: Over 300 million people are affected by about 7000 rare diseases globally. There are tremendous resource limitations and challenges in driving research and drug development for rare diseases. Hence, innovative approaches are needed to identify potential solutions. This review focuses on the resources developed over the past years for analysis of genome data towards understanding disease biology especially in the context of mitochondrial diseases, given that mitochondria are central to major cellular pathways and their dysfunction leads to a broad spectrum of diseases. Platforms for collaboration of research groups, clinicians and patients and the advantages of community collaborative efforts in addressing rare diseases are also discussed. The review also describes crowdsourcing and crowdfunding efforts in rare diseases research and how the upcoming initiatives for understanding disease biology including analyses of large number of genomes are also applicable to rare diseases.
review_content:
This article really serves as a good resource for researchers, clinicians and also patients.

I would suggest the authors to compare the available databases of the mitochondrial research and may provide a better summary.
paper_title_zh: "罕见线粒体疾病研究中的资源、挑战及前进方向"
paper_abstract_zh: 全球约有7000种罕见病影响着超过3亿人。在推动罕见病研究和药物开发方面存在巨大的资源限制和挑战。因此，需要创新方法来识别潜在的解决方案。本综述重点关注近年来为分析基因组数据以理解疾病生物学而开发的资源，特别是在线粒体疾病的背景下，鉴于线粒体是主要细胞通路的核心，其功能障碍会导致广泛的疾病谱。还讨论了研究小组、临床医生和患者合作平台以及社区协作努力在应对罕见病方面的优势。综述还描述了罕见病研究中的众包和众筹努力，以及即将开展的旨在理解疾病生物学的倡议，包括大量基因组的分析，这些也同样适用于罕见病。

paper_title: Coagulase-negative staphylococci as an evolving mastitis causing organism in cows: A review
paper_abstract: The present review attempts to address the emergence of a fast-growing mastitis causing pathogen – coagulase-negative staphylococci (CNS) – and its multi-facet roles in dairy farms. CNS is divided into numerous species, but only a few succeed in bovine mastitis. The two predominant CNS species causing mastitis are Staphylococcus chromogenes and Staphylococcus simulans . These two mostly known CNS affects dairy cows at varied parities and at different lactation stages. CNS have been judged to be the most common bovine mastitis isolate in several countries of the world. However, CNS may not likely be as pathogenic as the other primary mastitis pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus and its infection mostly remains subclinical. Conversely, CNS is capable of triggering persistent infections among dairy herds, resulting in reduced milk quality and high milk somatic cell count (SCC). One negative impact of CNS infection in dairy herds is that it can destroy cow udder tissue, hereby leading to a drop in milk production of dairy cows. CNS mastitis has a high cure rate when treated with anti-biotics as their infection in cows are not known to be a therapeutic problem. Judging from several literatures, it cannot be said whether CNS species act as an ecological or contagious pathogens. Regulator procedures, including pre- and post-milking teat disinfection, may reduce contagious mastitis pathogens of CNS infections in the dairy herd. Phenotypic methods for identification of CNS are not adequately dependable, and molecular techniques of identification may be better substitute for identification. Dairy farmers may benefit greatly from more empirical research on the epidemiology of CNS mastitis and more reliable methods for species identification.
review_content: This is a review article on CNS that seems to have been quite complete at the time it was written, but unfortunately it is not updated. The article cites good references, but the vast majority of them are from 10 or more years ago. Since then, many changes have occurred, both in terms of CNS identification, such as the advent of Maldi-Tof mass spectrometry, and in the protocols for treating livestock with antimicrobials, due to the current great concern with antimicrobial resistance in humans, animals and the environment.
paper_title_zh: 凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌作为奶牛乳腺炎致病菌的演变：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述旨在探讨一种快速增长的乳腺炎致病菌——凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌（CNS）的出现及其在奶牛场中的多方面作用。CNS分为多种物种，但仅有少数能在牛乳腺炎中成功定殖。导致乳腺炎的两个主要CNS物种是产色葡萄球菌和模拟葡萄球菌。这两种广为人知的CNS在不同胎次和不同泌乳阶段的奶牛中均有影响。CNS已被判定为世界上多个国家最常见的牛乳腺炎分离株。然而，CNS可能不如其他主要乳腺炎致病菌（如金黄色葡萄球菌）那样具有致病性，其感染大多呈亚临床状态。相反，CNS能够引发奶牛群中的持续性感染，导致牛奶质量下降和体细胞计数（SCC）升高。CNS感染对奶牛群的负面影响之一是它能破坏奶牛的乳腺组织，从而导致奶牛产奶量下降。使用抗生素治疗CNS乳腺炎时，治愈率较高，因为其在奶牛中的感染并未被视为治疗难题。从多篇文献来看，尚不能确定CNS物种是作为生态性还是接触性致病菌。包括预挤奶和后挤奶乳头消毒在内的监管措施，可能减少奶牛群中CNS感染的接触性乳腺炎致病菌。用于鉴定CNS的表型方法不够可靠，分子鉴定技术可能是更好的替代方法。奶牛养殖者可能从更多关于CNS乳腺炎流行病学的实证研究以及更可靠的物种鉴定方法中获益匪浅。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇关于中枢神经系统（CNS）的综述文章，撰写时似乎相当全面，但遗憾的是未进行更新。文章引用了良好的参考文献，但其中绝大多数是10年或更早以前的。自那时以来，无论是在CNS鉴定方面，如基质辅助激光解吸电离飞行时间质谱（Maldi-Tof mass spectrometry）的出现，还是在因当前对人类、动物和环境中的抗菌药物耐药性的巨大关注而导致的用于治疗牲畜的抗菌药物协议方面，都发生了许多变化。

paper_title: Exploring the anti-inflammatory activities, mechanism of action and prospective drug delivery systems of tocotrienol to target neurodegenerative diseases
paper_abstract: A major cause of death in the elderly worldwide is attributed to neurodegenerative diseases, such as AD (Alzheimer’s disease), PD (Parkinson’s disease), ALS (Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), FRDA (Friedreich’s ataxia), VaD (Vascular dementia) etc. These can be caused due to multiple factors such as genetic, physiological problems like stroke or tumor, or even external causes like viruses, toxins, or chemicals. T3s (tocotrienols) exhibit various bioactive properties where it acts as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-tumorigenic, and cholesterol lowering agent. Since T3 interferes with and influences several anti-inflammatory mechanisms, it aids in combating inflammatory responses that lead to disease progression. T3s are found to have a profound neuroprotective ability, however, due to their poor oral bioavailability, their full potential could not be exploited. Hence there is a need to explore other drug delivery techniques, especially focusing on aspects of nanotechnology. In this review paper we explore the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of T3 to apply it in the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases and also discusses the possibilities of nano methods of administering tocotrienols to target neurodegenerative diseases.

The article, "Exploring the anti-inflammatory activities, mechanism of action and prospective drug delivery systems of tocotrienol to target neurodegenerative diseases" is well-written. The paper is an important addition to the literature.
They can further read various articles on neurodegenerative disorders in recent years relevant to drug delivery.

paper_title_zh: 探索生育三烯酚的抗炎活性、作用机制及其针对神经退行性疾病的潜在药物递送系统
paper_abstract_zh: 全球范围内老年人死亡的主要原因之一是神经退行性疾病，如阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、弗里德reich共济失调（FRDA）、血管性痴呆（VaD）等。这些疾病可由多种因素引起，如遗传因素、生理问题如中风或肿瘤，甚至外部原因如病毒、毒素或化学物质。生育三烯酚（T3s）具有多种生物活性，包括抗氧化、抗炎、抗肿瘤和降胆固醇作用。由于T3干扰并影响多种抗炎机制，它有助于对抗导致疾病进展的炎症反应。研究发现T3s具有显著的神经保护能力，然而，由于其口服生物利用度低，其全部潜力未能得到充分利用。因此，有必要探索其他药物递送技术，特别是关注纳米技术方面。在这篇综述中，我们探讨了T3的抗炎机制，以应用于神经退行性疾病的 treatment，并讨论了利用纳米方法给药生育三烯酚以靶向治疗神经退行性疾病的可能性。

paper_title: Neural Collapse: A Review on Modelling Principles and Generalization
paper_abstract: Deep classifier neural networks enter the terminal phase of training (TPT) when training error reaches zero and tend to exhibit intriguing Neural Collapse (NC) properties. Neural collapse essentially represents a state at which the within-class variability of final hidden layer outputs is infinitesimally small and their class means form a simplex equiangular tight frame. This simplifies the last layer behaviour to that of a nearest-class center decision rule. Despite the simplicity of this state, the dynamics and implications of reaching it are yet to be fully understood. In this work, we review the principles which aid in modelling neural collapse, followed by the implications of this state on generalization and transfer learning capabilities of neural networks. Finally, we conclude by discussing potential avenues and directions for future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This is a review paper on the "neural collapse" (NC) phenomenon in deep neural networks. The authors summarize, compare, and contrast recent work within a unified framework. Implications of NC on generalization and transfer learning are discussed.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: - Well-organized. - The manuscript does what it claims, and summarizes recent work on this topic within a unified framework. I am not an expert in this topic but I found the review relatively easy to follow at a high level. - The unified framework for studying NC was presented in a clear manner. Weaknesses: - I am skeptical about the prevalence of these neural collapse phenomena and their purported benefits. While the manuscript cites many recent papers to support these claims, I found myself wishing that there was a clear explanation for what exactly has been shown by this body of work, and why we should take it seriously. This review focuses more on summarizing the methods used for studying the phenomenon. - The discussion of NC on generalization and transfer learning didn't seem to have much substance. Defining the terminal phase of training (TPT) as beginning when classification error (01-loss) reaches zero appears to be a useful shorthand, but this is not based on anything fundamental since these models are trained to minimize a different objective (i.e. cross-entropy loss). So why is it important to define "weak and strong test-collapse" for generalization and transfer learning scenarios? I couldn't see how this was useful.

**Requested Changes:**
Some minor issues: - In Introduction, what are "complexity based learning techniques"? - In Section 2.1, I believe there is a typo where ||(r,s)||_E should be ||(r,s)||_F

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Answer to Review of Paper758 by Reviewer 64hA #1: We are thankful to the reviewer for their constructive feedback regarding our manuscript. **Reviewer:** I am skeptical about the prevalence of these neural collapse phenomena and their purported benefits. While the manuscript cites many recent papers to support these claims, I found myself wishing that there was a clear explanation for what exactly has been shown by this body of work, and why we should take it seriously. This review focuses more on summarizing the methods used for studying the phenomenon. **Answer:** We have addressed this point by adding the relevant observations and key takeaways in Section 3.3 and Section 5 of the updated manuscript (changes marked in blue). On a brief note, please note that an extensive theoretical analysis of the global minimizers for cross-entropy loss from an NC perspective by Wojtowytsch et al. (2020); Lu & Steinerberger (2020) highlighted the difference in the expressive power of shallow and deep neural networks (since our paper primarily focuses on the modelling techniques and implications of NC on generalization/TL, we omit the in-depth analysis for brevity). Additionally, the work by Han et al. (2021) decomposes the MSE loss based on the gradient flow trajectory of features aligned with NC properties and demonstrated this behaviour for canonical deep classifier networks. Thus, shedding light on their training dynamics. Additionally, Zhu et al. (2021) leverage the simplex ETF property (NC2) and show ~ 20% reduction in the memory footprint of training ResNet18 on MNIST and ~ 52% reduction in the number of trainable parameters of ShuffleNet for ImageNet with 1000 classes. On a related note, Fang et al. (2021); Yang et al. (2022) propose solutions to address class imbalance training by analysing the collapse properties of under-represented classes. In summary, the studies pertaining to neural collapse have presented a unique approach to questioning and understanding the heuristic design choices and training dynamics involved in deep network training. **Reviewer:** The discussion of NC on generalization and transfer learning didn't seem to have much substance. Defining the terminal phase of training (TPT) as beginning when classification error (01-loss) reaches zero appears to be a useful shorthand, but this is not based on anything fundamental since these models are trained to minimize a different objective (i.e. cross-entropy loss). So why is it important to define "weak and strong test-collapse" for generalization and transfer learning scenarios? I couldn't see how this was useful. **Answer:** Although the models are trained to minimize objectives such as cross-entropy/MSE loss, the terminal phase of training (TPT) is of particular importance as it represents a regime where the network has interpolated on the training data and thus achieves zero-training error. Due to recent works which highlight the benign effects of interpolating on the training data with over-parameterized networks (for ex: Ma et al., 2018), and the initial work on NC by Papyan et al 2020 which shows NC metrics tending to 0 in this phase, the TPT is of particular interest. The notion of weak and strong test collapse was presented based on the work of Hui et al 2022. The purpose of presenting these metrics is to highlight the potential shortcomings of expecting NC1-4 values on test data to resemble that of the training regime. Additionally, since the generalization and transfer learning bounds depend on CDNV and not on weak/strong test collapse, we have modified our presentation of these two metrics to focus mainly on the idea. Furthermore, we have refined the presentation of Section 4 to convey the key ideas and assumptions behind the generalization and transfer learning bounds. Although the literature on this line of work is limited, we have presented connections with the work of Cohen et al 2018 on the role of random labels/noisy datasets on the effective depth and in section 4.3 briefly discussed the transfer learning bound and it's theoretical limitations in explaining empirical results of Kornblith et al 2021. **Reviewer:** In the Introduction, what are "complexity based learning techniques"? **Answer:** This was an error in the choice of words and has now been fixed. **Reviewer:** In Section 2.1, I believe there is a typo where ||(r,s)||_E should be ||(r,s)||_F **Answer:** We have adopted this notation from Mixon et al 2020, which indicates ||(r,s)||_E^2 = ||r||_F^2 + ||r||_F^2 and aids in simplifying the notation for the (r, s) tuple during gradient flow.
paper_title_zh: 神经坍缩：建模原理与泛化性能综述
paper_abstract_zh: 深度分类神经网络在训练误差达到零时进入训练的终端阶段（TPT），并倾向于表现出有趣的神经坍缩（NC）特性。神经坍缩本质上代表一种状态，即最终隐藏层输出的类内变异性极小，且其类均值形成一个等角紧框架的单纯形。这使得最后一层的行为简化为最近类中心决策规则。尽管这种状态简单，但达到该状态的动态过程及其影响尚未完全理解。在本研究中，我们回顾了有助于建模神经坍缩的原理，随后探讨了这种状态对神经网络泛化能力和迁移学习能力的影响。最后，我们通过讨论未来研究的潜在途径和方向来总结全文。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这是一篇关于深度神经网络中“神经坍缩”（NC）现象的综述文章。作者在统一框架内总结、比较和对比了近期的工作。讨论了NC对泛化和迁移学习的影响。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：- 组织良好。- 手稿如其所述，在统一框架内总结了该主题的近期工作。我不是这个领域的专家，但我觉得这篇综述在较高层面上相对容易理解。- 研究NC的统一框架表述清晰。
缺点：- 我对神经坍缩现象的普遍性和其所谓的好处的怀疑。虽然手稿引用了许多近期论文来支持这些观点，但我希望有一个清晰的解释，说明这一系列工作究竟展示了什么，以及为什么我们应该认真对待它。这篇综述更多地关注于总结研究该现象的方法。- 关于NC对泛化和迁移学习的讨论似乎没有太多实质内容。将训练的终端阶段（TPT）定义为分类误差（01损失）达到零时开始，这似乎是一个有用的简写，但这并非基于任何根本性因素，因为这些模型是训练来最小化不同的目标（即交叉熵损失）。那么，为什么定义“弱和强测试坍缩”对泛化和迁移学习场景很重要？我看不出这有什么用。

**请求的修改：**
一些小问题：- 在引言中，“基于复杂度的学习技术”是什么？- 在第2.1节中，我认为||(r,s)||_E应该是一个打字错误，应为||(r,s)||_F。

**声明和证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
对Reviewer 64hA关于Paper758的评审意见的回复#1：我们感谢评审者对我们手稿的建设性反馈。
**评审者：** 我对神经坍缩现象的普遍性和其所谓的好处的怀疑。虽然手稿引用了许多近期论文来支持这些观点，但我希望有一个清晰的解释，说明这一系列工作究竟展示了什么，以及为什么我们应该认真对待它。这篇综述更多地关注于总结研究该现象的方法。
**回复：** 我们通过在更新后的手稿的第3.3节和第5节中添加相关观察和关键要点来回应这一点（更改部分以蓝色标记）。简要说明，请注意，Wojtowytsch等人（2020年）；Lu & Steinerberger（2020年）从NC角度对交叉熵损失的全局最小值进行了广泛的理论分析，强调了浅层和深层神经网络的表示能力的差异（由于我们的论文主要关注建模技术和NC对泛化/TL的影响，我们省略了深入分析以保持简洁）。此外，Han等人（2021年）基于与NC属性对齐的特征的梯度流轨迹分解了MSE损失，并展示了典型深层分类网络的这种行为，从而揭示了它们的训练动态。此外，Zhu等人（2021年）利用单纯形ETF属性（NC2），展示了在MNIST上训练ResNet18的内存占用减少了约20%，在ImageNet上训练ShuffleNet的可训练参数减少了约52%。相关地，Fang等人（2021年）；Yang等人（2022年）通过分析代表性不足类别的坍缩属性，提出了解决类别不平衡训练的解决方案。总之，关于神经坍缩的研究呈现了一种独特的方法，质疑并理解深度网络训练中涉及的启发式设计选择和训练动态。
**评审者：** 关于NC对泛化和迁移学习的讨论似乎没有太多实质内容。将训练的终端阶段（TPT）定义为分类误差（01损失）达到零时开始，这似乎是一个有用的简写，但这并非基于任何根本性因素，因为这些模型是训练来最小化不同的目标（即交叉熵损失）。那么，为什么定义“弱和强测试坍缩”对泛化和迁移学习场景很重要？我看不出这有什么用。
**回复：** 尽管模型是训练来最小化如交叉熵/MSE损失的目标，但训练的终端阶段（TPT）特别重要，因为它代表了一个网络在训练数据上插值并因此实现零训练误差的区间。由于近期工作强调了在过参数化网络上对训练数据进行插值的良性效果（例如：Ma等人，2018年），以及Papyan等人2020年关于NC的初始工作显示NC指标在此阶段趋于0，TPT特别值得关注。弱和强测试坍缩的概念是基于Hui等人2022年的工作提出的。提出这些指标的目的是强调期望测试数据上的NC1-4值与训练区间相似的可能不足之处。此外，由于泛化和迁移学习界限取决于CDNV而非弱/强测试坍缩，我们已修改了对这两个指标的表述，主要关注这一思想。此外，我们已精简了第4节的表述，以传达泛化和迁移学习界限背后的关键思想和假设。尽管这一领域的文献有限，我们已展示了与Cohen等人2018年关于随机标签/噪声数据集对有效深度影响的工作的联系，并在第4.3节简要讨论了迁移学习界限及其在解释Kornblith等人2021年实证结果的理论局限性。
**评审者：** 在引言中，“基于复杂度的学习技术”是什么？
**回复：** 这是用词上的错误，现已修正。
**评审者：** 在第2.1节中，我认为||(r,s)||_E应该是一个打字错误，应为||(r,s)||_F。
**回复：** 我们采用了Mixon等人2020年的这一符号，表示||(r,s)||_E^2 = ||r||_F^2 + ||r||_F^2，有助于在梯度流中简化(r, s)元组的符号。

paper_title: A technical review and guide to RNA fluorescence in situ hybridization
paper_abstract: RNA-fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is a powerful tool to visualize target mRNA transcripts in cultured cells, tissue sections or whole-mount preparations. As the technique has been developed over time, an ever-increasing number of divergent protocols have been published. There is now a broad selection of options available to facilitate proper tissue preparation, hybridization, and post-hybridization background removal to achieve optimal results. Here we review the technical aspects of RNA-FISH, examining the most common methods associated with different sample types including cytological preparations and whole-mounts. We discuss the application of commonly used reagents for tissue preparation, hybridization, and post-hybridization washing and provide explanations of the functional roles for each reagent. We also discuss the available probe types and necessary controls to accurately visualize gene expression. Finally, we review the most recent advances in FISH technology that facilitate both highly multiplexed experiments and signal amplification for individual targets. Taken together, this information will guide the methods development process for investigators that seek to perform FISH in organisms that lack documented or optimized protocols.
review_content: Reviewer 2: (Anonymous) (1) The manuscript lacks a summary or conclusion part. A review article should not merely be a collection of previously published papers. As required by PeerJ, a Literature Review should have a conclusion part identifying unresolved questions/gaps/future directions about the field (https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/#literature-review-sections). In this part, the authors may summarize their review of the technical aspects of RNA FISH and provide their view on the future development of the FISH technique. This will help the readers quickly understand the main points of the paper. In line with this feedback, we have added a conclusions section to the manuscript to summarize the main points of the paper and improve the flow of the paper. (2) The manuscript fails to include the recent development of the RNA-FISH technique. As a promising technique for RNA labeling and imaging, RNA-FISH has been improved in different ways to increase the throughput (e.g., Eng et al., Nature, 2019; Shah et al., Cell, 2018) and signal level (e.g., Marras et al., PNAS, 2019; Choi et al., Development, 2018). These new versions of RNA-FISH may point to the future direction of the field. Without mentioning these recent advances and discussing their technical aspects, the manuscript looks a bit outdated. Hence, the authors should include these new versions of RNA-FISH technique in their paper. We have included a new section on recent developments in RNA FISH. We now discuss the methodology underpinning each of the references you have mentioned and added a brief discussion on data acquisition and analysis. (3) In some places of the paper, the same content has been reviewed twice, which is not necessary. For example, in “The development of RNA-FISH and smFISH” part, the first paragraph reviews the development of different RNA-FISH methods, while the second paragraph more reviews explicitly the development of different FISH probes. However, since the main difference between various RNA-FISH methods is their probes, the contents of the two paragraphs are highly overlapping. The authors should combine the two paragraphs and review the history of different RNA-FISH methods based on the development of different types of probes. We agree that the organization of this section led to some repetition. The entire section has been restructured to be more concise and review the history of RNA-FISH protocols with respect to the development of different probes. (4) In the last paragraph of the “Hybridization” part, where the authors discuss the hybridization conditions, the statement “three parameters regarding hybridization: salt concentration; hybridization temperature; and duration of hybridization” is not complete, as the pH value of the hybridization buffer is also an important parameter to affect the stringency of the hybridization (Choi et al., Development, 2016; Mannheim, Biochemicals Catalog, 1992). The authors should discuss how pH value affects hybridization in their paper. We agree that it is important to control pH throughout hybridization to maintain stability of the hybrid. We now mention in the hybridization section that it is important to maintain a pH of roughly 7.0 – 8.5. As we could not identify any protocols that use a hybridization solution with a pH outside of this range (and indeed we assume that most users would be operating within this range), we did not further explain the effect of pH on the ionization of RNA or DNA molecules. Minor points: (5) Figure caption is missing for Figure 1. Although Figure 1 is a simple figure, it has only been cited once in the main text (line 83) without a detailed description. A caption is therefore required to help explain the whole figure. For example, the term “Chromogenic ISH” only appears in Figure 1, but not in the main text. Without a figure caption, it is hard to understand what the term means. We agree that Figure 1 could benefit from a more detailed description. We have added a caption for this figure. (6) In lines 83 and 415, “(Figure 1)” and “(Figure 2)” should be “(Fig. 1)” and “(Fig. 2)”, respectively, according to the Instructions for Authors (https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/#figures). All instances of “Figure” have been updated to “Fig.”. (7) In Tables 1 and 3, the temperature of each step is not listed. The temperatures of each step has been included, and it is now mentioned in the table legends that where temperatures are not listed, the steps were performed at room temperature. (8) In line 81, the subtitle “the development of RNA-FISH and smFISH” is not correct, as smFISH is a specific type of RNA-FISH. The authors may modify the subtitle to “the development of RNA-FISH”. This subtitle has been updated as recommended. (9) In the last row of table 3, except for the first column, the duration of the final wash is missing. Durations for initial and final washes have been added to table 3. For some protocols, the wash duration was not reported, this is now reflected in the table legend. (10) There are some language issues in the manuscript. Here are a few examples. The authors will have to make sure all such errors are corrected. • In line 293, “…is used protect RNA-based probes” should be “…is used to protect RNA-based probes”. • On the last page, “Table 3. Table 2. Representative panel of fluorescence…” should be “Table 3. Representative panel of fluorescence …”. The noted typographical errors (and hopefully all others in the manuscript) have been addressed.
paper_title_zh: RNA荧光原位杂交技术综述与指南
paper_abstract_zh: RNA-荧光原位杂交（FISH）是一种强大的工具，用于在培养细胞、组织切片或整体制备中可视化目标mRNA转录本。随着该技术的不断发展，已发表了越来越多的不同协议。目前，已有广泛的选择方案来促进适当的组织制备、杂交和杂交后背景去除，以获得最佳结果。本文综述了RNA-FISH的技术方面，考察了与不同样本类型（包括细胞学制备和整体制备）相关的最常见方法。我们讨论了常用试剂在组织制备、杂交和杂交后洗涤中的应用，并解释了每种试剂的功能作用。我们还讨论了可用的探针类型和必要的对照，以准确可视化基因表达。最后，我们回顾了FISH技术的最新进展，这些进展促进了高度多重实验和单个目标的信号放大。综合来看，这些信息将为那些希望在缺乏文献记载或优化协议的有机体中进行FISH研究的调查人员提供方法开发指导。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2：（匿名）
(1) 手稿缺少总结或结论部分。综述文章不应仅仅是已发表文章的集合。根据PeerJ的要求，文献综述应包含一个结论部分，以识别该领域未解决的问题/差距/未来方向（https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/#literature-review-sections）。在这一部分，作者可以总结他们对RNA FISH技术方面的回顾，并提供他们对FISH技术未来发展的看法。这将帮助读者快速理解文章的主要观点。根据这一反馈，我们已在手稿中添加了结论部分，以总结文章的主要观点并改善文章的流畅性。
(2) 手稿未能包括RNA-FISH技术的最新发展。作为一种有前景的RNA标记和成像技术，RNA-FISH已在不同方面得到改进，以提高通量（例如，Eng等人，Nature，2019；Shah等人，Cell，2018）和信号水平（例如，Marras等人，PNAS，2019；Choi等人，Development，2018）。这些新的RNA-FISH版本可能指明了该领域的未来方向。如果不提及这些最新进展并讨论其技术方面，手稿看起来有些过时。因此，作者应在他们的文章中包括这些新的RNA-FISH技术版本。我们已添加了一个关于RNA FISH最新发展的新部分。我们现在讨论了您提到的每一篇参考文献的方法论，并添加了关于数据采集和分析的简要讨论。
(3) 在文章的某些地方，相同的内容被重复回顾，这是不必要的。例如，在“RNA-FISH和smFISH的发展”部分，第一段回顾了不同RNA-FISH方法的发展，而第二段更明确地回顾了不同FISH探针的发展。然而，由于不同RNA-FISH方法的主要区别在于它们的探针，这两段的内容高度重叠。作者应将这两段合并，并根据不同类型探针的发展回顾不同RNA-FISH方法的历史。我们同意这一部分的组织导致了某些重复。整个部分已重新结构，以更简洁地回顾RNA-FISH协议的历史，并考虑到不同探针的发展。
(4) 在“杂交”部分的最后一段，作者讨论了杂交条件，其中“关于杂交的三个参数：盐浓度；杂交温度；和杂交持续时间”的陈述不完整，因为杂交缓冲液的pH值也是一个影响杂交严格性的重要参数（Choi等人，Development，2016；Mannheim，Biochemicals Catalog，1992）。作者应在他们的文章中讨论pH值如何影响杂交。我们同意在整个杂交过程中控制pH值以保持杂种的稳定性是很重要的。我们现在在杂交部分提到，保持大约7.0 – 8.5的pH值是很重要的。由于我们无法识别出使用该范围外pH值的杂交溶液的任何协议（而且我们确实假设大多数用户会在这一范围内操作），我们没有进一步解释pH值对RNA或DNA分子离子化的影响。
次要问题：
(5) 图1缺少图注。尽管图1是一个简单的图，但它在正文中仅被引用了一次（第83行），没有详细描述。因此需要图注来帮助解释整个图。例如，“染色ISH”这一术语仅在图1中出现，而在正文中没有出现。没有图注，很难理解该术语的含义。我们同意图1可以从更详细的描述中受益。我们已为该图添加了图注。
(6) 在第83行和第415行，“(Figure 1)”和“(Figure 2)”应分别为“(Fig. 1)”和“(Fig. 2)”，根据作者指南（https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/#figures）。所有“Figure”实例已更新为“Fig.”。
(7) 在表1和表3中，每个步骤的温度未列出。每个步骤的温度已包括在内，并且现在在表注中提到，未列出温度的步骤是在室温下进行的。
(8) 在第81行，副标题“RNA-FISH和smFISH的发展”不正确，因为smFISH是RNA-FISH的一种特定类型。作者可以修改副标题为“RNA-FISH的发展”。该副标题已按建议更新。
(9) 在表3的最后一行，除第一列外，最终洗涤的持续时间缺失。已将初始和最终洗涤的持续时间添加到表3中。对于某些协议，未报告洗涤持续时间，这现在在表注中有所反映。
(10) 手稿中存在一些语言问题。这里有几个例子。作者必须确保所有此类错误都已纠正。
• 在第293行，“…is used protect RNA-based probes”应为“…is used to protect RNA-based probes”。
• 在最后一页，“Table 3. Table 2. Representative panel of fluorescence…”应为“Table 3. Representative panel of fluorescence …”。所提到的排版错误（以及希望手稿中的所有其他错误）已得到解决。

paper_title: COVID-19 lockdown and lifestyles: A narrative review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 The primary objective worldwide during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic had been controlling disease transmission. However, lockdown measures used to mitigate transmission affected human behavior and altered lifestyles, with a likely impact on chronic non-communicable diseases. More than a year into the pandemic, substantial peer-reviewed literature emerged on altered lifestyles following the varying lockdown measures imposed globally to control the virus spread. We explored the impact of lockdown measures on six lifestyle factors, namely diet, physical activity, sleep, stress, social connectedness, and the use of tobacco, alcohol, or other harmful substances. 
 
 
 Methods 
 We comprehensively searched PubMed and the World Health Organization’s global literature database on COVID-19 and retrieved 649 relevant articles for the narrative review. A critical interpretative synthesis of the articles was performed. 
 
 
 Results 
 Most of the articles included in the review identified the negative effect of lockdown measures on each of the lifestyle factors in many parts of the world. Encouraging lifestyle trends were also highlighted in a few articles. Such trends can positively influence the outcome of lifestyle-related chronic diseases, such as obesity and diabetes. 
 
 
 Conclusions 
 The lockdown associated with COVID-19 has largely had a negative impact on the lifestyles of individuals and communities across many countries and cultures. However, some individuals and communities also initiated positive lifestyle-related behavioral changes. If the knowledge generated by studying the impact of COVID-19-related lockdowns on the six lifestyle factors is further consolidated, it could improve chronic disease outcomes. This will help better understand lifestyle behaviors amidst crises and assist in redesigning extreme public health measures such as lockdowns.. It is up to governments, communities, and healthcare/academic entities to derive benefit from lessons learned from the pandemic, with the ultimate objective of better educating and promoting healthy lifestyles among communities.
review_content:
This narrative review focuses on the impact of COVID-19 lockdown on six lifestyle factors: diet, physical activity, sleep, stress, social connectedness, and the use of tobacco, alcohol, or other harmful substances. The authors collected a significant number of articles, closely related to the title and the aim.

I consider the description of the methodology for including articles in the review to be sufficiently described.

I have one major comment:
  * In the subsection Dietary habits, the authors also took into account the results concerning changes in body weight, which are a result / consequence of nutrition but not a lifestyle factor. In my opinion, this subsection requires modification and showing changes in dietary habits. Conclusions should take into account changes in body weight, which were also mainly conditioned by decreased activity.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19封锁与生活方式：叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
在2019年冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行期间，全球的主要目标是控制疾病传播。然而，为减缓传播而采取的封锁措施影响了人类行为，改变了生活方式，可能对慢性非传染性疾病产生影响。大流行一年多后，大量经过同行评审的文献涌现，探讨了全球为控制病毒传播而实施的多样化封锁措施后生活方式的变化。我们探讨了封锁措施对六个生活方式因素的影响，即饮食、体力活动、睡眠、压力、社会联系以及烟草、酒精或其他有害物质的使用。

方法
我们全面检索了PubMed和世界卫生组织的COVID-19全球文献数据库，并检索到649篇相关文章用于叙述性综述。对文章进行了关键的诠释性综合分析。

结果
综述中包含的大部分文章识别了封锁措施对世界各地多个生活方式因素的负面影响。也有少数文章强调了积极的生活趋势。这些趋势可以正面影响与生活方式相关的慢性疾病结果，如肥胖和糖尿病。

结论
与COVID-19相关的封锁在很大程度上对许多国家和文化中的个人和社区的生活方式产生了负面影响。然而，一些个人和社区也开始了积极的生活方式相关行为改变。如果进一步巩固通过研究COVID-19相关封锁对六个生活方式因素影响所获得的知识，可能会改善慢性疾病结果。这将有助于更好地理解危机中的生活方式行为，并协助重新设计如封锁等极端公共卫生措施。政府、社区和医疗/学术机构应从大流行中吸取教训，最终目标是更好地教育和促进社区中的健康生活方式。
review_content_zh:
本叙述性综述重点关注COVID-19封锁对六个生活方式因素的影响：饮食、身体活动、睡眠、压力、社会联系以及烟草、酒精或其他有害物质的使用。作者收集了大量与标题和目标密切相关的研究文章。

我认为关于纳入综述文章的方法论的描述是足够详细的。

我有一个主要意见：
* 在“饮食习惯”子节中，作者还考虑了有关体重变化的结果，这些结果是营养的结果/后果，但并非生活方式因素。在我看来，这一子节需要修改，以展示饮食习惯的变化。结论应考虑体重变化，这些变化也主要由活动减少所导致。
