paper_title: Data publication consensus and controversies
paper_abstract: The movement to bring datasets into the scholarly record as first class research products (validated, preserved, cited, and credited) has been inching forward for some time, but now the pace is quickening. As data publication venues proliferate, significant debate continues over formats, processes, and terminology. Here, we present an overview of data publication initiatives underway and the current conversation, highlighting points of consensus and issues still in contention. Data publication implementations differ in a variety of factors, including the kind of documentation, the location of the documentation relative to the data, and how the data is validated. Publishers may present data as supplemental material to a journal article, with a descriptive “data paper,” or independently. Complicating the situation, different initiatives and communities use the same terms to refer to distinct but overlapping concepts. For instance, the term published means that the data is publicly available and citable to virtually everyone, but it may or may not imply that the data has been peer-reviewed. In turn, what is meant by data peer review is far from defined; standards and processes encompass the full range employed in reviewing the literature, plus some novel variations. Basic data citation is a point of consensus, but the general agreement on the core elements of a dataset citation frays if the data is dynamic or part of a larger set. Even as data publication is being defined, some are looking past publication to other metaphors, notably “data as software,” for solutions to the more stubborn problems.
review_content:
The article focuses on a topic that receives a lot of interest these days. Therefore it is very timely. The article provides a useful and valuable overview of the current state of affairs and the ongoing debate. The title does justice to the content of the article. So does the abstract.

This is the second version of the article. I do not see many changes in the text based on the earlier critical comments made by Mark Parsons and Peter Fox.

The overview is very informative for everyone who needs a quick introduction into the subject. I do miss the opinion of the authors themselves on the issues at hand and on the quoted suggestions by others. This would have been appropriate in a concluding paragraph.

Detailed comments:
 1. In the Introduction I miss a clear link between data publishing and data citation and creating the possibility for researchers to receive academic credits for their work on data. This academic credit is crucial as an incentive for researchers to put valuable time and effort in sharing their data.
 2. In the paragraph Why publish data? a reference to the Dutch fraud cases might be useful, as these cases got a lot of international attention and more or less triggered the discussion in the Netherlands with respect to research data management, long term preservation of data and data publishing and citation. A reference could be:

    Doorn P, Dillo I, van Horik R: Lies, Damned Lies and Research Data: Can Data Sharing Prevent Data Fraud? International Journal of Digital Curation. 2013; 8(1): 229-243 http://dx.doi.org/10.2218/ijdc.v8i1.256
 3. In the paragraph Types of data publication a threefold model is introduced to categorize data publications. It is not clear how this model relates to the terminology and categorisation presented in the introduction. This could be somewhat confusing for the reader.

    Furthermore, there are of course many other models available, e.g. that of the The Data Publication Pyramid, developed on the basis of the Jim Gray pyramid, to express the different manifestation forms that research data can have in the publication process:

    Reilly S, Schallier W, Schrimpf S, et al.: Report on integration of data and publications. October 2011. Located at: http://www.stm-assoc.org/2011_12_5_ODE_Report_On_Integration_of_Data_and_Publications.pdf

    Or the model presented in the report: Costas, R., Meijer, I., Zahedi, Z. and Wouters, P. (2013). The Value of Research Data - Metrics for datasets from a cultural and technical point of view. A Knowledge Exchange Report, available from www.knowledge-exchange.info/datametrics
 4. With respect to trustworthy digital repositories, I would like to add a few comments. First of all, in Europe a European Framework for Audit and Certification of Digital Repositories is emerging. It contains three certification standards (DSA, DIN31644/NESTOR seal and ISO13636) and three levels of certification (basic, extended and formal) see: http://www.trusteddigitalrepository.eu/Site/Trusted%20Digital%20Repository.html

    Of these three standards, only DSA has been up and running for some time now ,with 31 seals awarded and 30 ongoing self-assessments at this moment. The NESTOR seal has become available only very recently and the ISO standard is not yet officially available. The accompanying ISO 16919 standard: Requirements for bodies providing audit and certification of candidate trustworthy digital repositories, has been published very recently and now the ISO organization needs to be set up in the different countries, including the training of national auditors. The audits done by CRL are not fully official, since CRL is no formal ISO accreditation body.

    In Europe we see a growing interest in TDRs, coming from funders who want to push open data and data sharing and demand the deposit of publicly funded data in long term TDRs. Furthermore European research infrastructures and projects are also looking more and more into the issue of trust hen it comes to data sharing and a groeing number of them is incorporating (parts of) the DSA guidelines into there repositories and policies (e.g. CESSDA, CLARIN, EUDAT).

    Yet another certification procedure is offered by the ICSU/WDS to repositories that aim to become a member of the World Data System. See: https://www.icsu-wds.org/community/membership/certification

    The certification of TDRs could also help publishers/editorial boards with Data Availability Policies to point their authors to the right repositories for the long-term storage of their data.
paper_title_zh: 数据发布共识与争议
paper_abstract_zh: 将数据集作为一等研究产品（经过验证、保存、引用和认可）纳入学术记录的运动已经逐步推进了一段时间，但现在步伐正在加快。随着数据发布平台的增多，关于格式、流程和术语的显著争议仍在继续。在此，我们概述了正在进行的数据发布倡议和当前的讨论，突出了共识点和仍存在争议的问题。数据发布实施在多种因素上存在差异，包括文档的类型、文档相对于数据的位置以及数据的验证方式。出版商可能会将数据作为期刊文章的补充材料呈现，附有描述性的“数据论文”，或独立发布。使情况复杂的是，不同的倡议和社区使用相同的术语来指代不同但重叠的概念。例如，“已发布”一词意味着数据对几乎所有人公开并可引用，但可能并不意味着数据已经经过同行评审。反过来，数据同行评审的含义远未明确；标准和流程涵盖了用于评审文献的全部范围，外加一些新颖的变体。基本的数据引用是一个共识点，但如果数据是动态的或属于更大的数据集，对数据集引用核心要素的普遍共识就会破裂。即使在数据发布正在被定义的同时，一些人已经在寻找超越发布的其他隐喻，尤其是“数据即软件”，以解决更为顽固的问题。
review_content_zh:
文章聚焦于当前备受关注的话题，因此具有很强的时效性。文章提供了对当前状况和持续讨论的有用且宝贵的概述。标题恰如其分地反映了文章内容，摘要亦是如此。

这是文章的第二个版本。基于马克·帕森斯和彼得·福克斯之前的批评意见，我没有看到文本中有太多变化。

该概述对于需要快速了解该主题的人来说非常有信息量。但我确实缺少作者本人对所涉问题及引用他人建议的看法。在结论段落中加入这些内容是恰当的。

详细评论：
1. 在引言中，我缺少数据发布与数据引用之间以及为研究人员因其在数据上的工作获得学术credit之间明确联系的阐述。这种学术credit作为激励研究人员投入宝贵时间和精力分享数据的因素至关重要。
2. 在“为何发布数据？”段落中，引用荷兰欺诈案例可能是有用的，因为这些案例引起了大量国际关注，并在某种程度上触发了荷兰关于研究数据管理、数据长期保存以及数据发布和引用的讨论。可引用如下文献：

   Doorn P, Dillo I, van Horik R: Lies, Damned Lies and Research Data: Can Data Sharing Prevent Data Fraud? International Journal of Digital Curation. 2013; 8(1): 229-243 http://dx.doi.org/10.2218/ijdc.v8i1.256
3. 在“数据发布类型”段落中，引入了一个三重模型来分类数据发布。该模型与引言中呈现的术语和分类之间的关系并不明确，这可能会让读者感到困惑。

   此外，当然还有许多其他模型可用，例如基于吉姆·格雷金字塔开发的“数据发布金字塔”模型，用以表达研究数据在发布过程中可能具有的不同表现形态：

   Reilly S, Schallier W, Schrimpf S, et al.: Report on integration of data and publications. October 2011. Located at: http://www_stm-assoc.org/2011_12_5_ODE_Report_On_Integration_of_Data_and_Publications.pdf

   或者在报告中呈现的模型：Costas, R., Meijer, I., Zahedi, Z. and Wouters, P. (2013). The Value of Research Data - Metrics for datasets from a cultural and technical point of view. A Knowledge Exchange Report, available from www.knowledge-exchange.info/datametrics
4. 关于可信数字仓储，我想补充几点评论。首先，在欧洲，一个欧洲数字仓储审计和认证框架正在形成。它包含三个认证标准（DSA、DIN31644/NESTOR seal和ISO13636）和三个认证级别（基础、扩展和正式），参见：http://www.trusteddigitalrepository.eu/Site/Trusted%20Digital%20Repository.html

   在这三个标准中，只有DSA已经运行一段时间，目前已有31个认证颁发和30个正在进行中的自我评估。NESTOR seal最近才可用，而ISO标准尚未正式发布。伴随的ISO 16919标准：“候选可信数字仓储审计和认证机构的要求”最近才发布，现在ISO组织需要在各国设立，包括培训国家审计员。CRL进行的审计并不完全正式，因为CRL不是正式的ISO认证机构。

   在欧洲，我们看到对TDRs的兴趣日益增长，这来自资助者推动开放数据和数据共享，并要求将公共资助的数据存放在长期TDRs中。此外，欧洲的研究基础设施和项目在数据共享的信任问题上也越来越多地关注，并且越来越多的机构将（部分）DSA指南纳入其仓储和政策中（例如CESSDA、CLARIN、EUDAT）。

   另一个认证程序由ICSU/WDS提供给希望成为世界数据系统成员的仓储。参见：https://www.icsu-wds.org/community/membership/certification

   TDRs的认证也可以帮助出版商/编辑委员会在数据可用性政策方面，指导作者将数据长期存储在合适的仓储中。

paper_title: Military-specific application of nutritional supplements: a brief overview
paper_abstract: The Soldiers of America's military endure numerous physical and mental challenges that demand strict physical fitness regimens, extreme mental agility, and a perpetual readiness to deploy at a moment's notice. The chronicity of these stressors has the potential to dramatically reduce performance - both directly and indirectly.  Because of this risk, many Soldiers turn to nutritional supplements with hopes of optimizing performance. Increasing amounts of research have demonstrated that various supplements may enhance overall physical prowess, health, and offer quicker recovery in the face of corporal or psychological extremes. Most individuals, including many medical and nutrition professionals, possess only an elementary comprehension of nutritional supplements and their effect on Soldiers in training or combat environments. Nevertheless, a grasp of these details is required for safety and optimal benefits. Various compounds have been evaluated - to include evidence within the military setting - and found to augment endurance, increase cognitive function, decrease knee pain, or offer hearing or lung protection in the face of high-energy impulses. These efficacious outcomes may serve to augment the health and longevity of these Soldiers; however, continued research is needed for efficacy and long-term safety within specific environments.
review_content: I applaud the authors for their efforts on this paper. The topic is extremely important, and the information is accurate and well written. I only wish they had delved deeper into the related literature as there are many other studies on the supplements they reviewed as well as a vast array of nutritional supplements that have the potential to improve military readiness and/or performance. That said, both of these limitations have been acknowledged by the authors. I encourage them to publish several "follow up" papers to address them.
paper_title_zh: 军事特定应用的营养补充剂：简要概述
paper_abstract_zh: 美国军人的士兵们承受着众多身体和心理上的挑战，这些挑战要求他们保持严格的体能训练、极高的心理敏捷性以及随时待命部署的能力。这些压力的长期性有可能显著降低士兵的表现——无论是直接影响还是间接影响。由于这种风险，许多士兵转向营养补充剂，希望借此优化表现。越来越多的研究表明，各种补充剂可能提升整体体能、改善健康状况，并在面对身体或心理极限时提供更快的恢复。大多数个体，包括许多医疗和营养专业人士，对营养补充剂及其在训练或战斗环境中对士兵的影响仅具备基本的理解。然而，为了安全和获得最佳效益，掌握这些细节是必要的。已评估了多种化合物——包括在军事环境中的证据——发现它们能增强耐力、提高认知功能、减轻膝盖疼痛，或在面对高能冲击时提供听力或肺部保护。这些有效成果可能有助于提升士兵的健康和寿命；然而，仍需持续研究以验证其在特定环境中的有效性和长期安全性。

paper_title: Mobile applications (apps) for tobacco cessation: Behaviour change potential and heuristic analysis using the Mobile Application Rating Scale (MARS)
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Given the high prevalence of tobacco use, India presents a significant challenge in tobacco control. Yet, the support received for tobacco cessation is suboptimal. Hence, the aim of this narrative review was to identify and heuristically evaluate ‘high-quality’ and ‘engaging’ tobacco cessation mobile apps using the Mobile Application Rating Scale (MARS). Also, to categorize and analyse their features with respect to engagement, functionality, aesthetics, and information quality. 
 
 
 Methods 
 A systematic search of tobacco cessation apps was done within app stores of prominent smartphone platforms developed by Apple and Android. The following search terms: ‘quit smoking,’ ‘smoking cessation, ‘stop smoking,’ ‘smoking therapy,’ ‘quit tobacco,’ ‘cigarette cessation,’ ‘cold turkey,’ and ‘quit cigarette.’ Pearson’s correlations were used to analyse correlations between app scores (Total score app-quality/mean score) and downloads/ratings and number of downloads with the overall MARS score. A Chi-square test was performed to analyse any association between app focus and app release dates. 
 
 
 Results 
 Total MARS scores ranged from 3.1 to 4.9. Quitsure app (4.9), Craving to Quit! app (4.8) and Stop Tobacco Mobile Trainer: Quit Smoking App (4.74) were ranked the highest according to the MARS overall mean score. Older apps focussed more on mere goal setting or substance use, as compared to behaviour change; whereas, recently developed apps are now focussing more on behaviour change. 
 
 
 Conclusions 
 The content and functionality of behaviour change-focused apps were of higher quality than those of other app categories. These recently developed mHealth apps can effectively supersede the traditional smoking cessation methods.
review_content:
General Comments: The aim of the study was to identify tobacco cessation apps on Apple and Android app stores and to categorize and analyse their features as regards to engagement, functionality, aesthetics, and information quality. Thereby recommending directions for the improvement of these apps.

Specific Comments:
Title:
 1. Please specify the type of review in the title to facilitate better understanding of the article.
Abstract:
 1. MARS (Mobile Application Rating Scale) could have been incorporated into the keywords to enhance the specificity.
Introduction
 1. Kindly give reference for the following lines in the introduction section: “The majority of people making independent attempts fail to maintain their quit status for even one month.”
 2. The second para of this section provides statistics on tobacco cessation from India. However, the following paragraph discusses global statistics on smartphone users, which appears to be out of sync with the flow of information. To maintain coherence, it would be better to align the information properly.
 3. The rationale of the review was well articulated in the introduction although a little more background on MARS and its scoring system and how it helps in heuristically evaluating the mhealth applications could be provided to strengthen the foundation of the study.
Methodology:
 1. The introduction highlights that rankings in app stores are highly volatile and primarily influenced by app usability, meaning that an app's behaviour change potential cannot be fully assessed based on its ratings or popularity alone. However, the inclusion criteria in the methods section focus on selecting apps with a rating of 4 stars or higher and more than 10,000 downloads. Justify.
 2. The inclusion of only apps with a rating of 4 stars or higher and over 10,000 downloads might exclude newer or less popular apps that could still be effective. This introduces a bias towards more established apps. Kindly justify.
 3. The reviewers were trained using a 37-minute YouTube video. Please answer the following questions:
    a) It may not be sufficient for thorough, expert-level assessment using the MARS tool. Kindly comment.
    b) While a high interrater reliability (0.804) is reported, no additional details are provided on how discrepancies between reviewers were resolved. This could affect the validity of the scoring and analysis if disagreements were not consistently addressed. Justify.
    c) How reliable and authentic was the video? It is suggested to include the link for the video in the references.
 4. There’s no mention of how frequently the apps were updated or if the study accounted for updates during the research period in the methods section. App features and functionalities can change significantly with updates, which could affect the evaluation. It is suggested to include details regarding the same.
 5. Less information is provided on the availability of the mhealth application, especially if is it limited to India (developed) or Indian context. This may be an important factor as some of the apps belonging to the western population could not be practical for lifestyle or behaviour change therapies among Asian Indians.
 6. Statistical analyses used in the review seem basic thus undermining the actual benefits of the application and how it could be practically applied. Although the review outlines the combined effects of all the 20 applications, additional specifications or features of at least the top 5 applications could be briefed out to demonstrate how pragmatic these apps are for everyday practise.
Results:
 1. It is recommended to provide a separate breakdown in Figure 2 for each reviewer, rather than presenting an overall summary. For example, indicate how many apps were identified by Reviewer 1 and how many were identified by Reviewer 2 using the search terms.
 2. While the study title emphasizes behaviour change, "Mobile applications (apps) for tobacco cessation: Behaviour change potential and heuristic analysis using the Mobile Application Rating Scale (MARS)," the majority of the apps reviewed (14) primarily focused on goal-setting, with only 4 targeting behaviour change directly. Justify.
 3. The final number of apps subjected to analysis (20 out of 670) is very small (only 3 apps from iOS). The sample size may be too small to yield reliable or meaningful statistical significance. This limits the generalizability of the findings
 4. "Chi-square test was performed to analyse any association between app focus and app release dates. Older apps focused more on mere goal setting or substance use, as compared to behaviour change. Apps that have been recently developed are now focusing more on behaviour change and these results were statistically significant (P value = 0.000)."

    What is the definition of older apps? According to table 1, 50% apps were release between years 2019-2023 and an equal number were updated in 2023. This contradicts the results where the authors have mentioned that there were only 4 apps targeting behaviour change.
 5. Table showing correlation and chi square test is missing.
 6. It is suggested to remove pie chart as this is not adding any value to the manuscript.
 7. Further explanation of statistical tests, confidence intervals, and potential confounding factors would enhance the clarity and rigor of the analysis. Additionally, providing more detail on the interpretation of correlations and the significance of app focus trends would strengthen the discussion of results.
Discussion:
 1. This is the line from discussion section: “According to the findings of our study, the apps that focus on behaviour modification had higher user ratings and overall MARS scores with many features.”
    a) Since, authors are talking a lot about these apps. In the results section as well It is suggested to include the app names based on this categorisation in the results section for clearer reference.
    b) Also, while the study notes that most apps focussed on goal setting. There is little exploration of the implications of having a majority of apps focused on goal setting rather than behaviour change.
 2. Some points mentioned in other sections of the study are repeated, such as the focus on the MARS scale and its dimensions. Kindly avoid such repetitions.
 3. "Our study found more than 622 smoking cessation apps in both platforms. It is concerning that the app stores for smoking cessation applications is saturated with apps of low quality, perhaps making it difficult for users who aren't the most selective to find higher-quality apps."

    For the above statement, What criteria were used to determine low quality of an app?
 4. The discussion mentions similarities with previous studies but does not provide a detailed comparison or analysis of how the current findings add to or differ from existing literature.
 5. The recommendation for developing more behavior change-focused apps lacks specificity and concrete suggestions on features.
 6. Kindly review the calculation for the apps excluded. The number mentioned in results (558) and the number mentioned in fig 2 (54) gives a difference of 10 which is missed out in the review. Recheck and update the table or the count.
 7. While the discussion does a great job of highlighting the importance of behavior change apps, it could benefit from a deeper exploration of why behavior change techniques (e.g., cognitive-behavioral therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy) are more effective in driving smoking cessation. A more detailed explanation of the mechanisms behind these techniques, backed by literature, would strengthen the argument and provide additional value to readers who may be unfamiliar with these approaches.
Final Comments:

The study aimed to evaluate tobacco cessation apps on Apple and Android app stores, analyzing their features related to engagement, functionality, aesthetics, and information quality. However, it faces issues with justifying its inclusion criteria, addressing the small sample size, and providing specific recommendations for improving behaviour change-focused apps.
paper_title_zh: 烟草戒断移动应用程序（App）：基于移动应用程序评分量表（MARS）的行为改变潜力和启发式分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
鉴于烟草使用的高流行率，印度在烟草控制方面面临着重大挑战。然而，戒烟所获得的支持并不理想。因此，本叙述性综述的目的是利用移动应用程序评分量表（MARS）识别并启发式评估“高质量”和“吸引人”的戒烟移动应用程序，并对其在参与度、功能性、美观性和信息质量方面的特征进行分类和分析。

方法
在苹果和安卓开发的知名智能手机平台的应用商店内，系统性地搜索戒烟应用程序。使用的搜索词包括：“戒烟”、“戒烟治疗”、“停止吸烟”、“吸烟治疗”、“戒除烟草”、“香烟戒除”、“冷火鸡”和“戒除香烟”。使用Pearson相关性分析应用程序评分（总分/平均分）与下载量/评分以及下载量与总体MARS评分之间的相关性。进行卡方检验以分析应用程序焦点与应用程序发布日期之间的任何关联。

结果
总体MARS评分范围从3.1到4.9。Quitsure应用程序（4.9）、Craving to Quit!应用程序（4.8）和Stop Tobacco Mobile Trainer: Quit Smoking App（4.74）根据MARS总体平均分排名最高。较旧的应用程序更多地关注单纯的目标设定或物质使用，而较新的应用程序则更多地关注行为改变。

结论
以行为改变为重点的应用程序的内容和功能性质量高于其他类别应用程序。这些最近开发的mHealth应用程序可以有效取代传统的戒烟方法。
review_content_zh:
### 综述意见

研究的目的是在苹果和安卓应用商店中识别戒烟应用程序，并对其在参与度、功能性、美观性和信息质量方面的特征进行分类和分析。从而为这些应用程序的改进提供建议。

### 具体意见

**标题：**
1. 请在标题中明确综述的类型，以便更好地理解文章。

**摘要：**
1. MARS（移动应用程序评分量表）可以纳入关键词中，以提高特异性。

**引言：**
1. 请在引言部分为以下句子提供参考文献：“大多数独立尝试戒烟的人甚至无法维持戒烟状态一个月。”
2. 本节的第二段提供了来自印度的戒烟统计数据。然而，接下来的段落讨论了全球智能手机用户的数据，这与信息流的连贯性似乎不一致。为了保持连贯性，最好将信息对齐。
3. 尽管引言中很好地阐述了综述的合理性，但可以提供更多关于MARS及其评分系统的背景信息，以及它如何帮助启发式评估mhealth应用程序，以加强研究的理论基础。

**方法：**
1. 引言中强调应用商店中的排名高度波动，主要受应用可用性的影响，这意味着仅凭应用的评分或流行度无法完全评估其行为改变潜力。然而，方法部分中的纳入标准侧重于选择评分4星或以上且下载量超过10,000次的应用。请解释原因。
2. 仅纳入评分4星或以上且下载量超过10,000次的应用可能会排除一些较新或不太流行的应用，这些应用可能仍然有效。这引入了对更成熟应用的偏见。请解释原因。
3. 评审员通过一个37分钟的YouTube视频进行培训。请回答以下问题：
   a) 这可能不足以使用MARS工具进行彻底的专家级评估。请评论。
   b) 虽然报告了较高的评分者间信度（0.804），但没有提供关于如何解决评审员之间差异的额外细节。如果分歧没有得到一致解决，这可能会影响评分和分析的有效性。请解释原因。
   c) 视频的可靠性和真实性如何？建议在参考文献中包含视频链接。
4. 方法部分中没有提及应用的更新频率，或者研究期间是否考虑了更新。应用的功能和功能可能会随着更新而发生显著变化，这可能会影响评估。建议包含相关细节。
5. 关于mhealth应用程序的可用性信息较少，尤其是是否仅限于印度（发达国家）或印度背景。这可能是一个重要因素，因为一些属于西方人群的应用可能不适合亚洲印度人的生活方式或行为改变疗法。
6. 综述中使用的统计分析似乎很基础，从而削弱了应用程序的实际益处及其在实际应用中的潜力。尽管综述概述了所有20个应用程序的综合效果，但至少可以简要介绍前5个应用程序的附加规格或特征，以展示这些应用在日常实践中的实用性。

**结果：**
1. 建议在图2中为每位评审员提供单独的细分，而不是呈现总体摘要。例如，指出评审员1和评审员2使用搜索词分别识别了多少个应用。
2. 尽管研究标题强调行为改变，“移动应用程序（应用）用于戒烟：使用移动应用程序评分量表（MARS）的行为改变潜力和启发式分析”，但大多数被审查的应用（14个）主要侧重于目标设定，只有4个直接针对行为改变。请解释原因。
3. 最终接受分析的应用数量（20个中的670个）非常少（只有3个来自iOS）。样本量可能太小，无法产生可靠或有意义的统计显著性。这限制了发现的可推广性。
4. “进行了卡方检验以分析应用焦点和应用发布日期之间的任何关联。较旧的应用更多地关注单纯的目标设定或物质使用，而较新的应用则更多地关注行为改变，这些结果具有统计学意义（P值=0.000）。”

   较旧应用的定义是什么？根据表1，50%的应用在2019-2023年间发布，相同数量的应用在2023年更新。这与作者提到的只有4个应用针对行为改变的结果相矛盾。
5. 缺少显示相关性和卡方检验的表格。
6. 建议删除饼图，因为这并没有为手稿增加任何价值。
7. 进一步解释统计检验、置信区间和潜在混杂因素将增强分析的清晰度和严谨性。此外，更详细地解释相关性的解释和应用焦点趋势的显著性将加强结果的讨论。

**讨论：**
1. 这是讨论部分的一行：“根据我们研究的结果，专注于行为改变的应用具有更高的用户评分和总体MARS评分，且具有许多功能。”
   a) 由于作者在这些应用上谈了很多。在结果部分也应包括基于此分类的应用名称，以便更清晰地参考。
   b) 同时，尽管研究指出大多数应用侧重于目标设定。对于大多数应用侧重于目标设定而非行为改变的后果，探讨较少。
2. 研究的其他部分提到了一些重复的点，例如对MARS量表及其维度的关注。请避免此类重复。
3. “我们的研究发现，在两个平台上有超过622个戒烟应用。令人担忧的是，戒烟应用的应用商店充斥着低质量的应用，这可能会使用户难以找到更高质量的应用。”

   对于上述声明，使用了什么标准来确定应用的质量低？
4. 讨论提到了与先前研究的相似之处，但没有提供详细的比较或分析，说明当前发现如何补充或不同于现有文献。
5. 关于开发更多专注于行为改变的应用的建议缺乏具体性和具体的特征建议。
6. 请审查排除应用的计算。结果中提到的数量（558）和图2中提到的数量（54）相差10，这在综述中遗漏了。重新检查并更新表格或计数。
7. 尽管讨论很好地强调了行为改变应用的重要性，但可以从更深入地探讨为什么行为改变技术（例如，认知行为疗法、接纳与承诺疗法）在推动戒烟方面更有效。更详细地解释这些技术背后的机制，并辅以文献支持，将加强论证并为不熟悉这些方法的读者提供额外价值。

**最终意见：**

该研究的目的是评估苹果和安卓应用商店中的戒烟应用，分析其在参与度、功能性、美观性和信息质量方面的特征。然而，它在证明其纳入标准、解决小样本量以及为改进专注于行为改变的应用提供具体建议方面存在问题。

paper_title: The characteristics and roles of antimicrobial peptides as potential treatment for antibiotic-resistant pathogens: A review
paper_abstract: The emergence of antibiotic resistant bacteria has become a significant and everincreasing threat to global public health, increasing both morbidity and mortality rates, and the financial burden on health services. Infection by drug-resistant bacteria is anticipated to contribute to the demise of almost 10 million people by the year 2050 unless a competent and effective response is devised to engage with this issue. The emergence and spread of resistance is commonly caused by the excessive or inappropriate use of antibiotics and substandard pharmaceuticals. It arises when pathogens adapt to different conditions and develop self-defence mechanisms. Currently, novel antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have been reported to be the sole cure for some clinical cases of infectious diseases such as sepsis and skin infections, although these agents may, on occasion, require administration together with an adjunctive low-dose antibiotic. Although AMPs are a promising alternative form of anti-microbial therapy and easily applied in the medical sector, they still have limitations that should not be taken lightly. Hence, this review explores the characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of AMPs for their potential in treating antibiotic-resistant pathogens.

paper_title: Prevalence, causes and impacts of human trafficking in Asian countries: A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background: In Asian countries, human trafficking is often encountered as forced labor, forced marriage, sex trafficking, men, women, and children exploitation. This review points out how human trafficking activities are prevalent in Asian countries and also reveals different causes that are the basis of increasingly human trafficking in Asian countries such as poverty, unemployment, political uncertainty, war, natural disaster, corruption and weak policies. Human trafficking also creates huge health, physical, psychological and social implications on individuals and the overall society. 
 Methods: The purpose of this study is to collect evidence on human trafficking in Asian countries. A scoping review methodology was used to systematically search online databases including Sage Journals Online, Wiley Online, Hein Online, Taylor & Francis Online, Web of Science, and Scopus literature to amalgamate information on this issue. For the purposes of this article, 64 studies met the inclusion criteria after searching and screening a total number of 1,278 studies. 
 Results: The findings of this study were classified under three categories: prevalence of human trafficking in Asia, causes of human trafficking in Asia (poverty and unemployment, environmental and manmade disaster, weak policies and corruption), and impacts of human trafficking including social, health, physical, psychological impacts. 
 Conclusion: Keeping in mind the prevalence and impacts of human trafficking, the author also recommends some meaningful and practical steps for policymakers and researchers to effectively tackle human trafficking in Asian countries.
review_content:
This is an overview article that uses a systematic review method to distil the main findings from already published research on human trafficking in Asia. Overall, the piece is of a very general nature, does not advance theory and method, and merely summarises extant literature on human trafficking,

There are some conceptual issues the authors need to address. The text vacillates between referring to human trafficking as a cross-border phenomenon and an intra-country phenomenon. It can be both, so the text needs to be consistent throughout. The review does not include important articles on definitional challenges around the concept of modern slavery, human trafficking, and related forms of exploitation. I would recommend more thorough consideration and clarity on conceptual definitions.

Methodologically, the authors need to reference the 2023 Global Slavery Index and prepare a table in the section on prevalence that lists Asian countries and estimated prevalence for each country for 2016 and 2023.

On the causes of human trafficking, the authors need to consider both the International Organisation for Migration 'Vulnerability Model' and the Global Slavery Index 'model of vulnerability,' which include more factors at different levels of analysis that have been found to be important drivers of the problem.

Finally, there are many problems with language and tone. There are many missing definite articles and incorrect verbs used (e.g. 'fabricated with globalisation,' simply makes no sense), while there is an overuse of alarmist adjectives that detract from the presentation and should not be used in an academic piece of writing..

paper_title: The nutritional status of children living within institutionalized care: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. There are an estimated 2.7 million children living within institutionalized care worldwide. This review aimed to evaluate currently available data on the nutrition status of children living within institutionalized care.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The paper has been significantly improved and the authors addressed most of my observations and comments. • Thank you for your review of the paper and support of the changes addressed. Experimental design Systematic research criteria and parameters are appropriate. • Thank you for your follow up that criteria and parameters are appropriate. Validity of the findings No major concerns. Comments for the Author There is only one point that I recommend the authors to address, mention and shortly discuss/emphasize in the discussion, as suggested in the previous review. See below the specific point and rebuttal. Review #1 - Additionally, I suggest the authors to consider additional paragraphs/section to discuss some specific health issues that occur frequently in institutionalized settings (e.g. diarrhea, respiratory infections, anemia). In this regard, the authors just mentioned also the concern about the medical care provided to these institutionalized children. Most papers come from developing countries: e.g. in Asia (which is the most represented country in this article, probably) common diseases, even not infectious (for instance, celiac disease, which is not rare, very heterogeneous clinically, but invariably associated with malnutrition and/or micronutrients deficiency) can be completely overlooked in healthy and normal settings and, then, the authors can figure out in institutionalized children (e.g. Medicina (Kaunas). 2019 Jan 12;55(1). pii: E11. doi: 10.3390/medicina55010011.; PLoS One. 2011;6(7):e22774. doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0022774). Authors' reply #1 - Thank you for sharing, we reviewed this article and added additional information, line 122 on page Review #2 (current) - I think the authors should add in the discussion a paragraph or a few sentences mentioning the possibility that many medical conditions without acute symptoms or with blunted clinical manifestations can be easily overlooked in these institutionalized setting and, in particular, in low-middle income countries, which represent the provenience of most paper considered in this systematic review. The authors may consider several non-communicable diseases, but one very good example might be celiac disease (as suggested), which is probably the most frequent chronic disease (often pauci-symptomatic, manifesting with growth problems mainly) that can impair the growth and nutritional status in children (including the reported micronutrients deficiency) all over the world. Both articles previously recommended can be very useful to mention, discuss and emphasize this specific aspect in the discussion. The additional information provided in the introduction (line 122, page 4) does not address this specific observation/suggestion appropriately, in my opinion. Indeed, table 2 (that is very detailed and informative) may indirectly suggest how chronic/no acute conditions are not considered in almost all available meta-analyzed studies. This issue of the under-diagnosis of medical conditions in settings with limited resources and/or poor awareness of specific non-acute diseases impairing the growth in children, should be mentioned. • Thank you for your additional feedback. This limitation of under diagnosis of disabilities, chronic diseases and medical conditions has been noted in the discussion section on lines 388-390 and the reference has been added at line 442-443. In line 115, it was further specified to include diarrhea and anemia as commonly occurring issues for children in care.

paper_abstract_zh: 背景。据估计，全球有270万儿童生活在机构化照料中。本综述旨在评估目前关于生活在机构化照料中儿童的营养状况的可用数据。
review_content_zh: 审稿人1（匿名）基本报告论文已显著改进，作者回应了我大部分的观察和评论。• 感谢您对论文的评审和对所做更改的支持。实验设计系统研究的标准和参数是适当的。• 感谢您的跟进，确认标准和参数是适当的。研究结果的有效性没有重大关切。对作者的建议只有一点，我建议作者在讨论中提及并简要讨论/强调，正如前次评审所建议的。具体内容和反驳意见见下文。审稿意见#1 - 此外，我建议作者考虑增加段落/章节来讨论在机构环境中频繁发生的特定健康问题（例如腹泻、呼吸道感染、贫血）。在这方面，作者也提到了对这些机构化儿童提供的医疗护理的担忧。大多数论文来自发展中国家：例如在亚洲（可能是本文中最具代表性的国家），常见疾病，即使是非传染性疾病（例如乳糜泻，并不罕见，临床表现非常异质，但总是与营养不良和/或微量营养素缺乏相关）在健康和正常环境中可能完全被忽视，然后，作者可以在机构化儿童中考虑（例如 Medicina (Kaunas). 2019年1月12日;55(1). pii: E11. doi: 10.3390/medicina55010011.; PLoS One. 2011;6(7):e22774. doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0022774）。作者回复#1 - 感谢分享，我们审阅了这篇文章并添加了额外信息，第122行，第4页审稿意见#2（当前） - 我认为作者应在讨论中增加一段或几句话，提及许多没有急性症状或临床表现不明显的医疗状况在这些机构环境中可能容易被忽视，特别是在中低收入国家，这些国家是本次系统综述中考虑的大多数论文的来源地。作者可以考虑几种非传染性疾病，但一个非常好的例子可能是乳糜泻（如建议），这可能是最常见的影响儿童生长发育（包括报告的微量营养素缺乏）的慢性疾病（通常症状轻微，主要表现为生长问题）。之前推荐的两篇文章可以非常有用地提及、讨论和强调讨论中的这一具体方面。在我看来，引言中提供的额外信息（第122行，第4页）并未适当解决这一具体观察/建议。实际上，表2（非常详细且信息丰富）可能间接表明，几乎所有的元分析研究中都没有考虑慢性/非急性状况。在资源有限和/或对特定非急性疾病认识不足的环境中，影响儿童生长的医疗状况的诊断不足问题应被提及。• 感谢您的额外反馈。这一关于残疾、慢性疾病和医疗状况诊断不足的局限性已在讨论部分的第388-390行中提及，并在第442-443行添加了参考文献。在第115行，进一步明确包括腹泻和贫血作为照护儿童中常见的问题。

reasons: Both articles previously recommended can be very useful to mention, discuss and emphasize this specific aspect in the discussion.
The paper has been significantly improved and the authors addressed most of my observations and comments.

paper_title: Intraoral repair of fractured ceramics: a literature review
paper_abstract:
Background: Fracture or chipping of veneering ceramic resulting in aesthetic and functional issues is a frequent technical complication encountered with fixed dental prostheses. Treatment options include extraoral or intraoral repair of the ceramic restoration; the latter being minimally invasive and cost-effective. We reviewed the various intraoral repair techniques for ceramic fractures and their efficiency in the last decade. 
 Methods: A literature search was carried out between 2017 and 2022 using the PubMed database with keywords: intraoral, repair, ceramics, porcelain, and ‘porcelain fused to metal’. Screening of abstracts and full texts was carried out to determine the final list of eligible studies. 
 Results:  Twenty-one eligible studies were included in the review which consisted of 17 in vitro studies, three case reports, and one prospective clinical study. Researchers and dentists preferred repairing cracked veneered zirconia-based restorations intraorally if the restoration is in acceptable condition. However, successful intraoral repair of veneering fractures relies on the bond between the previous restoration and the new repair material, the right adhesive resin, and adequate surface conditioning. The review indicated that the best technique to fix chipping in a complex made of zirconia core and veneering ceramic is to treat the veneering ceramic with hydrofluoric acid before covering the core ceramic with silica. 
 Conclusion: Intraoral repair is an efficient and economic procedure without the need for repeated sessions. However, the success and longevity of the restoration rely on the technical skills of the clinicians and adherence to prescribed protocols.
review_content: This review addresses the intraoral repair of fractured dental ceramics, a common and clinically significant issue in dental practice. The authors conducted a non-structured PubMed search for articles published in English between 2017 and 2022, identifying 21 relevant studies. This review considers various techniques and ceramic types to provide a comprehensive overview of modern repair strategies for ceramic fractures and current repair protocols for different fracture types and core materials. It is a valuable resource for research and clinical practice due to its practical relevance and accessibility. Although the clinical studies were limited to 50 patients, the conclusions must be interpreted cautiously. There is an inconsistency in the reported timeframe for the included studies. Two critical aspects have not been discussed: the age of the restoration and the impact it has on the repair prognosis-surface pretreatment with plasma for improved bond stability. The review's conclusions, while logical, are not fully supported by the included articles. There is, however, a well-structured summary of existing practices and recommendations for managing intraoral ceramic repairs. Despite some limitations, it offers dental professionals a valuable resource for understanding and implementing current repair strategies. Additional clinical data and the additional aspects mentioned could be included in future reviews to give a more comprehensive topic analysis.
paper_title_zh: 口腔内陶瓷断裂修复：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：固定牙科修复体中常见的专业技术并发症是饰面陶瓷的断裂或崩裂，导致美观和功能性问题。治疗方法包括陶瓷修复体的口外或口内修复，后者具有微创和成本效益高的特点。我们回顾了近年来口内修复陶瓷断裂的各种技术及其效率。

方法：使用PubMed数据库，在2017年至2022年期间进行文献检索，关键词包括：口内、修复、陶瓷、 porcelain（瓷器）和“porcelain fused to metal”（金属烤瓷）。通过筛选摘要和全文，确定最终符合条件的研究列表。

结果：共纳入21项符合条件的研究，包括17项体外研究、3篇病例报告和1项前瞻性临床研究。研究人员和牙医倾向于在口内修复裂纹饰面氧化锆基修复体，如果修复体状况可接受。然而，成功进行口内修复饰面断裂依赖于原有修复体与新修复材料之间的结合、合适的粘接树脂以及充分的表面处理。综述指出，修复由氧化锆核心和饰面陶瓷组成的复合体中崩裂的最佳技术是在用硅石覆盖核心陶瓷之前，用氢氟酸处理饰面陶瓷。

结论：口内修复是一种高效且经济的过程，无需多次治疗。然而，修复的成功和持久性依赖于临床医生的技术技能和对规定协议的遵守。
review_content_zh: 本综述探讨了口腔内修复断裂牙科陶瓷的问题，这是牙科实践中常见且具有临床意义的问题。作者对2017年至2022年间发表的英文文章进行了非结构化的PubMed检索，确定了21项相关研究。本综述考虑了各种技术和陶瓷类型，以提供对现代陶瓷断裂修复策略和不同断裂类型及核心材料当前修复协议的全面概述。由于其实用性和可获取性，它是研究和临床实践中的宝贵资源。尽管临床研究仅限于50名患者，但结论必须谨慎解读。所包含研究的报告时间框架存在不一致性。两个关键方面尚未讨论：修复体的年龄及其对修复预后的影响——使用等离子体进行表面预处理以提高粘接稳定性。综述的结论虽然合乎逻辑，但并未完全得到所包含文章的支持。然而，它对现有实践进行了结构良好的总结，并提供了管理口腔内陶瓷修复的建议。尽管存在一些局限性，但它为牙科专业人员理解和实施当前修复策略提供了宝贵资源。未来的综述可以包括更多的临床数据及提到的其他方面，以进行更全面的主题分析。

paper_title: The one-humped camel: The animal of future, potential alternative red meat, technological suitability and future perspectives
paper_abstract: The 2020 world population data sheet indicates that world population is projected to increase from 7.8 billion in 2020 to 9.9 billion by 2050 (Increase of more than 25%). Due to the expected growth in human population, the demand for meats that could improve health status and provide therapeutic benefits is also projected to rise. The dromedary also known as the Arabian camel, or one-humped camel ( Camelus dromedarius ), a pseudo ruminant adapted to arid climates, has physiological, biological and metabolic characteristics which give it a legendary reputation for surviving in the extreme conditions of desert environments considered restrictive for other ruminants. Camel meat is an ethnic food consumed across the arid regions of Middle East, North-East Africa, Australia and China. For these medicinal and nutritional benefits, camel meat can be a great option for sustainable meat worldwide supply. A considerable amount of literature has been published on technological aspects and quality properties of beef, lamb and pork but the information available on the technological aspects of the meat of the one humped camel is very limited. Camels are usually raised in less developed countries and their meat is as nutritionally good as any other traditional meat source. Its quality also depends on the breed, sex, age, breeding conditions and type of muscle consumed. A compilation of existing literature related to new technological advances in packaging, shelf-life and quality of camel meat has not been reviewed to the best of our knowledge. Therefore, this review attempts to explore the nutritional composition, health benefits of camel meat, as well as various technological and processing interventions to improve its quality and consumer acceptance. This review will be helpful for camel sector and highlight the potential for global marketability of camel meat and to generate value added products.
review_content:
The manuscript requires substantial reworking due to the presence of repetitive sentences, particularly between the recommendation and conclusion sections. To improve the clarity and quality, the recommendation should be condensed into a concise paragraph that highlights the primary assumptions and limitations. On a positive note, the language and style meet the required standards.

Moreover, it is crucial to ensure a clear and concise statement of the objective in the abstract to provide readers with a comprehensive understanding of the study's focus.
Furthermore, the authors should dedicate more attention to elaborating and discussing the points mentioned below. These crucial pieces of information are currently absent from the manuscript and their inclusion through thorough examination is necessary to enhance the overall quality of the article.
 1. Variation in nutritional composition of camel meat such as effect of Age at which the camel is slaughtered plays a significant role in determining the meat's composition and in turn, affects consumer acceptance. Also, the nutritional composition of camel meat shows considerable diversity based on the specific muscle being studied. Different muscle portions have distinct compositions, influencing the overall nutritional profile of the meat. In addition, variations in the chemical composition of camel meat have been observed due to differences in breeds. Different breeds of camels may exhibit varying nutritional properties in their meat.

    Understanding these variations is essential for researchers, meat processors, and consumers to make informed decisions regarding camel meat consumption and utilization. By considering these factors, stakeholders can optimize the production and marketing of camel meat products, meeting the preferences and demands of consumers while ensuring the meat's overall quality and nutritional value.
 2. Main constraints of camel production such as presence of camel disease, poor overall knowledge of producer, lack or insufficient market infrastructure, lack of market information and lack or insufficient overall support. Addressing these constraints through targeted interventions, such as disease control programs, capacity-building initiatives, improved market linkages, and policy support, can help to enhance the sustainability and profitability of camel production systems.
 3. Camel rearing and production and slaughtering and processing. Both camel rearing and production, as well as slaughtering and processing, play pivotal roles in determining the overall quality, safety, and value of camel meat in the market.
paper_title_zh: 单峰驼：未来的动物，潜在的替代红肉，技术适用性及未来展望
paper_abstract_zh: 2020年世界人口数据表显示，预计世界人口将从2020年的78亿增加到2050年的99亿（增长超过25%）。由于预期人口增长，对能够改善健康状况并提供治疗益处的肉类需求预计也将上升。单峰驼，也称为阿拉伯骆驼或单峰骆驼（Camelus dromedarius），是一种适应干旱气候的伪反刍动物，其生理、生物和代谢特征使其在被认为是其他反刍动物限制性环境的沙漠极端条件下生存而享有传奇声誉。骆驼肉是一种民族食品，消费于中东、东北非、澳大利亚和中国的干旱地区。由于其药用和营养价值，骆驼肉可以作为全球可持续肉类供应的绝佳选择。已有大量文献发表关于牛肉、羊肉和猪肉的技术方面和质量属性，但关于单峰骆驼肉技术方面的信息非常有限。骆驼通常在欠发达国家饲养，其肉质与其他传统肉类来源一样营养丰富。其质量还取决于品种、性别、年龄、饲养条件和所消费的肌肉类型。据我们所知，尚未对现有文献中关于骆驼肉包装、保质期和质量方面的新技术进展进行综述。因此，本综述试图探讨骆驼肉的营养成分、健康益处，以及各种技术和加工干预措施以改善其质量和消费者接受度。本综述将对骆驼行业有所帮助，并突出骆驼肉在全球市场的潜力以及生产高附加值产品的可能性。
review_content_zh:
手稿由于存在重复句子，尤其是推荐和结论部分之间，需要进行大量修改。为了提高清晰度和质量，建议应浓缩成一个简洁的段落，突出主要假设和局限性。积极的一面是，语言和风格符合要求的标准。

此外，确保摘要中明确且简洁地陈述研究目标至关重要，以便读者全面了解研究的重点。此外，作者应更加关注详细阐述和讨论以下提到的要点。这些关键信息目前在手稿中缺失，通过彻底审查将其纳入是提高文章整体质量的必要条件。
1. 骆驼肉营养组成的变异，如屠宰年龄的影响在决定肉品组成方面起着重要作用，进而影响消费者接受度。此外，骆驼肉的营养组成根据所研究的特定肌肉表现出显著差异。不同肌肉部分具有不同的组成，影响肉品的整体营养概况。此外，由于品种差异，骆驼肉的化学组成也观察到变化。不同品种的骆驼其肉品可能表现出不同的营养特性。

了解这些变异对于研究人员、肉类加工者和消费者做出有关骆驼肉消费和利用的明智决策至关重要。通过考虑这些因素，利益相关者可以优化骆驼肉产品的生产和营销，满足消费者的偏好和需求，同时确保肉品整体质量和营养价值。
2. 骆驼生产的主要制约因素，如骆驼疾病的存在、生产者整体知识水平低下、市场基础设施缺乏或不完善、市场信息不足以及整体支持缺乏或不充分。通过针对性干预措施解决这些制约因素，如疾病控制计划、能力建设倡议、改善市场联系和政策支持，可以帮助提高骆驼生产系统的可持续性和盈利能力。
3. 骆驼饲养和生产以及屠宰和加工。骆驼饲养和生产以及屠宰和加工在决定市场上骆驼肉的整体质量、安全和价值方面都起着关键作用。

paper_title: Systematic review  of ethnomedicinal knowledge: Documentation, evaluation, and conservation of medicinal plants and their therapeutic applications
paper_abstract: This study shows that ethnomedicine and ethnobotany have gained great relevance for their role in preserving ancestral knowledge about the use of medicinal plants. Despite the benefits, such as cultural preservation and biodiversity, new challenges arise, such as the lack of standardization and scientific validation, which limits their integration into modern medicine. Therefore, this systematic review aims to assess the documentation, evaluation, and conservation of medicinal plants and their therapeutic applications across different cultures, using the systematic literature review (SLR) methodology. The searches were conducted in electronic databases, such as Scopus, EBSCO, and Web of Science, following PRISMA protocol guidelines and focusing on studies published between 2007 and 2024. Research gaps were identified, and questions were developed to better understand ethnomedicinal practices, their validation, and conservation. A total of seventy studies were selected, documenting a wide diversity of medicinal plants, with a significant focus on the conservation of traditional knowledge. However, critical gaps were identified in the scientific validation and integration of this knowledge into conservation policies. The results of the thematic analysis highlight the need for standardized protocols and a multidisciplinary approach to validate and preserve ethnomedicinal knowledge, ensuring its relevance in modern medicine and its transmission to future generations.

paper_title_zh: 民族药物知识系统综述：药用植物及其治疗应用的记录、评估与保护
paper_abstract_zh: 本研究表明，民族医学和民族植物学因其保存有关药用植物使用的祖先知识的作用而获得了重要意义。尽管存在文化保护和生物多样性等益处，但也出现了新的挑战，如缺乏标准化和科学验证，这限制了它们融入现代医学。因此，本系统综述旨在通过系统文献综述（SLR）方法评估不同文化中药用植物的记录、评估和保存及其治疗应用。搜索在Scopus、EBSCO和Web of Science等电子数据库中进行，遵循PRISMA协议指南，重点关注2007年至2024年间发表的研究。识别了研究空白，并提出了问题，以更好地理解民族医药实践、其验证和保存。共选取了七十项研究，记录了广泛的药用植物多样性，重点显著放在传统知识的保存上。然而，在科学验证和将这一知识融入保护政策方面发现了关键空白。主题分析的结果强调了需要标准化协议和多学科方法来验证和保存民族医药知识，确保其在现代医学中的相关性及其向未来世代的传承。

paper_title: A systematic review and realist synthesis on toilet paper hoarding: COVID or not COVID, that is the question
paper_abstract: To explore whether the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic is associated with toilet paper hoarding and to assess which risk factors are associated with the risk of toilet paper hoarding.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Simon Columbus) Basic reporting The paper consists of three parts: A systematic review of studies on (determinants of) hoarding during the COVID-19 pandemic ("primary outcome"), a systematic review of inadequate use and hoarding of toilet paper in relation to mental health outcomes ("secondary outcome"), and a review of four predictors of hoarding that may be enhanced during the COVID-19 pandemic ("realist review"). Unfortunately, I am not convinced that these parts form a coherent whole. Moreover, I have severe doubts that enough data on the central topic are available to justify a systematic review. In our opinion, although published data on toilet paper hoarding are limited, the justification for conducting a systematic review should not rely on the number of published studies. In our case, the justification arose because toilet paper hoarding seemed to be associated with the COVID-19 pandemic in many countries. Although we anticipated that the number of studies could be low, we opted to conduct a systematic review because we wanted to gather the published evidence before discussing potential mechanisms (that were addressed with a realist review). The study of the pathological use of toilet paper was chosen as a secondary outcome in the systematic review. We decided to add this topic because we wanted to study potential inadequate/pathological use of toilet paper and mental health problems. The realist review was proposed as a second step for synthesizing the research (published, pre-prints, grey literature) with an explanatory focus. In our view, the two approaches are complementary. Experimental design A central problem is that the paper conflates hoarding as a clinically relevant mental health issue with 'hoarding' in the form of increased purchases in response to COVID-19. The authors discuss the use of clinical and non-clinical samples (l. 115-116). Yet, this does not address the implicit assumption that these two kinds of hoarding are the same or related constructs. Although I am no expert on clinical psychology, I find this highly doubtful. If a connection between these two constructs is made, it has to be supported and defended much more strongly. ‘Hoarding’ behaviour in non-clinical and clinical samples is thought to be mediated by the same neurobiological pathway. The following sentences have been included in the Introduction section to address this comment: “Neuroimaging studies using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and conducting experimental approaches (provocation of hoarding-related anxiety) in healthy subjects and clinical populations (OCD patients) have demonstrated that hoarding symptoms are associated with activation of the same brain areas, involving the anterior ventromedial prefrontal cortex, in both non-clinical and clinical populations (Mataix-Cols et al., 2003; An et al., 2009). These results support a common transdiagnostic neurobiological pathway for hoarding symptoms. Interestingly, the anterior ventromedial prefrontal cortex has also been implicated in buying behaviour in studies exploring value-based decisions with a buying task during an fMRI session (Gluth et al., 2012).” Second, it is not quite clear which role toilet paper and the COVID-19 pandemic play in the reviews. The first part of the systematic review considers hoarding during COVID-19 (but not necessarily toilet paper). The second part considers inappropriate use of toilet paper (but not necessarily during COVID-19). Finally, the realist review sometimes focuses on toilet paper-specific outcomes (e.g., mechanism 1), but sometimes discusses hoarding more generally (e.g., mechanism 3). Ultimately, these three parts do not really hang together. There also exists little data which would allow for integration (e.g., there is no data providing evidence as to whether hoarding of toilet paper is in any way distinct from other hoarding behaviour, in either clinical or non-clinical populations). This suggests that the focus of the paper is too broad. We agree with some points raised by the reviewer, such as the lack of data providing evidence as to whether hoarding of toilet paper is distinct from other hoarding behaviour. However, in our opinion, the lack of specific data on the category of hoarded items (e.g., toilet paper) does not mean that we cannot explore potential mechanisms linked to a specific behaviour that seemed to be present during the COVID-19 pandemic (toilet paper hoarding). We have included one sentence to address some of the reviewer concerns: “Moreover, there is no previous evidence suggesting that toilet paper hoarding is a behaviour distinct from other hoarding behaviour” (lines 101-102). Regarding the inclusion of the three parts, we have decided to focus the article in two parts (systematic review and realist review) and include the CATOTIM algorithm as a discussion. This decision has also been based on other reviewer comments that suggested removing the algorithm from the methods but include it as the Discussion. Validity of the findings The first part of the systematic review examines studies on hoarding during COVID-19. At this point, data is extremely limited; the systemic review only highlighted two empirical studies. Importantly, preprints were included from the systematic review. The authors identify one preprint with empirical data (Columbus, 2020). However, there are several other preprints that report on purchasing behaviour during the COVID-19 pandemic (e.g., Bai et al., 2020; Bentall et al., 2020; Zettler et al., 2020). Given the limited available data, I find it problematic that preprints are excluded from the review. Even including preprints and generalising beyond toilet paper, however, there is scarcely enough literature on hoarding during the COVID-19 pandemic to justify a systematic review. The decision to include only published articles was based a priori on our protocol that was registered in PROSPERO. We are aware that the number of studies is small, but we prefer not to mix published and unpublished articles in the systematic review. However, it is important to emphasize that the realist review does include published articles, unpublished articles and grey literature. We have included the suggested pre-prints (Bai et al., 2020; Bentall et al., 2020; Zettler et al., 2020) in the revised manuscript in the realist review section. We have also re-run the search for the systematic review until October 2020, and three new articles have been included in the systematic review part. In contrast to the systematic review, which focuses on published literature, the realist review covers a wide range of publications. These not just include preprints, but also news articles and blog posts. Some of these make rather silly arguments (e.g., a Freudian analysis of "regression to the anal stage", l. 506-507---although I understood at least one of the cited authors to be using this as a toy example to explain Freudian reasoning of which they are critical). At times, the realist review is mostly essayistic in nature. For example, l. 426-439 discuss information diffusion on social media using the example of a toilet roll juggling challenge. It is not clear what to draw from such discussions, especially since the paper does not provide even a limited review of the actual empirical literature on the topic. A realist review is an interpretative type of literature review, in contrast with a systematic review, which “attempts to collate all empirical evidence that fits pre-specified eligibility criteria in order to answer a specific research question” (Berg RC, Nanavati J. Realist Review: Current Practice and Future Prospects. 2016). We have clarified this issue in the Introduction section because we think that it is important to differentiate the methodology and approach of different review methods (systematic vs realist). We have rewritten the sentence on the Freudian analysis to state that psychoanalytical explanations for the hoarding of toilet paper might be formulated. Although there is less empirical evidence for these formulations, we think that we can mention them. In fact, when we re-run our analyses through 31st October 2020, we found a new publication on COVID-19 reflecting on toilet paper hoarding mechanisms with a psychodynamic approach (Güzel, 2020). Nevertheless, these explanations are included just once in the manuscript and are not considered major contributors to the study when compared to other potential mechanisms (e.g., bandwagon effects, personality traits). Comments for the Author Minor issues l. 260 describes the findings of Garbe et al. (2020) as 'excessive stockpiling'. However, the actual item simply referred to having more toilet paper than usual at home. This is plausibly described as stockpiling, but not excessive. We have removed the term “excessive”. P., Lloyd, A., Bennett, K., McKay, R., Mason, L., Murphy, J., … Shevlin, M. (2020). Pandemic buying: Testing a psychological model of over-purchasing and panic buying using data from the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland during the early phase of the COVID-19 pandemic. paper_title_zh: "关于囤积卫生纸的系统综述与现实主义综合分析：是否与COVID相关，这是个问题"
paper_abstract_zh: 探讨2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行是否与卫生纸囤积行为相关，并评估哪些风险因素与卫生纸囤积风险相关。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（西蒙·哥伦布）基本报告
本文由三部分组成：对COVID-19大流行期间（囤积行为的决定因素）的研究的系统回顾（“主要结果”），对与心理健康结果相关的卫生纸不当使用和囤积行为的系统回顾（“次要结果”），以及对COVID-19大流行期间可能加剧的四个囤积行为预测因素的现实主义回顾（“现实主义回顾”）。遗憾的是，我不认为这些部分构成了一个连贯的整体。此外，我严重怀疑是否有足够的数据来支持对中心主题进行系统回顾。在我们看来，尽管关于卫生纸囤积的已发表数据有限，但进行系统回顾的合理性不应依赖于已发表研究的数量。在我们的案例中，合理性源于卫生纸囤积似乎与许多国家的COVID-19大流行有关。尽管我们预计相关研究的数量可能较低，但我们选择进行系统回顾，因为我们希望在讨论潜在机制（通过现实主义回顾解决）之前收集已发表的证据。病理使用卫生纸的研究被选为系统回顾中的次要结果。我们决定添加这一主题，因为我们希望研究卫生纸的潜在不当/病理使用和心理健康问题。现实主义回顾被提议作为第二步，用于综合具有解释性重点的研究（已发表、预印本、灰色文献）。在我们看来，这两种方法是互补的。

实验设计
一个核心问题是，本文将囤积行为作为一种临床相关的心理健康问题与因COVID-19而增加购买的“囤积”行为混为一谈。作者讨论了临床和非临床样本的使用（第115-116行）。然而，这并未解决这两种囤积行为是相同或相关构念的隐含假设。尽管我不是临床心理学专家，但我对此表示高度怀疑。如果在这两种构念之间建立联系，必须更有力地支持和辩护。非临床和临床样本中的“囤积”行为被认为是由相同的神经生物学通路介导的。为回应这一评论，以下句子已包含在引言部分：“使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）进行神经影像学研究，并在健康受试者和临床人群（强迫症患者）中进行实验方法（囤积相关焦虑的激发）表明，囤积症状与非临床和临床人群中的相同脑区激活相关，涉及前腹内侧前额叶皮层（Mataix-Cols等人，2003年；An等人，2009年）。这些结果支持囤积症状的共同跨诊断神经生物学通路。” 有趣的是，前腹内侧前额叶皮层在探索基于价值的决策的购买任务中的功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究中，也被认为是与购买行为相关的（Gluth等人，2012年）。其次，卫生纸和COVID-19大流行在评论中所扮演的角色尚不明确。系统综述的第一部分考虑了COVID-19期间的囤积行为（但不一定是卫生纸）。第二部分考虑了卫生纸的不当使用（但不一定是在COVID-19期间）。最后，现实主义综述有时专注于卫生纸特定的结果（例如，机制1），但有时更广泛地讨论囤积行为（例如，机制3）。最终，这三部分并没有真正结合在一起。此外，几乎没有数据可以支持整合（例如，没有数据提供证据表明卫生纸的囤积行为在临床或非临床人群中与其他囤积行为有何不同）。这表明论文的关注范围过于广泛。我们同意审稿人提出的一些观点，例如缺乏数据证明卫生纸囤积行为与其他囤积行为有何不同。然而，在我们看来，缺乏关于囤积物品类别（例如，卫生纸）的具体数据，并不意味着我们不能探索与COVID-19大流行期间似乎存在的特定行为（卫生纸囤积）相关的潜在机制。我们已添加一句话以回应审稿人的一些担忧：“此外，没有先前证据表明卫生纸囤积行为与其他囤积行为不同”（第101-102行）。关于三部分的包含，我们决定将文章集中在两部分（系统综述和现实主义综述），并将CATOTIM算法作为讨论内容。这一决定也基于其他审稿人的建议，即从方法中删除算法，但在讨论中包含它。

研究结果的有效性
系统综述的第一部分考察了COVID-19期间的囤积行为研究。目前，数据极为有限；系统综述仅突出了两项实证研究。重要的是，系统综述中包含了预印本。作者识别出一篇包含实证数据的预印本（Columbus，2020年）。然而，还有其他几篇预印本报告了COVID-19大流行期间的购买行为（例如，Bai等人，2020年；Bentall等人，2020年；Zettler等人，2020年）。鉴于可用数据的有限性，我认为将预印本排除在综述之外是有问题的。即使包含预印本并将范围扩展到卫生纸之外，关于COVID-19大流行期间囤积行为的文献也几乎没有足够数量来支持系统综述。仅包含已发表文章的决定是基于我们事先在PROSPERO注册的协议。 我们意识到研究的数量较少，但出于系统评价的考虑，我们倾向于不将已发表和未发表的文章混合在一起。然而，需要强调的是，现实主义评价确实包括已发表的文章、未发表的文章和灰色文献。我们在修订稿中的现实主义评价部分已纳入了建议的预印本（Bai等人，2020年；Bentall等人，2020年；Zettler等人，2020年）。我们还重新进行了系统评价的检索，截止到2020年10月，并在系统评价部分纳入了三篇新文章。与专注于已发表文献的系统评价不同，现实主义评价涵盖了广泛的出版物。这些不仅包括预印本，还包括新闻文章和博客帖子。其中一些文章提出了相当荒谬的论点（例如，对“回归肛门阶段”的弗洛伊德式分析，第506-507行——尽管我理解至少有一位被引用的作者将其作为一个玩具示例来解释他们所批判的弗洛伊德式推理）。有时，现实主义评价的性质更像是散文。例如，第426-439行通过卫生纸杂耍挑战的例子讨论了社交媒体上的信息传播。从这些讨论中得出什么结论并不明确，尤其是论文甚至没有提供对该主题实际实证文献的有限回顾。现实主义评价是一种解释性的文献综述类型，与系统评价不同，后者“试图汇总所有符合预先指定资格标准的实证证据，以回答特定的研究问题”（Berg RC, Nanavati J. 现实主义评价：当前实践与未来前景. 2016年）。我们在引言部分澄清了这一问题，因为我们认为区分不同评价方法（系统评价与现实主义评价）的方法论和 approach 很重要。我们重写了关于弗洛伊德分析的句子，指出可以提出对囤积卫生纸的心理分析解释。尽管对这些解释的实证证据较少，我们认为可以提及它们。事实上，当我们重新进行截至2020年10月31日的分析时，我们发现了一篇新的关于COVID-19的出版物，从心理动力学角度反思卫生纸囤积机制（Güzel，2020年）。尽管如此，这些解释在文稿中仅提及一次，与其他潜在机制（例如，从众效应、人格特质）相比，并未被视为研究的主要贡献者。

对作者的小问题
第260行将Garbe等人（2020年）的研究发现描述为“过度囤积”。然而，实际项目仅指家中拥有比平时更多的卫生纸。这可以合理地描述为囤积，但并非过度。我们已删除了“过度”一词。

参考文献
Bai, M. (2020). 谁买光了所有的卫生纸？ 阴谋论者更有可能在COVID-19大流行期间囤积物资。来源：https://psyarxiv.com/z2g34/ Bentall, R. P., Lloyd, A., Bennett, K., McKay, R., Mason, L., Murphy, J., … Shevlin, M. (2020). 大流行购买：使用英国和爱尔兰共和国在COVID-19大流行早期阶段的数据测试过度购买和恐慌性购买的心理学模型。来源：https://psyarxiv.com/u7vqp/ Columbus, S. (2020). 诚实-谦逊、信念和亲社会行为：对COVID-19大流行期间囤积行为的测试。来源：https://psyarxiv.com/8e62v/ Zettler, I., Schild, C., Lilleholt, L., Kroencke, L., Utesch, T., Moshagen, M., … Geukes, K. (2020). 接受个人限制以对抗COVID-19大流行的个体差异：来自丹麦成人样本的结果。https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/pkm2a

paper_title: Incentivizing green building technology: A financial perspective on sustainable development in India
paper_abstract:
Future viability depends on ensuring a sustainable society because green energy methods may efficiently reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Nevertheless, stakeholders, consumers, and developers continue to be notably ignorant of the financial incentives connected to green technology. Moreover, there is still a dearth of studies on the range of financial incentives offered by different authorities in India. Monetary incentives, such as tax breaks, indirect tax exemptions, and refunds, are crucial in encouraging the use of green technology in the modern world. This study explores the importance of financial incentives for green building technologies in India, which also looks at the wide range of incentives provided by federal, state, and local governments. Furthermore, the study highlights various state government programs such as goods subsidies, exemptions from local taxes, and fee waivers. Notably, several incentives aimed at consumers, developers, and other stakeholders have been implemented by the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC). 
  This review study emphasizes the effectiveness of financial incentives in green construction projects and draws attention to a clear knowledge gap regarding the adoption of green technology. This study also provides insights into potential future directions. Studies and research results emphasize the importance of spreading the word about financial incentives as a key factor in determining the adoption of green technologies. Many parties, including governmental organizations, municipal governments, developers, and clients engaged in green building technology projects, stand to gain increased awareness.
review_content:
Nice work done. Some suggestions that could enhance the quality of paper:

1. Research motivation describes what motivates researchers and what they would like to achieve as a result of their studies. Therefore, the author can add a paragraph on research motivation in the introduction.

2. The author has written a research gap in the introduction section. But the same can be explained in detail with supportive relevant recent literature published recently.

3. Authors could discuss the scope for future work.

4. Literature Review should be extensive and include more supporting literature published in the last 10 years.
paper_title_zh: 激励绿色建筑技术：印度可持续发展的金融视角
paper_abstract_zh:
未来的可持续性取决于确保社会的可持续性，因为绿色能源方法可以有效减少温室气体排放。然而，利益相关者、消费者和开发者对于与绿色技术相关的财务激励仍然显著缺乏了解。此外，关于印度不同当局提供的财务激励范围的研究仍然匮乏。货币激励措施，如税收减免、间接税豁免和退款，对于鼓励现代世界使用绿色技术至关重要。本研究探讨了印度绿色建筑技术财务激励的重要性，同时考察了联邦、州和地方政府提供的广泛激励措施。此外，研究还强调了各州政府的项目，如商品补贴、地方税豁免和费用减免。值得注意的是，印度绿色建筑委员会（IGBC）已经实施了针对消费者、开发者和其他利益相关者的多项激励措施。
这项综述研究强调了财务激励在绿色建筑项目中的有效性，并指出了关于采用绿色技术的明显知识缺口。本研究还提供了对未来潜在方向的见解。研究和研究结果强调，传播财务激励信息是决定绿色技术采纳的关键因素。包括政府组织、市政政府、开发者和参与绿色建筑技术项目的客户在内的许多方面都将从提高认识中受益。
review_content_zh:
工作完成得不错。以下是一些建议，可以提升论文的质量：

1. 研究动机描述了激励研究者的因素以及他们希望通过研究达到的目标。因此，作者可以在引言部分增加一段关于研究动机的论述。

2. 作者在引言部分已经写了一个研究空白，但可以结合最近发表的相关文献进行更详细的阐述。

3. 作者可以讨论未来工作的范围。

4. 文献综述应更加广泛，并包括过去10年内发表的支持性文献。
