paper_title: A conflicts' classification for IoT-based services : A comparative survey
paper_abstract: Recently, IoT-based systems, especially automation systems, have become an indispensable part of modern-day lives to support the controlling of the networked devices and providing context-aware and intelligent environments. IoT-based services/apps developed by the end-users interact with each other and share concurrent access to devices according to their preferences, which increases safety, security, and correctness issues in IoT systems. Due to the critical impacts resulting from these issues, IoT-based apps require a customized type of compilers or checking tools that capable of analyzing the structures of these apps and detecting different types of errors and conflicts either in intra-IoT app instructions or in inter-IoT apps interactions. A plethora of approaches and frameworks have been proposed to assist the best practices for end-users in developing their IoT-based apps and mitigate these errors and conflicts. This paper focuses on conflict classification and detection approaches in the context of IoT systems by investigating the current research techniques that provided conflicts' classification or detection in IoT systems (published between 2014 and 2020). A classification of IoT-based apps interaction conflicts is proposed. The proposed conflicts' classification provides a priori conflicts detection method based on the analysis of IoT app instructions' relationships with utilizing the state-of-the-art Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) model checking and formal notations. The current detection approaches are compared with each other according to the proposed conflicts' classification to determine to which extend they cover different conflicts. Based on this comparison, we provide evidence that the existing approaches have a gap in covering different conflicts' levels and types which yields to minimize the correctness and safety of IoT systems. We point out the need to develop a safety and security compiler or tool for IoT systems. Also, We recommend using a hybrid approach that combines model checking with a variety of languages and semantic technologies in developing future IoT-based apps verification frameworks to cover all levels and types of
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting - The writing is clear and understandable though further proofreading is required. - The font sizes in the figures should be more optimized for print readers. - Technical keywords are well-introduced. - However, the title indicates it is specific for BAS while the target papers include generic IoT papers. The authors should clarify the difference in terms of conflict categorization. Regarding the survey title, we edited it to ​“A conflicts classification for IoT-based services : A comparative survey” which will be suitable to all papers mentioned in the survey. The abstract and survey context are edited from focusing on BAS to IoT systems, and an overall proofreading has been made. For figures, we have edited almost all of them (see Figures 3 to 13) specially the conflicts’ figures according to the formal notations provided in Table 1. Experimental design This is a comprehensive survey paper on conflict detection for IoT/BAS applications and systems. The reviewer appreciates the authors' contribution here, and gives several comments to improve the study further. Validity of the findings The authors' other paper (Ibrhim et al. 2020) is highlighted in the last row of Table 2. While it is not unfair to cite their papers, the authors should summarize the basic rationale of why their paper is standing out in terms of their own criteria. The basic rationale between this survey and (Ibrhim et al. 2020) is summarized in a paragraph (lines 769 to 784). In general, the RVF framework proposed in (Ibrhim et al. 2020) uses the same SMT model checker to detect the conflicts with the same rules relationship analysis described in this survey. The review found the summary of the technology but not much insight about why it can beat the other technologies. We edited the insights in the “Discussion” section (lines 725 to 831) to highlight the advantages gained from our survey. To summarize, the survey shows the gap in the current works in the sparse focusing on the conflicts detection and not covering different conflict types, the shortage in the current verification and detection methods, the state-of-the-art ignoring checking the system policies themselves and focusing only in IoT apps, suggests performing the checking and detecting of interactions conflicts in different levels, mention the need to a standard representation for both automation service rules and system policies which include different IoT platforms (e.g., SmartThings, IFTTT, Zapier, OpenHAB, etc.) is required, and opens a new research direction in the area of developing custom or domain-specific compilers for the IoT systems verification context. The reviewer recommends the authors to review the coverage of the papers again, especially the arguments that many papers ignore "system policies". System policies are often expressed in other automation services rules. And even further, DepSys paper definitely models system policies as "requirement dependencies". Yes, you are right. We mentioned (lines 70 to 74) different synonyms of “system policies” used in the previous works as “Requirement Dependencies” in (Munir and Stankovic, 2014), “Properties” in (Zhang et al., 2019a), “Constraints” in (Guilly et al., 2015), Energy Efficiency Indicators in (Pẽna et al., 2016), and “Devices Communication policies” in (Nagendra et al., 2019), and this work (Cheng et al., 2014) used policies in a different way, to resolve the conflicts between different users. DepSys and other papers are revised and edited in Section “Current conflicts' classifications and detection methods” (lines 357 to 362, lines 366 to 369 and lines 412 to 417) and also in Table 2. For IRON paper, it's unfair to argue the proposed tool is "not suitable for non-technical users" given most of the rule detection technologies remain at the algorithm level while the paper proposes more tools for usability. We removed this statement from have IRON paper description and edited its explanation (lines 373 to 377) to clarify that creating IoT apps using IRON language requires the programmer to have knowledge about devices’ properties (Int or Boolean physical or logical - has a constraint or not) which implies a burden for normal users when developing their apps. It's a big burden for readers to validate certain techniques' lack of conflict type coverages. Thus, the reviewer recommends the authors to exemplify several papers to explain why they lack in covering certain types of conflicts in explaining Table 2. We have added 7 examples (lines 748 to 768) of other papers and explain the reasons for not covering certain conflicts. For instance, IoTGuard in (Celik et al., 2019b) fails to detect the JBsC conflict because the unified dynamic model generated by their work required the IoT apps to have a chain of events. Also, (Vannucchi et al., 2017) uses different ways to detect the conflict, where it includes the invariants to detect the conflicts, and it depends on a single IoT app with its invariants. While the authors conclude in the abstract by recommending hybrid model checking, the reasoning is weak in the body. The authors may allocate a couple of paragraphs to explain that. We mentioned in two paragraphs (lines 785 to 812) the shortage of the existing conflict detection methods in covering different levels and types of conflicts, where each method uses different tools to reason about a few number of conflicts. So, for the sake of covering these issues, we recommend using a hybrid approach that combines model checking with a variety of languages and semantic technologies in developing future IoT-based apps verification frameworks to cover all levels and types of conflicts to guarantee and maximize the safety, security, and correctness of IoT systems. Comments for the Author This paper surveys a comprehensive list of papers about conflict types and detection, and then proposes categorization. The proposed categories are very helpful for evaluating existing and future frameworks.
paper_title_zh: 基于物联网服务的冲突分类：比较性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 近年来，基于物联网（IoT）的系统，尤其是自动化系统，已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分，用以支持网络设备的控制并提供情境感知和智能环境。由终端用户开发的基于IoT的服务/应用相互交互，并根据其偏好共享对设备的并发访问，这在IoT系统中增加了安全性、保密性和正确性问题。由于这些问题的严重影响，基于IoT的应用需要定制化的编译器或检查工具，能够分析这些应用的结构并检测在IoT应用内部指令或IoT应用间交互中的不同类型的错误和冲突。为协助终端用户在开发其基于IoT的应用时遵循最佳实践并减轻这些错误和冲突，已提出了大量方法和框架。本文聚焦于在IoT系统背景下冲突分类和检测方法，通过研究当前在IoT系统中提供冲突分类或检测的研究技术（发表于2014年至2020年）。提出了基于IoT应用交互冲突的分类。所提出的冲突分类基于对IoT应用指令关系的分析，利用最新的满足性模理论（SMT）模型检查和形式化表示，提供了一种先验冲突检测方法。根据所提出的冲突分类，将当前的检测方法相互比较，以确定它们覆盖不同冲突的程度。基于此比较，我们提供了证据，表明现有方法在覆盖不同冲突级别和类型方面存在差距，这导致降低了IoT系统的正确性和安全性。我们指出需要开发用于IoT系统的安全性和保密性编译器或工具。此外，我们建议使用一种混合方法，将模型检查与多种语言和语义技术相结合，以开发未来的基于IoT应用的验证框架，以覆盖所有级别和类型的冲突。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）

基本报告：
- 文章写作清晰易懂，但仍需进一步校对。
- 图中的字体大小应更优化，以便打印阅读。
- 技术关键词介绍得当。
- 然而，标题表明文章专针对BAS（楼宇自动化系统），而目标论文包括通用的物联网（IoT）论文。作者应澄清在冲突分类方面的差异。关于调查标题，我们已将其编辑为“基于物联网服务的冲突分类：比较性综述”，这将适用于调查中提到的所有论文。摘要和调查背景已从专注于BAS调整为IoT系统，并进行了全面的校对。对于图表，我们几乎编辑了所有图表（见图3至图13），特别是根据表1中提供的正式符号对冲突图表进行了编辑。

实验设计：
这是一篇关于物联网/BAS应用和系统冲突检测的综合性综述论文。审稿人赞赏作者的贡献，并提出了几条建议以进一步改进研究。

结果的有效性：
作者的其他论文（Ibrhim等，2020）在表2的最后一行中被突出显示。虽然引用他们的论文并无不公，但作者应总结其论文为何在自身标准下脱颖而出的基本理由。本文调查与（Ibrhim等，2020）之间的基本理由在一段文字中进行了总结（第769至784行）。总体而言，（Ibrhim等，2020）中提出的RVF框架使用相同的SMT模型检查器来检测冲突，并采用了与本文调查中描述的相同的规则关系分析。审稿人发现了对技术的总结，但对其为何能超越其他技术的洞察不足。我们在“讨论”部分（第725至831行）编辑了洞察内容，以突出我们从调查中获得的优势。总结来说，调查显示了当前工作中在稀疏关注冲突检测且未涵盖不同冲突类型、当前验证和检测方法的不足、现有技术仅关注IoT应用而忽略检查系统策略本身、建议在不同层次进行交互冲突的检查和检测、提到需要一种标准表示法来涵盖不同IoT平台（例如，SmartThings、IFTTT、Zapier、OpenHAB等）的自动化服务规则和系统策略，并在物联网系统验证背景下开辟了开发定制或领域特定编译器的新研究方向。审稿人建议作者再次审查论文的覆盖范围，特别是许多论文忽略“系统策略”的论点。系统策略通常在其他自动化服务规则中表达。更进一步，DepSys论文确实将系统策略建模为“需求依赖”。是的，您是对的。我们提到了（第70至74行）前人工作中使用的“系统策略”的不同同义词，如（Munir和Stankovic，2014）中的“需求依赖”、（Zhang等，2019a）中的“属性”、（Guilly等，2015）中的“约束”、（Pẽna等，2016）中的能源效率指标以及（Nagendra等，2019）中的“设备通信策略”，而（Cheng等，2014）的工作以不同方式使用策略，以解决不同用户之间的冲突。DepSys和其他论文在“当前冲突分类和检测方法”部分（第357至362行、第366至369行和第412至417行）以及表2中进行了修订和编辑。对于IRON论文，认为所提出的工具“不适合非技术用户”是不公平的，因为大多数规则检测技术仍处于算法层面，而该论文提出了更多用于可用性的工具。我们删除了IRON论文描述中的这一声明，并编辑了其解释（第373至377行），以澄清使用IRON语言创建IoT应用需要程序员了解设备的属性（Int或Boolean物理或逻辑——是否有约束），这对普通用户在开发应用时是一个负担。对于读者来说，验证某些技术缺乏冲突类型覆盖是一个很大的负担。因此，审稿人建议作者举例说明几篇论文，解释它们为何在覆盖某些冲突类型方面存在不足，以解释表2。我们添加了7个其他论文的例子（第748至768行），并解释了未覆盖某些冲突的原因。例如，（Celik等，2019b）中的IoTGuard未能检测到JBsC冲突，因为他们的工作生成的统一动态模型要求IoT应用具有事件链。（Vannucchi等，2017）使用不同的方式检测冲突，其中包括不变量来检测冲突，且依赖于单个IoT应用及其不变量。虽然作者在摘要中通过推荐混合模型检查得出结论，但正文的论证较弱。作者可以分配几段文字来解释这一点。我们在两段文字中提到（第785至812行），现有冲突检测方法在覆盖不同层次和类型的冲突方面的不足，每种方法使用不同的工具来推理少量冲突。因此，为了解决这些问题，我们建议使用一种混合方法，将模型检查与多种语言和语义技术相结合，以开发未来的基于物联网的应用验证框架，覆盖所有层次和类型的冲突，以确保和最大化物联网系统的安全性、保密性和正确性。

对作者的建议：
本文综述了关于冲突类型和检测的综合性论文列表，并提出了分类。所提出的分类对于评估现有和未来的框架非常有帮助。

reasons: While it is not unfair to cite their papers, the authors should summarize the basic rationale of why their paper is standing out in terms of their own criteria.
The review found the summary of the technology but not much insight about why it can beat the other technologies.
While the authors conclude in the abstract by recommending hybrid model checking, the reasoning is weak in the body.
The proposed categories are very helpful for evaluating existing and future frameworks.

paper_title: Oligodendrocytes, BK channels and the preservation of myelin
paper_abstract: Oligodendrocytes wrap multiple lamellae of their membrane, myelin, around axons of the central nervous system (CNS), to improve impulse conduction. Myelin synthesis is specialised and dynamic, responsive to local neuronal excitation. Subtle pathological insults are sufficient to cause significant neuronal metabolic impairment, so myelin preservation is necessary to safeguard neural networks. Multiple sclerosis (MS) is the most prevalent demyelinating disease of the CNS. In MS, inflammatory attacks against myelin, proposed to be autoimmune, cause myelin decay and oligodendrocyte loss, leaving neurons vulnerable. Current therapies target the prominent neuroinflammation but are mostly ineffective in protecting from neurodegeneration and the progressive neurological disability. People with MS have substantially higher levels of extracellular glutamate, the main excitatory neurotransmitter. This impairs cellular homeostasis to cause excitotoxic stress. Large conductance Ca2 + -activated K +  channels (BK channels) could preserve myelin or allow its recovery by protecting cells from the resulting excessive excitability. This review evaluates the role of excitotoxic stress, myelination and BK channels in MS pathology, and explores the hypothesis that BK channel activation could be a therapeutic strategy to protect oligodendrocytes from excitotoxic stress in MS. This could reduce progression of neurological disability if used in parallel to immunomodulatory therapies.
review_content:
Is the topic of the review discussed comprehensively in the context of the current literature?

In the review by Rupnik et al., the role of excitotoxicity in oligodendrocytes was approached through a physiological, clinical, and biophysical perspective, which allows the reader to understand the basics on the origin, progression, and possible therapies for diseases associated with demyelination.

Are all factual statements correct and adequately supported by citations?

In the manuscript by Rupnik et al., the statements were adequately supported by citations which included some classic works (Hursh, 19391; Waxman et al., 19772; Waxman et al., 19843) and articles published in the last ten years.

Is the review written in accessible language?

The review was written fluently, clearly and the topics were discussed deeply enough. The structure of the paper was clearly defined at the beginning of the text (page 3).

Are the conclusions drawn appropriate in the context of the current research literature?

The authors summarized the causes and effects of oligodendrocytes toxicity and proposed an alternative therapy to treat pathologies associated with demyelination. One strategy involves modulation of the large conductance, Ca2+ and voltage-activated BKCa channel, which activation might prevent Ca2+ overload to protect oligodendrocytes from excitotoxic stress. Of note, a similar mechanism has been observed in cardiac mitochondria in rodents, where the BKCa channel expresses and its activation reduces the driving force for Ca2+, preventing overload and cell death (Singh et al., 20134; Balderas et al., 20195). Moreover, as observed in cardiac mitochondria, the functional association of mitoBKCa with regulatory subunits β1 broadens the spectrum of molecular targets suitable for the development of new and more directed therapies.
Targeting the pore forming BKCa channel α-subunit with current and novel drugs needs to overcome the broad localization of the channel in brain cells. Considering that BKCa is expressed ubiquitously in brain cells it is essential to establish the differential and perhaps localized expression of BKCa channels and/or its regulatory subunits (β1-4; γ1-4) in oligodendrocytes. This would allow designing a more specific therapy alternative to immunosuppressive agents.


In summary, the review presented by Rupnik and coworkers represents a good collection of most recent information in the field of oligodendrocytes and the pathologies associated with demyelination, highlighting a possible role of the BKCa channel in preventing Ca2+ overload and reducing excitotoxic stress.
Our main suggestion would be to include a comment on the importance of the expression and association with BKCa-regulatory subunits and their possible use as novel targets for future therapies.
paper_title_zh: 少突胶质细胞、BK通道与髓鞘的保护
paper_abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞将其膜的多层薄片——髓鞘，包裹在中枢神经系统（CNS）的轴突周围，以改善冲动传导。髓鞘合成是特化且动态的，能够响应局部神经元的兴奋。微小的病理损伤足以引起显著的神经元代谢障碍，因此髓鞘的保存对于保护神经网络是必要的。多发性硬化症（MS）是CNS中最常见的脱髓鞘疾病。在MS中，针对髓鞘的炎症攻击（被认为是自身免疫性的）导致髓鞘退化和少突胶质细胞丢失，使神经元变得脆弱。当前的治疗方法主要针对显著的神经炎症，但在保护神经退化和进行性神经功能障碍方面大多无效。MS患者体内的细胞外谷氨酸水平显著升高，谷氨酸是主要的兴奋性神经递质。这会损害细胞稳态，导致兴奋性毒性应激。大电导Ca2+-激活K+通道（BK通道）可能通过保护细胞免受过度兴奋的影响来保存髓鞘或促进其恢复。本文综述了兴奋性毒性应激、髓鞘形成和BK通道在MS病理中的作用，并探讨了BK通道激活作为一种治疗策略的可能性，以保护MS中的少突胶质细胞免受兴奋性毒性应激的影响。如果与免疫调节疗法并行使用，这可能减少神经功能障碍的进展。
review_content_zh:
该评论的主题是否在当前文献背景下进行了全面讨论？

在Rupnik等人撰写的评论中，通过生理学、临床和生物物理学的视角探讨了少突胶质细胞中兴奋毒性的作用，使读者能够理解与脱髓鞘疾病相关的起源、进展和可能疗法的基础知识。

所有事实性陈述是否正确并得到了充分的引用支持？

在Rupnik等人的手稿中，陈述得到了充分的引用支持，其中包括一些经典著作（Hursh, 19391; Waxman et al., 19772; Waxman et al., 19843）以及过去十年内发表的文章。

评论是否使用了易于理解的语言？

该评论写作流畅、清晰，主题讨论深入。文章结构在文本开头（第3页）有明确的定义。

结论在当前研究文献背景下是否适当？

作者总结了少突胶质细胞毒性的原因和影响，并提出了一种替代疗法来治疗与脱髓鞘相关的病理状况。其中一种策略涉及调节大电导、Ca2+和电压激活的BKCa通道，其激活可能防止Ca2+过载，保护少突胶质细胞免受兴奋毒性应激。值得注意的是，类似机制已在啮齿动物的心脏线粒体中观察到，其中BKCa通道表达，其激活减少了Ca2+的驱动力，防止过载和细胞死亡（Singh et al., 20134; Balderas et al., 20195）。此外，正如在心脏线粒体中所观察到的，mitoBKCa与调节亚基β1的功能性关联拓宽了适合开发新型和更有针对性疗法的分子靶标谱。针对BKCa通道α亚基（孔形成亚基）使用现有和新药物需要克服该通道在大脑细胞中的广泛定位。考虑到BKCa在脑细胞中普遍表达，因此有必要确定BKCa通道及其调节亚基（β1-4；γ1-4）在少突胶质细胞中的差异和可能的局部表达。这将有助于设计一种更具体的替代免疫抑制剂的疗法。

总之，Rupnik及其同事呈现的评论汇集了少突胶质细胞领域及其与脱髓鞘相关病理学的最新信息，突出了BKCa通道在防止Ca2+过载和减少兴奋毒性应激中的可能作用。
我们的主要建议是增加对BKCa调节亚基的表达和关联重要性的评论，以及它们作为未来疗法新靶标的可能用途。

reasons: In the review by Rupnik et al., the role of excitotoxicity in oligodendrocytes was approached through a physiological, clinical, and biophysical perspective, which allows the reader to understand the basics on the origin, progression, and possible therapies for diseases associated with demyelination.

In the manuscript by Rupnik et al., the statements were adequately supported by citations which included some classic works (Hursh, 19391; Waxman et al., 19772; Waxman et al., 19843) and articles published in the last ten years.

Moreover, as observed in cardiac mitochondria, the functional association of mitoBKCa with regulatory subunits β1 broadens the spectrum of molecular targets suitable for the development of new and more directed therapies.

Considering that BKCa is expressed ubiquitously in brain cells it is essential to establish the differential and perhaps localized expression of BKCa channels and/or its regulatory subunits (β1-4; γ1-4) in oligodendrocytes.
This would allow designing a more specific therapy alternative to immunosuppressive agents.
Our main suggestion would be to include a comment on the importance of the expression and association with BKCa-regulatory subunits and their possible use as novel targets for future therapies.
The review was written fluently, clearly and the topics were discussed deeply enough.
The structure of the paper was clearly defined at the beginning of the text (page 3).

paper_title: Healing through language: Positive physical health effects of indigenous language use
paper_abstract: This article summarizes existing work that indicates language maintenance and revitalization efforts result in health-related benefits for Native Americans and other indigenous populations. Although forced loss of ancestral language has been a feature of life in most indigenous communities since the first contact with Europeans, the pace of loss has accelerated in the past 50 years. Among the many hardships such communities face, an especially troubling one is lowered health status. There are indications, however, that language maintenance and revitalization efforts have positive effects on physical and communal health among indigenous populations. The types of language programs currently in place are outlined along with a variety of studies that will measure health improvement outcomes correlated with language revitalization efforts. Such evidence justifies increased support for language revitalization in order to improve health.
review_content:
This is a timely and important article. Indigenous peoples continue to voice the importance of culture and language revitalization for their well-being. As a result, more and more research is being conducted linking language and health in Indigenous populations. A review or summary of that work is needed, hence the current article. I commend the authors for undertaking this vital task. Generally, the article is well written and informative. However, I found that some sections were not thoroughly explored and the authors would do well by deepening their literature review and expanding on their ideas. My comments are as follows:
 1. I suggest the authors capitalize the term “Indigenous” throughout the article.
 2. Abstract, third sentence: it is not clear what the authors mean by “communities” here. Also, compared to what population is their “lowered health status”?
 3. Abstract: it would be useful to add a sentence on how language revitalization is thought to improve health.
 4. Introduction: the authors state that this current article is a survey. This is a bit confusing. The authors should be clear on what type of article this is. It is not a quantitative survey, systematic review, meta-analysis, review, or literature search. As the article is now, an “opinion piece” seems more appropriate. However, I’m hoping that the authors can expand on many of their ideas and explore the known literature further. In which case, the article may be appropriately termed a “review”.
 5. Introduction, paragraph 3, last sentence: I’m not sure that the references cited support the claim being made that language shifts have caused the health deficits we see today among Indigenous populations. Perhaps the authors can rework this sentence.
 6. Health status: this is one of the sections that seems lacking in its scope. Perhaps the authors can expand and describe some of the major health disparities among Indigenous populations. Some epidemiological data would be helpful to the reader to understand the scope of the disparities.
 7. Indigenous language loss and language use: it would be helpful to the reader if the authors provided examples of some of the Indigenous languages. What are some of the major Indigenous languages worldwide? How many are there? How many have been lost? It would also be helpful if the authors provided some data on how much Indigenous languages are being spoken today around the world and in North America.
 8. Existing studies and why focus on language sections: These sections in particular need to be expanded upon. Are the authors able to conduct a formal literature search? Perhaps with keywords? Also, the authors may want to explore and include other literature that has explored the relationship between language/culture and emotional/mental health. The extensive writings of Laurence Kirmayer come to mind as a good place to start. What is explicitly missing from this article is the how piece... How does language revitalization lead to better health? Is it due to enhanced sense of identity (as Chandler and Lalonde argue)? Enhanced spiritual health? Enhanced sense of community/belonging? The provision of strong role models that teach the language? Protection from early life traumas? There is also an entire field of neurological research that has looked at how learning multiple languages can impact the brain and health. The authors would do well to explore these different areas and give the reader an idea on the how. Even looking into some of the qualitative research with Indigenous peoples suffering from some of the major health problems that Indigenous populations face (e.g. diabetes) would be beneficial as often language/culture is brought up as a key determinant of health in these studies. Moreover, has there been research that has shown not shown a relationship between language and health? Lastly, second paragraph, last sentence: Has there been work done that specifically examined language loss and sense of spiritual well-being?
 9. I was pleased that the authors recommend that future studies aimed at language revitalization include assessments of health outcomes. Perhaps the authors could expand on what these health assessments may look like? What should be measured and how?
10. Conclusion: It would make more sense perhaps to include and expand upon the Berry 2012, Gone 2015, and Tullouch 2013 references in the “existing studies” or “why focus on language” sections.
11. Last paragraph of conclusion: the ideas presented in this paragraph seem to come out of nowhere as they have not been discussed earlier in the article. Again, the authors would do well to really spend some time reading and then summarizing in the “existing studies” or “why focus on language” sections the known literature on how and why language revitalization may lead to improved health. These sections are the place (as opposed to the conclusion) to introduce and describe in-depth the other contributors related to speaking an Indigenous language that may be responsible for improved health status.
paper_title_zh: 通过语言治愈：使用土著语言的积极身体健康效应
paper_abstract_zh: 本文总结了现有研究，表明语言维护和复兴工作为美洲原住民和其他土著人口带来了与健康相关的益处。尽管自与欧洲人首次接触以来，被迫丧失祖传语言已成为大多数土著社区生活的一个特征，但过去50年中语言丧失的速度有所加快。在这些社区面临的诸多困难中，尤为令人担忧的是健康状况下降。然而，有迹象表明，语言维护和复兴工作对土著人口的身体健康和社区健康产生了积极影响。本文概述了当前实施的语言项目类型，以及一系列将衡量与语言复兴工作相关的健康改善结果的研究。此类证据证明了增加对语言复兴的支持以改善健康的合理性。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇及时且重要的文章。土著人民持续强调文化和语言复兴对其福祉的重要性。因此，越来越多的研究正在探讨土著人口中语言与健康之间的联系。对这些工作的综述或总结是必要的，因此有了本文。我赞赏作者们承担这一重要任务。总体而言，文章写得很好，信息丰富。然而，我发现有些部分探讨得不够深入，作者们应通过深化文献综述和扩展其观点来改进。我的评论如下：

1. 我建议作者们在整篇文章中将“Indigenous”一词大写。
2. 摘要，第三句：此处作者们所指的“社区”并不明确。此外，他们的“降低的健康状况”是相对于哪个群体而言的？
3. 摘要：增加一句关于语言复兴如何被认为能改善健康的句子会很有用。
4. 引言：作者们称本文为“调查”。这有些令人困惑。作者们应明确本文的类型。它不是定量调查、系统综述、元分析、综述或文献检索。就目前文章而言，“观点文章”似乎更合适。然而，我希望作者们能扩展许多观点并进一步探讨已知文献。在这种情况下，文章可以适当地称为“综述”。
5. 引言，第三段，最后一句：我不确定所引用的参考文献是否支持语言转变导致了今天土著人口中我们所看到的健康赤字的论断。或许作者们可以重写这句话。
6. 健康状况：这是看起来范围不足的章节之一。或许作者们可以扩展并描述土著人口中一些主要的健康差距。一些流行病学数据将有助于读者理解这些差距的范围。
7. 土著语言丧失和语言使用：如果作者们提供一些土著语言的例子，对读者会很有帮助。世界上一些主要的土著语言有哪些？有多少种？有多少已经丧失？如果作者们提供一些关于今天全球和北美土著语言使用情况的数据也会很有帮助。
8. 现有研究和为何关注语言部分：这些部分尤其需要扩展。作者们能否进行正式的文献检索？或许可以使用关键词？此外，作者们可能还想探讨并包括其他探讨了语言/文化与情感/心理健康之间关系的文献。劳伦斯·基尔迈耶的广泛著作是一个很好的起点。本文明确缺失的是“如何”部分……语言复兴如何导致更好的健康？是由于增强了身份认同感（如钱德勒和拉隆德所论证的）？增强了精神健康？增强了社区/归属感？提供了教授语言的强有力榜样？保护免受早期生活创伤？还有一个完整的神经科学研究领域，探讨了学习多种语言如何影响大脑和健康。作者们应探讨这些不同领域，并给读者一个关于“如何”的概念。甚至探讨一些与面临主要健康问题的土著人口（如糖尿病）进行的定性研究也会有益，因为这些研究中常常提到语言/文化是健康的关键决定因素。此外，是否有研究表明语言与健康之间没有关系？最后，第二段，最后一句：是否有专门研究语言丧失和精神福祉感之间关系的工作？
9. 我很高兴作者们建议未来的语言复兴研究包括健康结果的评估。或许作者们可以扩展这些健康评估可能是什么样的？应该测量什么以及如何测量？
10. 结论：或许将Berry 2012、Gone 2015和Tullouch 2013的参考文献包含并扩展到“现有研究”或“为何关注语言”部分会更有意义。
11. 结论的最后一段：本段中提出的观点似乎突如其来，因为它们在文章前面并未讨论过。再次强调，作者们应花时间阅读并在“现有研究”或“为何关注语言”部分总结已知文献，探讨语言复兴如何及为何可能改善健康。这些部分是（相对于结论）引入和深入描述与说土著语言相关的其他可能影响健康状况的因素的地方。

paper_title: Oral hormone pregnancy tests and the risks of congenital malformations: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract:
Background: Oral hormone pregnancy tests (HPTs), such as Primodos, containing ethinylestradiol and high doses of norethisterone, were given to over a million women from 1958 to 1978, when Primodos was withdrawn from the market because of concerns about possible teratogenicity. We aimed to study the association between maternal exposure to oral HPTs and congenital malformations. 
 Methods: We have performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of case-control and cohort studies that included data from pregnant women and were exposed to oral HPTs within the estimated first three months of pregnancy, if compared with a relevant control group. We used random-effects meta-analysis and assessed the quality of each study using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale for non-randomized studies. 
 Results: We found 16 case control studies and 10 prospective cohort studies, together including 71 330 women, of whom 4,209 were exposed to HPTs. Exposure to oral HPTs was associated with a 40% increased risk of all congenital malformations: pooled odds ratio (OR) = 1.40 (95% CI 1.18 to 1.66; P<0.0001; I 2 = 0%). Exposure to HPTs was associated with an increased risk of congenital heart malformations: pooled OR = 1.89 (95% CI 1.32 to 2.72; P = 0.0006; I 2 =0%); nervous system malformations  OR = 2.98 (95% CI 1.32 to 6.76; P = 0.0109 I 2 = 78%); gastrointestinal malformations, OR = 4.50 (95% CI 0.63 to 32.20; P = 0.13; I 2 = 54%); musculoskeletal malformations, OR = 2.24 (95% CI 1.23 to 4.08; P= 0.009; I 2 = 0%); the VACTERL syndrome (Vertebral defects, Anal atresia, Cardiovascular anomalies, Tracheoesophageal fistula, Esophageal atresia, Renal anomalies, and Limb defects), OR = 7.47 (95% CI 2.92 to 19.07; P < 0.0001; I 2 = 0%). 
 Conclusions: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows that use of oral HPTs in pregnancy is associated with increased risks of congenital malformations.
review_content:
This is a timely and much-needed paper that deserves to be widely read and cited. It provides the first systematic review and meta-analysis of old epidemiological data pointing towards a long-acknowledged association between HPTs and birth defects. Most of the paper is devoted to apparently rigorous statistical analysis. We leave constructive criticism of the statistics to other, more appropriately qualified reviewers. Instead, we confine our comments to the historical context and factual details presented in the paper. These, on the whole, are entirely satisfactory. But some minor errors — that do not significantly detract from the overall argument — should be amended:
 1. 'Oral hormone pregnancy tests (HPTs), such as Primodos, containing ethinylestradiol and high doses of norethisterone, were given to over a million women from 1958 to 1978’ (p. 1).

    It is worth clarifying that HPTs were available as injections from 1950 and in tablet form (e.g., Schering’s Orasecron, Roussel’s Amenorone Forte), in the UK, from at least 1956. See, for example, Britton (19561); and https://archive.org/details/b19974760M4180/page/n45?q=amenorone+1956. For an extended discussion, see Olszynko-Gryn (2014), available for download here. Furthermore, not all HPTs contained norethisterone; different companies used other types of synthetic progesterone, and the same goes for ethinylestradiol.

 2. ‘Oral hormone pregnancy tests (HPTs), such as Primodos (known as Duogynon in Germany), were used from 1958 to 1978, before urine pregnancy tests were available’ (p. 3).

    Contrary to popular belief, urine pregnancy tests were in fact widely though unevenly available between 1958 and 1978 and HPTs were never the dominant method of pregnancy testing. For a detailed timeline of pregnancy testing in the UK, please see Olszynko-Gryn et al. (20182), esp. pp. 35-36. It would also be helpful to clarify that HPTs were removed from UK market in 1978, but earlier and later elsewhere. See Olszynko-Gryn et al. (20182) for details (pp. 41-42).

 3. ‘The test principle was that menstruation would be induced in those who were not pregnant’ (p.3).

    At the time HPTs were variously described as ‘clinical’, ‘hormonal’, or ‘withdrawal bleeding’ pregnancy tests and it would be more precise to refer to their effect as inducing menstrual-like withdrawal bleeding, which is not identical to menstruation.

 4. Worth mentioning that Gal 1967, though a highly significant intervention, was not the first published warning against HPTs; these began to appear as early as 1956, in response to marketing literature aimed at GPs. See Britton (19561) and Olszynko-Gryn et al. (20182), p. 36.

 5. ‘However, we believe that this systematic review shows an association of oral HPTs with congenital malformations’ (p. 17).

    More optionally, the authors might consider reflecting on the extent to which the association they identify implies a causal association. An association between the use of HPTs and birth defects has long been recognised and was rarely in dispute. Many experts explained the association in terms of a suspected though as unknown direct mechanistic effect of HPTs on the developing human embryo. Others, however, preferred to explain the association in terms of underlying factors, e.g., a patient history of miscarriage or birth defects. This view, which still has traction in some quarters, is discussed to some extent in Olszynko-Gryn et al. (20182) (pp. 39-41). The authors might usefully offer a fresh perspective based on their findings, in the Conclusion and/or in the interesting discussion of unknown mechanisms on p. 16.
paper_title_zh: 口服激素妊娠试验与先天性畸形风险：系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：口服激素妊娠试验（HPTs），如含有炔雌醇和高剂量炔诺酮的Primodos，在1958年至1978年间被给予超过一百万名女性，当时Primodos因可能具有致畸性而从市场上撤回。我们旨在研究母体暴露于口服HPTs与先天性畸形之间的关联。

方法：我们对包括孕妇数据并在怀孕前三个月内暴露于口服HPTs的病例对照研究和队列研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析，并与相关对照组进行比较。我们使用随机效应荟萃分析，并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华非随机研究量表评估每项研究的质量。

结果：我们发现了16项病例对照研究和10项前瞻性队列研究，共包括71,330名女性，其中4,209名暴露于HPTs。暴露于口服HPTs与所有先天性畸形风险增加40%相关：合并比值比（OR）= 1.40（95% CI 1.18至1.66；P<0.0001；I²=0%）。暴露于HPTs与先天性心脏畸形风险增加相关：合并OR = 1.89（95% CI 1.32至2.72；P=0.0006；I²=0%）；神经系统畸形OR = 2.98（95% CI 1.32至6.76；P=0.0109；I²=78%）；胃肠道畸形OR = 4.50（95% CI 0.63至32.20；P=0.13；I²=54%）；肌肉骨骼畸形OR = 2.24（95% CI 1.23至4.08；P=0.009；I²=0%）；VACTERL综合征（脊椎缺陷、肛门闭锁、心血管异常、气管食管瘘、食管闭锁、肾脏异常和肢体缺陷）OR = 7.47（95% CI 2.92至19.07；P<0.0001；I²=0%）。

结论：这项系统综述和荟萃分析表明，孕期使用口服HPTs与先天性畸形风险增加相关。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇及时且非常必要的论文，值得广泛阅读和引用。它首次系统地回顾和元分析了旧有的流行病学数据，指向长期以来公认的HPTs与出生缺陷之间的关联。论文的大部分内容致力于看似严谨的统计分析。我们将对统计的积极批评留给其他更有资格的评审者。相反，我们将评论限于论文中呈现的历史背景和事实细节。总体而言，这些内容完全令人满意。但一些小错误——虽然不显著影响整体论点——应予以修正：

1. “口服激素妊娠试验（HPTs），如含有炔雌醇和高剂量炔诺酮的Primodos，在1958年至1978年间被给予超过一百万名女性”（第1页）。

    值得澄清的是，HPTs自1950年起以注射形式存在，并在英国至少自1956年起以片剂形式（例如，Schering的Orasecron，Roussel的Amenorone Forte）出现。例如，参见Britton（19561）；以及https://archive.org/details/b19974760M4180/page/n45?q=amenorone+1956。更详细的讨论，参见Olszynko-Gryn（2014），可在此下载。此外，并非所有HPTs都含有炔诺酮；不同公司使用其他类型的合成孕酮，炔雌醇亦是如此。

2. “口服激素妊娠试验（HPTs），如Primodos（在德国称为Duogynon），在1958年至1978年间使用，当时尿妊娠试验尚未普及”（第3页）。

    与普遍看法相反，尿妊娠试验在1958年至1978年间实际上广泛但不均匀地可用，HPTs从未成为妊娠测试的主导方法。关于英国妊娠测试的详细时间线，请参见Olszynko-Gryn等人（20182），特别是第35-36页。还应澄清的是，HPTs在1978年从英国市场撤出，但在其他地方早些或晚些时候撤出。详情参见Olszynko-Gryn等人（20182），第41-42页。

3. “测试原理是诱导非怀孕者月经”（第3页）。

    当时的HPTs被 variously described as ‘临床’、‘激素’或‘撤退性出血’妊娠试验，更准确的说法是它们诱导类似月经的撤退性出血，这与月经并不完全相同。

4. 值得一提的是，Gal 1967虽然是一个极其重要的干预，但并非首次发表的针对HPTs的警告；这些警告最早出现在1956年，作为对针对全科医生的营销文献的回应。参见Britton（19561）和Olszynko-Gryn等人（20182），第36页。

5. “然而，我们认为这一系统回顾显示了口服HPTs与先天性畸形之间的关联”（第17页）。

    更可选择的是，作者们可以考虑反思他们所识别的关联在多大程度上暗示了因果关系。HPTs使用与出生缺陷之间的关联早已被认识，且鲜有争议。许多专家解释这一关联时，认为是HPTs对发育中的人类胚胎的疑似但未知的直接机械效应。然而，其他人更倾向于用潜在因素来解释这一关联，例如，患者的流产或出生缺陷史。这一观点在某些领域仍有一定影响力，在Olszynko-Gryn等人（20182）中有一定讨论（第39-41页）。作者们或许可以基于他们的发现，在结论和/或第16页关于未知机制的有趣讨论中，提供一个新的视角。

paper_title: Strategies for promoting sustainable use and conservation of indigenous chicken breeds in Sub-Saharan Africa: Lessons from low-income countries
paper_abstract: This review explores innovative and sustainable strategies for the utilization and conservation of indigenous chickens (IC) (Gallus domesticus) in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), drawing lessons from selected low-income countries. Small-scale farmers (SSF) have kept IC for hundreds of years to meet their households’ nutritional needs, incomes, and social-cultural and religious uses. The commitment exhibited by SSF to keeping IC has made them the significant custodians of essential animal genetic resources AnGR in most low-income countries. Between 1991 and 2012, Zambia’s private breeders invested over US$95 million in the commercial poultry sector, resulting in over a 100% increase in the annual production of day-old chicks to 65 million. However, high production costs and low market access hindered rural farmers’ full participation, hence their continued dependence on IC breeds. The erosion of AnGR poses the biggest threat to IC in SSA. The Food and Agriculture Organisation, an international body of the United Nations, highlighted that over 3.5% (60) of chicken breeds were extinct, 21.3% (368) were at risk of extinction, and nearly 67% (1068) were under unknown risk status. The report stated that 12.3% of the known chicken breeds were not at risk. Poultry diseases, lack of sustainable conservation strategies and poor use have significantly contributed to these losses. In 2012, 60% of IC were reportedly diseased in parts of SSA. The continued loss of IC-AnGR may negatively impact rural livelihoods and impede future poultry research and breeding programs. This paper reviews the IC sector in SSA, the socioeconomic, cultural and religious roles of IC and lessons on researcher-community-stakeholder strategies from selected low-income countries. The paper concludes and outlines some recommendations for future research.
review_content: The article covers all aspects concerning indigenous chickens in Sub Saharan Africa with verifiable examples provided through citations. The article also attempts to provide a direction through which Indigenous Chicken producers and producers, can create a platform that will be mutually beneficial to both stakeholders. The article has no bias.
paper_title_zh: 促进撒哈拉以南非洲本土鸡种可持续利用与保护的策略：来自低收入国家的经验教训
paper_abstract_zh: 本文综述了在撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）利用和保育本地鸡（IC）（Gallus domesticus）的创新和可持续策略，借鉴了选定的低收入国家的经验。小规模农户（SSF）数百年来一直饲养本地鸡，以满足其家庭营养需求、收入以及社会文化及宗教用途。SSF对饲养本地鸡的承诺使他们成为大多数低收入国家重要动物遗传资源（AnGR）的显著守护者。1991年至2012年间，赞比亚的私人育种者在商业家禽部门投资超过9500万美元，导致一日龄雏鸡的年产量增加了100%以上，达到6500万只。然而，高昂的生产成本和低市场准入阻碍了农村农户的充分参与，因此他们继续依赖本地鸡品种。AnGR的侵蚀对SSA的本地鸡构成了最大威胁。联合国国际机构粮食及农业组织指出，超过3.5%（60种）的鸡品种已灭绝，21.3%（368种）面临灭绝风险，近67%（1068种）处于未知风险状态。报告指出，12.3%的已知鸡品种没有风险。家禽疾病、缺乏可持续的保育策略和利用不当显著导致了这些损失。2012年，据报道SSA部分地区60%的本地鸡患有疾病。IC-AnGR的持续损失可能对农村生计产生负面影响，并阻碍未来的家禽研究和育种计划。本文综述了SSA的本地鸡行业、本地鸡的社会经济、文化和宗教角色，以及从选定的低收入国家中汲取的研究者-社区-利益相关者策略的经验教训。文章最后总结并提出了一些建议，以供未来研究参考。
review_content_zh: 该文章涵盖了撒哈拉以南非洲本土鸡的所有相关方面，并通过引文提供了可验证的实例。文章还试图指出一个方向，通过这一方向，本土鸡生产者和相关生产者可以创建一个对双方利益相关者均有益的平台。该文章没有偏见。

paper_title: On AI-centered Retrosynthetic Planning: a Survey
paper_abstract: Retrosynthetic planning is one of the most challenging problems in organic chemistry up to date. It involves designing a target molecule by recursively decomposing it into simpler molecules through a series of backward chemical reaction steps. Typically, these simpler molecules are either commercially available or easy to synthesize. The development of new computer-aided retrosynthetic methods can advance the development of target molecules in drug design, material science and agrochemicals. This paper presents the retrosynthetic planning problem and the current AI-based methods. We conduct an in-depth review of the application of AI-based methods to retrosynthetic planning while also presenting the current challenges and potential future research directions.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper reviews existing works on reaction prediction and retrosynthetic planning. It explains the underlying concepts and tries to systematically categorize existing approaches on several axes. Finally, it provides an outlook for what future work in this domain may bring.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
=== Strengths === (S1): Retrosynthesis is an important topic in computer-assisted drug design. Summarizing the existing body of works is a useful and timely effort, especially given the generally growing interest in applying AI to scientific domains. (S2): The work does a reasonable job gathering many references to prior works, also trying to cover older expert-based approaches. === Weaknesses === (W1): The paper makes fundamental errors confounding single-step reaction prediction with multi-step planning. In most cases, single-step prediction (predicting viable reactant sets given a product) is considered a separate problem from multi-step planning (chaining single-step predictions into entire synthesis plans), and the techniques are usually different as well (the former is a prediction problem, while the latter is a planning problem). There are exceptions to this that e.g. feed an entire search graph into an ML model [1], and it's important to benchmark both elements jointly [2, 5], but in most cases the choice of the single-step model and the choice of the search algorithm are nearly orthogonal. In contrast, the proposed paper confuses the two, and claims several times (both in the text, e.g. "strong template-based methods are based on tree search", and in the taxonomy in Figure 3) that multi-step search algorithms are a subclass of template-based models, which is just not true; many prior works run search using template-free or semi-template-based models as well [2-4]. I would recommend making a clear distinction between single-step and multi-step, noting where the algorithms can be combined freely and where there could be potential problems or constraints. On that note, I don't like the design of Table 1 that lists papers and contains a binary "Multi-step" column to denote whether a particular paper has done something with multi-step, because it again confounds the fact that some papers introduce both a single-step model and a planning algorithm, but the former is not "multi-step", it just happens to appear in a paper that also does multi-step benchmarking. I would rather see two separate tables for single-step and multi-step, and also perhaps a separate note of which pairs were so far combined with each other in existing works. (W2): Overall I found that the way prior works are organized and summarized is not very helpful. For example, the main taxonomy in Table 1 includes a binary "USPTO" column for whether a particular paper used one of the USPTO derivatives. This is not inherent to a particular method, and so I'd rather not have that in the high-level comparison, and additionally have separate tables to aggregate results per dataset, differentiating between different USPTO derivative datasets appropriately. It also has an accuracy column which is said to contain some top-k values but the k and dataset varies; the paper thus shows statistics of the form "paper A reported accuracies between 58 and 88, while paper B reported between 64 and 73", but these were measured differently on different datasets, so it doesn't seem particularly useful. I would hope for a more systematic and useful breakdown of the different methods, which would require many tables looking at different axes of comparison. (W3): I found the paper rather hard to parse, and I feel that a reader who is not already familiar with the discussed concepts would not benefit from reading it in the current form, or may even become confused due to unclear explanations. Some examples of statements which wouldn't be clear to a reader who is new to the topic: - "RP can be formulated as a tree." - again we should be clear we mean multi-step planning here, and "tree" should probably rather say "tree search problem" - "number of transformations at each level in the tree for simpler molecules ranges between 80-4000" - unclear what this refers to (number of valid single-step reactions for a single target molecule? number of nodes at a particular depth in a typical search?) - "Template-free methods also require a database of chemical reactions in the form of product-reactant mappings" - unclear if this refers to mappings in the sense of atom mappings (which, by the way, are referred to at the bottom of page 4 yet don't seem to be explained), or mapping in the sense of mapping products to valid sets of reactants; in the former sense this sentence is not true, and in the latter sense it seems obvious, as it's essentially stating that a template-free model also requires training data (which is true for all models) - "σ includes a set of reaction parameters e.g. reagents that control the single-step chemical reaction" - not clear how this feeds into the MDP (one could imagine this to be included in the output from a reaction prediction model and thus part of the transition P?) - "mapping P : S × A → 2^S is one-to-many mapping" - unclear (my understanding is that P is a mathematical function and thus returns a single reactant set; perhaps if one imagines a mapping from S without A then it would be one-to-many) - "transition probability P is non-deterministic and thus can result in exponential branching" - unclear - Discussion of parallelization is not clear (e.g. unclear whether the parallelization is across multiple target molecules or across expanding a search tree for a single molecule in several places at the same time) (W4): While many existing papers and references are already included, a review paper should hopefully be exhaustive, so some more references listed in the "References" section of my review could also be included. Specifically, things that could also be mentioned include: - Pistachio dataset [8] which was also used in some of the works, either for testing generalization [2] or for pretraining [10] - More single-step models: [7] - More search algorithms: [1, 9] - Papers performing a holistic evaluation of several approaches and discussing potential pitfalls: [2-5] Finally, there is also some work on retrosynthesis-driven drug-design [6] which often doesn't follow the backward retrosynthetic search blueprint, which may be out of scope for this review, depending on the authors' preference. (W5): The paper appears to be generally not very well-written, containing typos throughout (see "Nitpicks" section for some examples). === Nitpicks === Below I list various grammar issues, typos, or broken sentences; this list is not exhaustive but is a representative sample of where one could start improving the work. - "involves the process of designing a target molecule by recursively decomposing it into simpler molecules" (abstract) - the word "designing" could be confusing here, as one could imagine it refers to drug-design, whereas typically retrosynthetic planning is done with a concrete target molecule in mind (although there are exceptions of course [6]) - "Squares represent reaction nodes and molecules represented by the circles." - misusing "e.g." in places "i.e." would fit better - "are interpretable and can model diverse chemical relationships while also being interpretable" - some punctuation marks missing e.g. after "g" in "e.g." - Figures 2 and 3 largely overlap in their purpose - "molcule" in Figure 2 - "SMILES are mostly used to encode general molecular subgraph patterns" - do you mean SMARTS? - "SMART-based" - "e = (v_i ,v_j ,b) where v_i and v_j are the atoms connected by the bond b" - explain b - "obtained by through" - "can identified automatically" - "bond types - single (-) or ( )" - please explicitly explain that single bonds are sometimes implicit instead of writing "( )" - "Semi-template RP attempts to some of these challenges" - "Se2Seq" - "Criticv" - "Retrosyntic" in Figure 3 - "deepspeeed" - "optimizing one-step RP with RL" - "as a result of the sub-optimality, in consequence of the sub-optimality" === References === [1] Liu et al, "FusionRetro: Molecule Representation Fusion via In-Context Learning for Retrosynthetic Planning" [2] Maziarz et al, "Re-evaluating Retrosynthesis Algorithms with Syntheseus" [3] Hassen et al, "Mind the Retrosynthesis Gap: Bridging the divide between Single-step and Multi-step Retrosynthesis Prediction" [4] Torren-Peraire et al, "Models Matter: The Impact of Single-Step Retrosynthesis on Synthesis Planning" [5] Tripp et al, "Re-evaluating Chemical Synthesis Planning Algorithms" [6] Bradshaw et al, "A Model to Search for Synthesizable Molecules" [7] Zhong et al, "Root-aligned SMILES: A Tight Representation for Chemical Reaction Prediction" [8] Mayfield et al, "Pistachio: Search and Faceting of Large Reaction Databases" [9] Tripp et al, "Retro-fallback: retrosynthetic planning in an uncertain world" [10] Jiang et al, "Learning chemical rules of retrosynthesis with pre-training"

**Requested Changes:**
While the work done by the authors is a good initial step, I believe the paper would need a major revision to be acceptable for publication at TMLR. I would request for the points listed in the "Weaknesses" section be addressed first.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
As this is a review paper, I believe it poses no ethical risks or concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 关于以人工智能为中心的逆合成规划：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 逆合成规划是有机化学中迄今为止最具挑战性的问题之一。它涉及通过一系列逆向化学反应步骤递归地将目标分子分解为更简单的分子来设计目标分子。通常，这些更简单的分子要么是商业可获得的，要么是易于合成的。新计算机辅助逆合成方法的发展可以推进药物设计、材料科学和农药领域中目标分子的开发。本文介绍了逆合成规划问题及当前的基于人工智能的方法。我们对基于人工智能的方法在逆合成规划中的应用进行了深入综述，同时提出了当前的挑战和潜在的未来研究方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文回顾了现有关于反应预测和逆合成规划的研究工作。解释了相关概念，并试图在多个维度上系统地对现有方法进行分类。最后，展望了该领域未来工作的可能方向。

**优点与缺点：**
=== 优点 ===
(S1)：逆合成是计算机辅助药物设计中的一个重要课题。总结现有研究是一项有用且及时的工作，尤其是在当前对将人工智能应用于科学领域日益增长的兴趣背景下。
(S2)：本文在收集大量前期研究文献方面做得较为合理，也试图涵盖较老的基于专家的方法。

=== 缺点 ===
(W1)：本文在基本概念上存在错误，混淆了单步反应预测与多步规划。在大多数情况下，单步预测（给定产物预测可行的反应物集合）被视为与多步规划（将单步预测串联成完整的合成计划）不同的问题，且所使用的技术通常也不同（前者是预测问题，而后者是规划问题）。虽然存在例外情况，例如将整个搜索图输入到机器学习模型中[1]，并且重要的是要联合评估这两个元素[2, 5]，但在大多数情况下，单步模型的选择和搜索算法的选择几乎是正交的。相反，本文将两者混淆，并在多处（无论是在文本中，例如“强模板方法基于树搜索”，还是在图3的分类中）声称多步搜索算法是模板模型的子类，这根本不正确；许多前期研究使用无模板或半模板模型进行搜索[2-4]。建议明确区分单步和多步，指出算法可以自由结合的地方以及可能存在潜在问题或约束的地方。在此前提下，我不喜欢表1的设计，该表列出了文献并包含一个二进制的“多步”列来表示某篇文献是否进行了多步相关的研究，因为这再次混淆了某些文献既引入了单步模型又引入了规划算法的事实，但前者并非“多步”，只是恰好出现在也进行了多步基准测试的文献中。我更希望看到分别针对单步和多步的两个独立表格，并且或许可以单独注明哪些组合在现有研究中已被结合使用。

(W2)：总体而言，我发现前期研究的组织和总结方式不太有帮助。例如，表1中的主要分类包含一个二进制的“USPTO”列，用于表示某篇文献是否使用了USPTO的衍生数据。 这并非特定方法的固有特性，因此我更倾向于不将其纳入高层次的比较中，并且另外制作单独的表格来按数据集汇总结果，适当区分不同的USPTO衍生数据集。此外，还有一个准确度列，据说包含一些top-k值，但k和数据集各不相同；因此，论文展示了如下形式的统计数据：“论文A报告的准确度在58到88之间，而论文B报告的准确度在64到73之间”，但这些是在不同数据集上以不同方式测量的，因此似乎并不特别有用。我希望有一个更系统、更有用的不同方法的分解，这将需要许多表格来查看不同的比较维度。（W3）：我发现这篇论文相当难以解析，我觉得不熟悉所讨论概念的读者在当前形式下阅读它不会受益，甚至可能会因为解释不清而感到困惑。一些对初学者来说不清楚的陈述示例：- “RP可以表述为一棵树。”——我们应当明确这里指的是多步规划，而“树”可能更应该说是“树搜索问题”。- “树中每个级别的转换数量在80-4000之间” ——不清楚这指的是什么（单个目标分子的有效单步反应数量？典型搜索中特定深度的节点数量？）。- “无模板方法还需要一个以产物-反应物映射形式的化学反应数据库”——不清楚这是指原子映射（顺便提一下，这在第4页底部被提及但似乎没有解释），还是指将产物映射到有效反应物集合的映射；在前一种意义上这句话不成立，而在后一种意义上这似乎是显而易见的，因为它本质上是在说无模板模型也需要训练数据（这对所有模型都是成立的）。- “σ包括一组反应参数，例如控制单步化学反应的试剂”——不清楚这是如何融入MDP的（可以想象这包含在反应预测模型的输出中，从而成为转换P的一部分？）。- “映射P : S × A → 2^S 是一对多映射”——不清楚（我的理解是P是一个数学函数，因此返回单个反应物集合；也许如果想象一个没有A的S的映射，那将是一对多）。- “转换概率P是非确定性的，因此可能导致指数级分支”——不清楚。- 并行化的讨论不清楚（例如。 不清楚并行化是针对多个目标分子还是同时在多个位置扩展单个分子的搜索树（W4）：尽管许多现有论文和参考文献已经包含在内，但一篇综述论文应当尽可能全面，因此在我综述的“参考文献”部分中列出的一些更多参考文献也可以被纳入。具体来说，还可以提及的内容包括：- 开心果数据集[8]，该数据集在一些工作中也被使用， either for testing generalization [2] or for pretraining [10] - 更多单步模型：[7] - 更多搜索算法：[1, 9] - 对几种方法进行整体评估并讨论潜在陷阱的论文：[2-5] 最后，还有一些关于逆合成驱动药物设计的工作[6]，这些工作通常不遵循反向逆合成搜索蓝图，这可能取决于作者的偏好，超出本综述的范围。（W5）：该论文总体上似乎写得不太好，全文存在多处错别字（详见“挑剔”部分的一些例子）。=== 挑剔 === 以下我列出了各种语法问题、错别字或断句；这个列表并不全面，但代表了改进工作的起点。 - “涉及通过递归地将目标分子分解为更简单的分子来设计目标分子的过程”（摘要） - 这里“设计”一词可能造成混淆，因为人们可能会认为它指的是药物设计，而通常逆合成规划是在有具体目标分子的情况下进行的（尽管当然有例外[6]） - “正方形代表反应节点，分子由圆形表示。” - 错误使用“e.g.”，在有些地方“i.e.”更合适 - “是可解释的，并且可以建模多种化学关系，同时也具有可解释性” - 一些标点符号缺失，例如“e.g.”中的“g”后缺少标点 - 图2和图3在目的上大量重叠 - 图2中的“molcule”拼写错误 - “SMILES主要用于编码通用分子子图模式” - 你是指SMARTS吗？ - “基于SMART的” - “e = (v_i, v_j, b)，其中v_i和v_j是通过键b连接的原子” - 解释b - “通过……获得” - “可以自动识别” - “键类型 - 单键（-）或（）” - 请明确解释单键有时是隐含的，而不是写成“（）” - “半模板RP试图应对这些挑战中的一些” - “Se2Seq” - “Criticv” - 图3中的“Retrosyntic” - “deepspeeed” - “使用RL优化单步RP” - “由于次优性，作为次优性的结果” === 参考文献 === [1] 刘等人，"FusionRetro: 通过上下文学习进行分子表示融合以用于逆合成规划" [2] Maziarz等人，"使用Syntheseus重新评估逆合成算法" [3] Hassen等人，"注意逆合成差距：弥合单步和多步逆合成预测之间的鸿沟" [4] Torren-Peraire等人，"模型至关重要：单步逆合成对合成规划的影响" [5] Tripp等人，"重新评估化学合成规划算法" [6] Bradshaw等人，"搜索可合成分子的模型" [7] 钟等人，"Root-aligned SMILES：化学反应预测的紧凑表示" [8] Mayfield等人，"Pistachio：大型反应数据库的搜索和分面" [9] Tripp等人，"Retro-fallback：不确定世界中的逆合成规划" [10] 姜等人，"通过预训练学习逆合成的化学规则"

**请求的修改：**
尽管作者所做的工作是一个良好的初步尝试，但我认为该论文需要大幅修订才能被TMLR接受发表。我请求首先解决“弱点”部分中列出的要点。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
由于这是一篇综述文章，我认为它不会带来任何伦理风险或关切。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

paper_title: Pharmacovigilance in perspective: drug withdrawals, data mining and policy implications
paper_abstract: Considering that marketed drugs are not free from side effects, many countries have initiated pharmacovigilance programs. These initiatives have provided countries with methods of detection and prevention of adverse drug reactions at an earlier stage, thus preventing harm occurring in the larger population. In this review, examples of drug withdrawals due to effective pharmacovigilance programs have been provided with details. In addition, information concerning data mining in pharmacovigilance, an effective method to assess pharmacoepidemiologic data and detecting signals for rare and uncommon side effects, is also examined, which is a method synchronized with information technology and advanced electronic tools. The importance of policy framework in relation to pharmacovigilance is discussed in detail, and country experiences upon implementation of pharmacovigilance policies is highlighted.
review_content: The article has been written in a very appropriate way. This review article has also used relevant literature and the information given is very appropriate in the field of pharmacovigilance. The references are used accurately. Data miming information about the pharmacovigilance has been considered as an important area of information and this article will help young researchers to work more in this area. paper_title: Oral hormone pregnancy tests and the risks of congenital malformations: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract:
Background: Oral hormone pregnancy tests (HPTs), such as Primodos, containing ethinylestradiol and high doses of norethisterone, were given to over a million women from 1958 to 1978, when Primodos was withdrawn from the market because of concerns about possible teratogenicity. We aimed to study the association between maternal exposure to oral HPTs and congenital malformations. 
 Methods: We have performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of case-control and cohort studies that included data from pregnant women and were exposed to oral HPTs within the estimated first three months of pregnancy, if compared with a relevant control group. We used random-effects meta-analysis and assessed the quality of each study using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale for non-randomized studies. 
 Results: We found 16 case control studies and 10 prospective cohort studies, together including 71 330 women, of whom 4,209 were exposed to HPTs. Exposure to oral HPTs was associated with a 40% increased risk of all congenital malformations: pooled odds ratio (OR) = 1.40 (95% CI 1.18 to 1.66; P<0.0001; I 2 = 0%). Exposure to HPTs was associated with an increased risk of congenital heart malformations: pooled OR = 1.89 (95% CI 1.32 to 2.72; P = 0.0006; I 2 =0%); nervous system malformations  OR = 2.98 (95% CI 1.32 to 6.76; P = 0.0109 I 2 = 78%); gastrointestinal malformations, OR = 4.50 (95% CI 0.63 to 32.20; P = 0.13; I 2 = 54%); musculoskeletal malformations, OR = 2.24 (95% CI 1.23 to 4.08; P= 0.009; I 2 = 0%); the VACTERL syndrome (Vertebral defects, Anal atresia, Cardiovascular anomalies, Tracheoesophageal fistula, Esophageal atresia, Renal anomalies, and Limb defects), OR = 7.47 (95% CI 2.92 to 19.07; P < 0.0001; I 2 = 0%). 
 Conclusions: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows that use of oral HPTs in pregnancy is associated with increased risks of congenital malformations.
review_content:
The manuscript reads well. The manuscript was well written. It has the potential to add to the body of knowledge in the field. The method was described in detail to allow for replication of the study. I have no major concerns.

My only comment: the author should change the abstract conclusion to: “This systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies shows that the use of oral HPTs in pregnancy is associated with increased risks of congenital malformations”.
paper_title_zh: 口服激素妊娠试验与先天性畸形风险：系统综述与Meta分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：口服激素妊娠试验（HPTs），如含有炔雌醇和高剂量炔诺酮的Primodos，在1958年至1978年间被给予超过一百万名女性，当时Primodos因可能具有致畸性而从市场上撤回。我们旨在研究母体暴露于口服HPTs与先天性畸形之间的关联。

方法：我们对包括孕妇数据并在怀孕前三个月内暴露于口服HPTs的病例对照研究和队列研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析，并与相关对照组进行比较。我们使用随机效应荟萃分析，并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华非随机研究量表评估每项研究的质量。

结果：我们发现了16项病例对照研究和10项前瞻性队列研究，共包括71,330名女性，其中4,209名暴露于HPTs。暴露于口服HPTs与所有先天性畸形风险增加40%相关：合并比值比（OR）= 1.40（95% CI 1.18至1.66；P<0.0001；I²=0%）。暴露于HPTs与先天性心脏畸形风险增加相关：合并OR = 1.89（95% CI 1.32至2.72；P=0.0006；I²=0%）；神经系统畸形OR = 2.98（95% CI 1.32至6.76；P=0.0109；I²=78%）；胃肠道畸形OR = 4.50（95% CI 0.63至32.20；P=0.13；I²=54%）；肌肉骨骼畸形OR = 2.24（95% CI 1.23至4.08；P=0.009；I²=0%）；VACTERL综合征（脊椎缺陷、肛门闭锁、心血管异常、气管食管瘘、食管闭锁、肾脏异常和肢体缺陷）OR = 7.47（95% CI 2.92至19.07；P<0.0001；I²=0%）。

结论：这项系统综述和荟萃分析表明，孕期使用口服HPTs与先天性畸形风险增加相关。

paper_title: Augmented Language Models: a Survey
paper_abstract: This survey reviews works in which language models (LMs) are augmented with reasoning skills and the ability to use tools. The former is defined as decomposing a potentially complex task into simpler subtasks while the latter consists in calling external modules such as a code interpreter. LMs can leverage these augmentations separately or in combination via heuristics, or learn to do so from demonstrations. While adhering to a standard missing tokens prediction objective, such augmented LMs can use various, possibly non-parametric external modules to expand their context processing ability, thus departing from the pure language modeling paradigm. We therefore refer to them as Augmented Language Models (ALMs). The missing token objective allows ALMs to learn to reason, use tools, and even act, while still performing standard natural language tasks and even outperforming most regular LMs on several benchmarks. In this work, after reviewing current advance in ALMs, we conclude that this new research direction has the potential to address common limitations of traditional LMs such as interpretability, consistency, and scalability issues.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a comprehensive survey on augmented language models (ALMs). Maybe slightly different from others’ definition of ALMs, the authors define ALMs as LMs augmented with reasoning and tools, resulting in agents that combine reasoning, tool usage, and action, in addition to purely LMs. In this regard, the survey systematically reviews ALMs with respect to reasoning, tool usage, and action, which were usually discussed separately before. This approach offers a more visionary perspective for readers to view LLMs and gain a deeper understanding of the underlying connections among recent advancements in these fields.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
### Strengths: 1. This paper provides a novel perspective on augmented language models – by reviewing reasoning, tool usage, and action in the same framework, ALMs are envisioned as powerful agents. The paper also includes an interesting discussion on the connection between ALMs and world models. Although LLMs as agents are not new, this paper clearly defines and reviews the critical aspects of serving as agents, which I appreciate a lot by reading the paper. 2. This paper includes a comprehensive list of related work on reasoning, tool usage, and action, which should be helpful for researchers in related fields. ### Weaknesses: I don’t identify significant weaknesses of this paper.

**Requested Changes:**
I don't have requested changes for this paper.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
This paper included a nice discussion on ethical concerns that I feel sufficient.

**Audience:**

paper_title: Explainability of Vision Transformers: A Comprehensive Review and New Perspectives
paper_abstract: Transformers have had a significant impact on natural language processing and have recently demonstrated their potential in computer vision. They have shown promising results over convolution neural networks in fundamental computer vision tasks. However, the scientific community has not fully grasped the inner workings of vision transformers, nor the basis for their decision-making, which underscores the importance of explainability methods. Understanding how these models arrive at their decisions not only improves their performance but also builds trust in AI systems. This study explores different explainability methods proposed for vision transformers and presents a taxonomy for organizing them according to their motivations, structures, and application scenarios. In addition, it provides a comprehensive review of evaluation criteria that can be used for comparing explanation results, as well as explainability tools and frameworks. Finally, the paper highlights essential but unexplored aspects that can enhance the explainability of vision transformers, and promising research directions are suggested for future investment.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper reviews techniques, evaluation criteria, software packages, and datasets in explainability of vision transformers. The techniques are organized into common attribution, attention-based, pruning-based, inherently explainable, and applicable to non-classification tasks. Two experiments and a visualization are also provided to compare some of the reviewed techniques. The paper concludes by highlighting current limitations of explainability research in terms of techniques, evaluations, and applications.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Although I am not well-versed enough in explainability research to ensure the paper has not missed a key method, the review appears comprehensive. The taxonomy in Figure 2 is especially helpful for research in this area. The techniques, evaluation criteria, datasets, tools, and limitations of current reserach are all adequately explained. I am overall positive about the submission as long as the following comments about writing are addressed and unless other issues are brought up in the reviewer discussions. 1. Section 5 has a footnote that PaddlePaddle is "The first independent R&D deep learning platform in China". This is irrelevant to the paper and should be removed. Further, in case there is some conflict of interest regarding the software packages, the authors should also consult the journal's guidelines on conflicts of interest and sources of funding to ensure the final version is transparent. 2. The text in Section 5 appears AI-generated. I cannot guarantee this and I cannot find the TMLR guidelines on AI-generated text if this is the case. Depending on the action editor's decision, this section may have to be paraphrased. 3. The same section has multiple vague phrases when introducing the tools such as "a valuable resource", "a noteworthy ... tool", "a unique perspective", and an "invaluable resource". Even if the text is not AI-generated, such phrases should be removed. 4. Many of the citations throughout the paper should have parenthesis using \pcite or \parencite. 5. Section 3 has multiple comments about the performance of the methods. Since this section appears before the evaluation criteria is described, it is important to mention, at least after the first comment on performance, that the next section will describe the evaluation criteria. 6. The description for Attention Rollout says "Although it outperforms the raw attention explanations, it has several limitations." The name of the evaluation criteria and at least one of the limitations should be mentioned. This is also the best place to refer the reader to section 4 for a description of the evaluation criteria as per comment 5 above. Similarly, the text about Beyond Intuition mentions that it "performs 20 times more accurate than ...". The name of the criterion should be mentioned. Also, accurate->accurately. 7. Attention Flow is said to be "more correlated than the Rollout method in some cases". What quantity is it correlated with? 8. The text below Eq. 12 mentions that this metric is "a weighted average of classification accuracy and explainability". Eq. 12 does not look like a weighted average. Does this text refer to Eq. 12 itself, or is Eq. 12 used in some weighted average to obtain another quantity? 9. There are some phrases in the text that will be confusing to some readers and will need a clearer definition, an example, or rephrasing. Important cases are "face information retention" (Section 2.1), "high-level semantics" (Section 3.2), and "class token" and "image token" (Section 3.3.2). 10. Is it possible to use the same x-axis for Figure 6 (a) and Figure 7 instead of insertion rate and keep_rate? 11. Typos and minor errors: "Shaply"->"Shapley" (Section 3.1), "qualitative and qualitative"->"qualitative and quantitative" (Section 3.3.2). "extended Beyond Attention method"->"proposed Beyond Attention method".

**Requested Changes:**
See the comments on writing.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Reply to  Reviewer SkfT: First of all, We thank the reviewer very much for his/her positive comments on our submitted paper. We have done our best to improve the article by considering the following numbered list. 1: We followed your suggestion and removed the footnote. Given that PaddlePaddle and InterpretDL have common contributors, we concluded that there is no conflict of interest and therefore we removed that. 2: We guarantee that this section ( section 5 ) is not AI-generated, however, we paraphrased some parts that may seem more formal than necessary. 3: Given the above comments, we revised that section and removed/ changed those phrases. 4: Thanks for this comment, we refined all citations according to the TMLR template. 5: We followed your suggestion and included a note to Section 3 (end of 4th paragraph), indicating that Section 4 will provide a detailed description of the evaluation criteria. 6: Thanks for this comment, We added the names of the evaluation metrics and the limitations to the descriptions. Additionally, we fixed the typos in these paragraphs (4th paragraph in section 3.2): Although it outperforms the raw attention explanations, it has several limitations. One of these is the exaggerated differences between attention scores for different tokens, which occur because it combines tokens linearly through layers based on attention weights. This results in a loss of faithfulness in saliency maps. Faithfulness refers to how accurately a saliency map represents the target model. It is measured by observing how quickly the model’s score for the target class changes when important pixels are removed or added. This loss of faithfulness affects evaluation metrics such as Deletion Area Under the Curve (AUC) and Insertion AUC (for a detailed description of these criteria please see Section 4 ) (Komorowski et al., 2023; Bhatt et al., 2020; Petsiuk et al., 2018; Nguyen & Martínez, 2020). and in the 11th paragraph in section 3.2 as follows: Specifically, the token-wise attention map performs 20 times more accurately than Attention Rollout in terms of faithfulness evaluation metrics, such as Deletion AUC, Insertion AUC, and Faithfulness correlation (see section 4) (Komorowski et al., 2023; Bhatt et al., 2020; Petsiuk et al., 2018; Nguyen & Martínez, 2020) 7: We added the quantity of correlation as follows: It is known to be more correlated with the importance scores of the input tokens than the Rollout method with respect to the ablation method and input gradients, but it is too slow to support large-scale evaluations (Abnar & Zuidema, 2020). 8: This metric evaluates explainability, considering the clarity of the explanation, with overall performance measured by the mean accuracy across different categories in the dataset. In addition, it can be employed to evaluate the weighted average of classification accuracy and explainability, meaning that it considers both the correctness of the prediction and the clarity of the explanation. As these statements, we revised that section as follows: This metric can be employed to evaluate the weighted average of classification accuracy and explainability, meaning that it considers both the correctness of the prediction and the clarity of the explanation (Zhang et al., 2018).
paper_title_zh: 视觉Transformer的可解释性：全面综述与新视角
paper_abstract_zh: Transformer在自然语言处理领域产生了显著影响，并在近期展示了在计算机视觉领域的潜力。它们在基本的计算机视觉任务中相较于卷积神经网络展现了令人瞩目的结果。然而，科学界尚未完全理解视觉Transformer的内部工作机制，以及其决策依据，这凸显了可解释性方法的重要性。理解这些模型如何做出决策不仅能够提升其性能，还能增强对AI系统的信任。本研究探讨了针对视觉Transformer提出的不同可解释性方法，并根据其动机、结构和应用场景提出了一个分类体系。此外，它还提供了用于比较解释结果的评估标准的全面综述，以及可解释性工具和框架。最后，本文强调了能够提升视觉Transformer可解释性的重要但未探索的方面，并提出了未来值得投入的研究方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这篇综述论文回顾了视觉Transformer可解释性方面的技术、评估标准、软件包和数据集。这些技术被分为常见归因、基于注意力、基于剪枝、固有可解释性和适用于非分类任务等类别。此外，还提供了两个实验和一个可视化，以比较一些被回顾的技术。论文通过强调当前可解释性研究在技术、评估和应用方面的局限性来总结。

**优点和缺点：**
尽管我对可解释性研究的了解不足以确保论文没有遗漏关键方法，但该综述看起来是全面的。图2中的分类法对这一领域的研究特别有帮助。当前研究的技术、评估标准、数据集、工具和局限性都得到了充分的解释。总体上，我对这篇投稿持积极态度，只要以下关于写作的评论得到解决，且在审稿人讨论中没有提出其他问题。1. 第5节有一个脚注，提到PaddlePaddle是“中国首个独立研发的深度学习平台”。这与论文无关，应予删除。此外，以防在软件包方面存在利益冲突，作者还应参考期刊关于利益冲突和资金来源的指南，以确保最终版本的透明度。2. 第5节的文本看起来像是AI生成的。我无法保证这一点，也找不到TMLR关于AI生成文本的指南。根据责任编辑的决定，这一节可能需要改写。3. 同一节在介绍工具时使用了多个模糊的短语，如“宝贵的资源”、“值得注意的工具”、“独特的视角”和“无价的资源”。即使文本不是AI生成的，这些短语也应删除。4. 论文中的许多引用应使用\pcite或\parencite加括号。5. 第3节有多处关于方法性能的评论。由于这一节出现在评估标准描述之前，至少在第一次评论性能后，重要的是要提到下一节将描述评估标准。6. 注意力展开（Attention Rollout）的描述中提到“尽管它优于原始注意力解释，但存在一些局限性”。应提及评估标准的名称和至少一个局限性。这也是根据上述第5条评论，引导读者参考第4节描述评估标准的最佳位置。同样，关于超越直觉（Beyond Intuition）的文本提到它“比……准确20倍”。应提及标准的名称。此外，accurate应改为accurately。7. 注意力流（Attention Flow）被说成在某些情况下“比展开方法更相关”。它与什么量相关？8. Eq. 12下方的文本提到该指标是“分类准确性和可解释性的加权平均值”。Eq. 12看起来并不像一个加权平均值。这段文本是指Eq. 12本身，还是Eq. 12用于某种加权平均值以获得另一个量？9. 文中有些短语对一些读者来说可能会感到困惑，需要更清晰的定义、示例或改写。重要的情况包括“面部信息保留”（第2.1节）、“高层语义”（第3.2节）以及“类标记”和“图像标记”（第3.3.2节）。10. 是否可能对图6（a）和图7使用相同的x轴，而不是插入率和保留率？11. 错别字和小错误：“Shaply”应为“Shapley”（第3.1节），“qualitative and qualitative”应为“qualitative and quantitative”（第3.3.2节）。“extended Beyond Attention method”应为“proposed Beyond Attention method”。

回复审稿人SkfT：首先，我们非常感谢审稿人对我们投稿的积极评论。我们已经尽力通过考虑以下编号列表来改进文章。1：我们按照您的建议删除了脚注。鉴于PaddlePaddle和InterpretDL有共同的贡献者，我们得出结论认为没有利益冲突，因此我们删除了这一点。2：我们保证这一节（第5节）不是AI生成的，但我们改写了一些可能显得过于正式的部分。3：鉴于上述评论，我们修订了那一节，删除/更改了那些短语。4：感谢这条评论，我们根据TMLR模板精炼了所有引用。5：我们按照您的建议，在第3节（第4段末尾）加入了一条注释，指出第4节将提供评估标准的详细描述。6：感谢这条评论，我们在描述中添加了评估指标的名称和局限性。此外，我们修正了这些段落中的错别字（第3.2节的第4段）：尽管它优于原始注意力解释，但存在一些局限性。其中之一是不同标记之间的注意力分数差异被夸大，这是因为它通过基于注意力权重的层线性组合标记，导致显著性图的真实性丧失。真实性指的是显著性图准确表示目标模型的能力。通过观察当重要像素被移除或添加时，模型对目标类别的分数变化速度来衡量。这种真实性的丧失影响了诸如删除面积曲线下（AUC）和插入AUC等评估指标（关于这些标准的详细描述请见第4节）（Komorowski et al., 2023; Bhatt et al., 2020; Petsiuk et al., 2018; Nguyen & Martínez, 2020）。以及第3.2节的第11段如下：具体来说，标记-wise注意力图在真实性评估指标方面比注意力展开准确20倍，如删除AUC、插入AUC和真实性相关性（见第4节）（Komorowski et al., 2023; Bhatt et al., 2020; Petsiuk et al., 2018; Nguyen & Martínez, 2020）。7：我们添加了相关量的描述如下：已知它与输入标记的重要性分数在消融方法和输入梯度方面比展开方法更相关，但太慢，无法支持大规模评估（Abnar & Zuidema, 2020）。8：该指标评估可解释性，考虑解释的清晰度，整体性能通过数据集中不同类别的平均准确度来衡量。此外，它可以用来评估分类准确性和可解释性的加权平均值，意味着它考虑了预测的正确性和解释的清晰度。根据这些陈述，我们修订了那一节如下：该指标可以用来评估分类准确性和可解释性的加权平均值，意味着它考虑了预测的正确性和解释的清晰度（Zhang et al., 2018）。

paper_title: Assessment of methods used for 3-dimensional superimposition of craniofacial skeletal structures: A systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. So far, several techniques have been recommended for the assessment of craniofacial changes through skeletal tissue superimposition, but the evidence that supports them remains unexplored. The purpose of the present study is to assess the available literature on skeletal-tissue superimpositions of serial craniofacial CT or CBCT images used to detect morphological changes. Materials and methods. Medline (via Pubmed), EMBASE, Google Scholar, Cochrane Library, Open Grey and Grey Literature Report were searched (last search: 17.11.2019) using specific terms that fulfilled the requirements of each database in the context of the study aim. Hand searches were also performed. The outcomes of interest were the accuracy, precision, or agreement between skeletal-tissue superimposition techniques to assess changes in the morphology of craniofacial structures. Studies of any design with sample size ≥ 3 were assessed by two authors independently. The study protocol was registered in PROSPERO (ID: CRD42019143356). Results. Out of 832 studies, fifteen met the eligibility criteria. From the 15 included studies, 12 have shown high total risk of bias, one low risk of bias, and 2 studies have shown unclear risk of bias. Thirteen out of the 15 studies showed high applicability concerns, 2 unclear and no study had low applicability concerns. There was high heterogeneity among studies regarding the type of participants, sample size, growth status, machines, acquisition parameters, superimposition techniques, assessment techniques and outcomes measured. Fourteen of them were performed on Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) and one on Computed Tomography (CT) derived 3D models. paper_title: A conflicts' classification for IoT-based services : A comparative survey
paper_abstract: Recently, IoT-based systems, especially automation systems, have become an indispensable part of modern-day lives to support the controlling of the networked devices and providing context-aware and intelligent environments. IoT-based services/apps developed by the end-users interact with each other and share concurrent access to devices according to their preferences, which increases safety, security, and correctness issues in IoT systems. Due to the critical impacts resulting from these issues, IoT-based apps require a customized type of compilers or checking tools that capable of analyzing the structures of these apps and detecting different types of errors and conflicts either in intra-IoT app instructions or in inter-IoT apps interactions. A plethora of approaches and frameworks have been proposed to assist the best practices for end-users in developing their IoT-based apps and mitigate these errors and conflicts. This paper focuses on conflict classification and detection approaches in the context of IoT systems by investigating the current research techniques that provided conflicts' classification or detection in IoT systems (published between 2014 and 2020). A classification of IoT-based apps interaction conflicts is proposed. The proposed conflicts' classification provides a priori conflicts detection method based on the analysis of IoT app instructions' relationships with utilizing the state-of-the-art Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) model checking and formal notations. The current detection approaches are compared with each other according to the proposed conflicts' classification to determine to which extend they cover different conflicts. Based on this comparison, we provide evidence that the existing approaches have a gap in covering different conflicts' levels and types which yields to minimize the correctness and safety of IoT systems. We point out the need to develop a safety and security compiler or tool for IoT systems.
